1.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
1.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
1.e: One Universal Creator God. The Name Is Truth. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying, Beyond Birth, Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace ~

1.g: ॥ ਜਪੁ ॥
1.t: || jap ||
1.e: Name of the Composition, "Jup". Chant And Meditate:

1.g: ਆਦਿ ਸਚੁ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਚੁ ॥
1.t: aadh sach jugaadh sach ||
1.e: True In The Primal Beginning. True Throughout The Ages.

1.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹੋਸੀ ਭੀ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
1.t: hai bhee sach naanak hosee bhee sach ||1||
1.e: True Here And Now. O Nanak, Forever And Ever True. ||1||

1.g: ਸੋਚੈ ਸੋਚਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸੋਚੀ ਲਖ ਵਾਰ ॥
1.t: sochai soch na hoviee je sochee lakh vaar ||
1.e: Even if one bathes hundreds of thousands of times, the mind does not become cleansed.

1.g: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੁਪ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਲਾਇ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
1.t: chupai chup na hoviee je lai rahaa liv taar ||
1.e: By remaining silent, inner silence is not obtained, even by remaining lovingly absorbed deep within.

1.g: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੇ ਬੰਨਾ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਭਾਰ ॥
1.t: bhukhiaa bhukh na utaree je ba(n)naa pureeaa bhaar ||
1.e: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased, even by piling up loads of worldly goods.

1.g: ਸਹਸ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਤ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
1.t: sahas siaanapaa lakh hoh ta ik na chalai naal ||
1.e: Hundreds of thousands of clever tricks, but not even one of them will go along with you in the end.

1.g: ਕਿਵ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ਹੋਈਐ ਕਿਵ ਕੂੜੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਾਲਿ ॥
1.t: kiv sachiaaraa hoieeaai kiv kooRai tuTai paal ||
1.e: So how can you become truthful? And how can the veil of falsehood be torn away?

1.g: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
1.t: hukam rajaiee chalanaa naanak likhiaa naal ||1||
1.e: O Nanak, it is written that you shall obey the Hukam of His Command, and walk in the Way of His Will. ||1||

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਆਕਾਰ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
1.t: hukamee hovan aakaar hukam na kahiaa jaiee ||
1.e: By His Command, bodies are created; His Command cannot be described.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
1.t: hukamee hovan jeea hukam milai vaddiaaiee ||
1.e: By His Command, souls come into being; by His Command, glory and greatness are obtained.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
1.t: hukamee utam neech hukam likh dhukh sukh paie'eeh ||
1.e: By His Command, some are high and some are low; by His Written Command, pain and pleasure are obtained.

1.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ ॥
1.t: eikanaa hukamee bakhasees ik hukamee sadhaa bhavaie'eeh ||
1.e: Some, by His Command, are blessed and forgiven; others, by His Command, wander aimlessly forever.

1.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਹੁਕਮ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
1.t: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko baahar hukam na koi ||
1.e: Everyone is subject to His Command; no one is beyond His Command.

1.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਜੇ ਬੁਝੈ ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
1.t: naanak hukamai je bujhai ta haumai kahai na koi ||2||
1.e: O Nanak, one who understands His Command, does not speak in ego. ||2||

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko taan hovai kisai taan ||
1.e: Some sing of His Power-who has that Power?

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko dhaat jaanai neesaan ||
1.e: Some sing of His Gifts, and know His Sign and Insignia.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਗੁਣ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਚਾਰ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko gun vaddiaaieeaa chaar ||
1.e: Some sing of His Glorious Virtues, Greatness and Beauty.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਵਿਖਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko vidhiaa vikham veechaar ||
1.e: Some sing of knowledge obtained of Him, through difficult philosophical studies.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko saaj kare tan kheh ||
1.e: Some sing that He fashions the body, and then again reduces it to dust.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko jeea lai fir dheh ||
1.e: Some sing that He takes life away, and then again restores it.

1.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
1.t: gaavai ko jaapai dhisai dhoor ||
1.e: Some sing that He seems so very far away.

2.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਾਦਰਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
2.t: gaavai ko vekhai haadharaa hadhoor ||
2.e: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present.

2.g: ਕਥਨਾ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤੋਟਿ ॥
2.t: kathanaa kathee na aavai toT ||
2.e: There is no shortage of those who preach and teach.

2.g: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਕਥੀ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ॥
2.t: kath kath kathee koTee koT koT ||
2.e: Millions upon millions offer millions of sermons and stories.

2.g: ਦੇਦਾ ਦੇ ਲੈਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
2.t: dhedhaa dhe laidhe thak paeh ||
2.e: The Great Giver keeps on giving, while those who receive grow weary of receiving.

2.g: ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹੀ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
2.t: jugaa juga(n)tar khaahee khaeh ||
2.e: Throughout the ages, consumers consume.

2.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਰਾਹੁ ॥
2.t: hukamee hukam chalaae raahu ||
2.e: The Commander, by His Command, leads us to walk on the Path.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੩॥
2.t: naanak vigasai veparavaahu ||3||
2.e: O Nanak, He blossoms forth, Carefree and Untroubled. ||3||

2.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਇ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਉ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
2.t: saachaa saahib saach nai bhaakhiaa bhaau apaar ||
2.e: True is the Master, True is His Name-speak it with infinite love.

2.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
2.t: aakheh ma(n)geh dheh dheh dhaat kare dhaataar ||
2.e: People beg and pray, ""Give to us, give to us"", and the Great Giver gives His Gifts.

2.g: ਫੇਰਿ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਰਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਿਸੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
2.t: fer k agai rakheeaai jit dhisai dharabaar ||
2.e: So what offering can we place before Him, by which we might see the Darbaar of His Court?

2.g: ਮੁਹੌ ਕਿ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
2.t: muhau k bolan boleeaai jit sun dhare piaar ||
2.e: What words can we speak to evoke His Love?

2.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
2.t: a(n)mirat velaa sach naau vaddiaaiee veechaar ||
2.e: In the Amrit Vaylaa, the ambrosial hours before dawn, chant the True Name, and contemplate His Glorious Greatness.

2.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਵੈ ਕਪੜਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
2.t: karamee aavai kapaRaa nadharee mokh dhuaar ||
2.e: By the karma of past actions, the robe of this physical body is obtained. By His Grace, the Gate of Liberation is found.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੪॥
2.t: naanak evai jaaneeaai sabh aape sachiaar ||4||
2.e: O Nanak, know this well: the True One Himself is All. ||4||

2.g: ਥਾਪਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਤਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
2.t: thaapiaa na jai keetaa na hoi ||
2.e: He cannot be established, He cannot be created.

2.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
2.t: aape aap nira(n)jan soi ||
2.e: He Himself is Immaculate and Pure.

2.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
2.t: jin seviaa tin paiaa maan ||
2.e: Those who serve Him are honored.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
2.t: naanak gaaveeaai gunee nidhaan ||
2.e: O Nanak, sing of the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

2.g: ਗਾਵੀਐ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਰਖੀਐ ਭਾਉ ॥
2.t: gaaveeaai suneeaai man rakheeaai bhaau ||
2.e: Sing, and listen, and let your mind be filled with love.

2.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
2.t: dhukh parahar sukh ghar lai jai ||
2.e: Your pain shall be sent far away, and peace shall come to your home.

2.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਦੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
2.t: gurmukh naadha(n) gurmukh vedha(n) gurmukh rahiaa samaiee ||
2.e: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad; the Guru's Word is the Wisdom of the Vedas; the Guru's Word is all-pervading.

2.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਈਸਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਰਖੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
2.t: gur ieesar gur gorakh baramaa gur paarabatee maiee ||
2.e: The Guru is Shiva, the Guru is Vishnu and Brahma; the Guru is Paarvati and Lakhshmi.

2.g: ਜੇ ਹਉ ਜਾਣਾ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
2.t: je hau jaanaa aakhaa naahee kahanaa kathan na jaiee ||
2.e: Even knowing God, I cannot describe Him; He cannot be described in words.

2.g: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
2.t: guraa ik dheh bujhaiee ||
2.e: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

2.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
2.t: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||5||
2.e: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||5||

2.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਣੇ ਕਿ ਨਾਇ ਕਰੀ ॥
2.t: teerath naavaa je tis bhaavaa vin bhaane k nai karee ||
2.e: If I am pleasing to Him, then that is my pilgrimage and cleansing bath. Without pleasing Him, what good are ritual cleansings?

2.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵੇਖਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਈ ॥
2.t: jetee siraTh upaiee vekhaa vin karamaa k milai liee ||
2.e: I gaze upon all the created beings: without the karma of good actions, what are they given to receive?

2.g: ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਿਕ ਜੇ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
2.t: mat vich ratan javaahar maanik je ik gur kee sikh sunee ||
2.e: Within the mind are gems, jewels and rubies, if you listen to the Guru's Teachings, even once.

2.g: ਗੁਰਾ ਇਕ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
2.t: guraa ik dheh bujhaiee ||
2.e: The Guru has given me this one understanding:

2.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੬॥
2.t: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa so mai visar na jaiee ||6||
2.e: there is only the One, the Giver of all souls. May I never forget Him! ||6||

2.g: ਜੇ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਆਰਜਾ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
2.t: je jug chaare aarajaa hor dhasoonee hoi ||
2.e: Even if you could live throughout the four ages, or even ten times more,

2.g: ਨਵਾ ਖੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
2.t: navaa kha(n)ddaa vich jaaneeaai naal chalai sabh koi ||
2.e: and even if you were known throughout the nine continents and followed by all,

2.g: ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਉ ਰਖਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਸੁ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਲੇਇ ॥
2.t: cha(n)gaa naau rakhai kai jas keerat jag lei ||
2.e: with a good name and reputation, with praise and fame throughout the world-

2.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਤ ਵਾਤ ਨ ਪੁਛੈ ਕੇ ॥
2.t: je tis nadhar na aaviee ta vaat na puchhai ke ||
2.e: still, if the Lord does not bless you with His Glance of Grace, then who cares? What is the use?

2.g: ਕੀਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੀਟੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਸੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਧਰੇ ॥
2.t: keeTaa a(n)dhar keeT kar dhosee dhos dhare ||
2.e: Among worms, you would be considered a lowly worm, and even contemptible sinners would hold you in contempt.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਦੇ ॥
2.t: naanak niragun gun kare gunava(n)tiaa gun dhe ||
2.e: O Nanak, God blesses the unworthy with virtue, and bestows virtue on the virtuous.

2.g: ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਜਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋਇ ਕਰੇ ॥੭॥
2.t: tehaa koi na sujhiee j tis gun koi kare ||7||
2.e: No one can even imagine anyone who can bestow virtue upon Him. ||7||

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
2.t: suniaai sidh peer sur naath ||
2.e: Listening-the Siddhas, the spiritual teachers, the heroic warriors, the yogic masters.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਧਰਤਿ ਧਵਲ ਆਕਾਸ ॥
2.t: suniaai dharat dhaval aakaas ||
2.e: Listening-the earth, its support and the Akaashic ethers.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
2.t: suniaai dheep loa paataal ||
2.e: Listening-the oceans, the lands of the world and the nether regions of the underworld.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
2.t: suniaai poh na sakai kaal ||
2.e: Listening-Death cannot even touch you.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
2.t: naanak bhagataa sadhaa vigaas ||
2.e: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਪ ਕਾ ਨਾਸੁ ॥੮॥
2.t: suniaai dhookh paap kaa naas ||8||
2.e: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||8||

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਇੰਦੁ ॥
2.t: suniaai ieesar baramaa i(n)dh ||
2.e: Listening, and connecting one's consciousness with the Name of the Eternal Being, an ordinary person can rise to the status of Shiva, Brahma, or Indra.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣ ਮੰਦੁ ॥
2.t: suniaai mukh saalaahan ma(n)dh ||
2.e: Listening-even foul-mouthed people praise Him.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੇਦ ॥
2.t: suniaai jog jugat tan bhedh ||
2.e: Listening-the technology of Yoga and the secrets of the body.

2.g: ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਵੇਦ ॥
2.t: suniaai saasat simirat vedh ||
2.e: Listening-the Shaastras, the Simritees and the Vedas.

2.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
2.t: naanak bhagataa sadhaa vigaas ||
2.e: O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.

3.e: Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||9||
Listening-truth, contentment and spiritual wisdom.
Listening-take your cleansing bath at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
Listening-reading and reciting, honor is obtained.
Listening-intuitively grasp the essence of meditation.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||10||
Listening-dive deep into the ocean of virtue.
Listening-the Shaykhs, religious scholars, spiritual teachers and emperors.
Listening-even the blind find the Path.
Listening-the Unreachable comes within your grasp.
O Nanak, the devotees are forever in bliss.
Listening-pain and sin are erased. ||11||

3.g: ਮੰਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
3.t: ma(n)ne kee gat kahee na jai ||
3.e: The state of the faithful cannot be described.
One who tries to describe this shall regret the attempt.
No paper, no pen, no scribe
can record the state of the faithful.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

3.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
3.t: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||12||
3.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||12||
The faithful have intuitive awareness and intelligence.
The faithful know about all worlds and realms.
The faithful shall never be struck across the face.

3.g: ਮੰਨੈ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
3.t: ma(n)nai jam kai saath na jai ||
3.e: The faithful do not have to go with the Messenger of Death.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

3.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੩॥
3.t: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||13||
3.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||13||
The path of the faithful shall never be blocked.
The faithful shall depart with honor and fame.
The faithful do not follow empty religious rituals.
The faithful are firmly bound to the Dharma.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

3.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੪॥
3.t: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||14||
3.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||14||
The faithful find the Door of Liberation.
The faithful uplift and redeem their family and relations.
The faithful are saved, and carried across with the Sikhs of the Guru.
The faithful, O Nanak, do not wander around begging.
Such is the Name of the Immaculate Lord.

3.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧੫॥
3.t: je ko ma(n)n jaanai man koi ||15||
3.e: Only one who has faith comes to know such a state of mind. ||15||
The chosen ones, the self-elect, are accepted and approved.
The chosen ones are honored in the Court of the Lord.
The chosen ones look beautiful in the courts of kings.
The chosen ones meditate single-mindedly on the Guru.
No matter how much anyone tries to explain and describe them,
the actions of the Creator cannot be counted.
The mythical bull is Dharma, the son of compassion;
this is what patiently holds the earth in its place.
One who understands this becomes truthful.
What a great load there is on the bull!
So many worlds beyond this world-so very many!

3.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਤਲੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
3.t: tis te bhaar talai kavan jor ||
3.e: What power holds them, and supports their weight?
The names and the colors of the assorted species of beings
were all inscribed by the Ever-flowing Pen of God.
Who knows how to write this account?
Just imagine what a huge scroll it would take!
What power! What fascinating beauty!
And what gifts! Who can know their extent?
You created the vast expanse of the Universe with One Word!
Hundreds of thousands of rivers began to flow.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

3.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
3.t: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
3.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One! ||16||
Countless meditations, countless loves.
Countless worship services, countless austere disciplines.
Countless scriptures, and ritual recitations of the Vedas.
Countless Yogis, whose minds remain detached from the world.

4.e: Countless devotees contemplate the Wisdom and Virtues of the Lord.
Countless the holy, countless the givers.
Countless heroic spiritual warriors, who bear the brunt of the attack in battle (who with their mouths eat steel).
Countless silent sages, vibrating the String of His Love.
How can Your Creative Potency be described?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

4.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
4.t: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
4.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One. ||17||
Countless fools, blinded by ignorance.
Countless thieves and embezzlers.
Countless impose their will by force.
Countless cut-throats and ruthless killers.
Countless sinners who keep on sinning.
Countless liars, wandering lost in their lies.
Countless wretches, eating filth as their ration.
Countless slanderers, carrying the weight of their stupid mistakes on their heads.
Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

4.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
4.t: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
4.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One. ||18||
Countless names, countless places.
Inaccessible, unapproachable, countless celestial realms.
Even to call them countless is to carry the weight on your head.
From the Word, comes the Naam; from the Word, comes Your Praise.
From the Word, comes spiritual wisdom, singing the Songs of Your Glory.
From the Word, come the written and spoken words and hymns.
From the Word, comes destiny, written on one's forehead.

4.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
4.t: jin eh likhe tis sir naeh ||
4.e: But the One who wrote these Words of Destiny-no words are written on His Forehead.
As He ordains, so do we receive.
The created universe is the manifestation of Your Name.
Without Your Name, there is no place at all.
How can I describe Your Creative Power?
I cannot even once be a sacrifice to You.

4.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
4.t: jo tudh bhaavai saiee bhalee kaar ||
4.e: Whatever pleases You is the only good done,
You, Eternal and Formless One. ||19||
When the hands and the feet and the body are dirty,
water can wash away the dirt.
When the clothes are soiled and stained by urine,
soap can wash them clean.
But when the intellect is stained and polluted by sin,
it can only be cleansed by the Love of the Name.
Virtue and vice do not come by mere words;

4.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
4.t: kar kar karanaa likh lai jaahu ||
4.e: actions repeated, over and over again, are engraved on the soul.
You shall harvest what you plant.
O Nanak, by the Hukam of God's Command, we come and go in reincarnation. ||20||
Pilgrimages, austere discipline, compassion and charity

4.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
4.t: je ko paavai til kaa maan ||
4.e: these, by themselves, bring only an iota of merit.
Listening and believing with love and humility in your mind,
cleanse yourself with the Name, at the sacred shrine deep within.

4.g: ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
4.t: sabh gun tere mai naahee koi ||
4.e: All virtues are Yours, Lord, I have none at all.

4.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
4.t: vin gun keete bhagat na hoi ||
4.e: Without virtue, there is no devotional worship.
I bow to the Lord of the World, to His Word, to Brahma the Creator.
He is Beautiful, True and Eternally Joyful.

4.g: ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਕਵਣ ਥਿਤਿ ਕਵਣੁ ਵਾਰੁ ॥
4.t: kavanu su velaa vakhat kavan kavan thit kavan vaar ||
4.e: What was that time, and what was that moment? What was that day, and what was that date?

4.g: ਕਵਣਿ ਸਿ ਰੁਤੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
4.t: kavan s rutee maahu kavan jit hoaa aakaar ||
4.e: What was that season, and what was that month, when the Universe was created?

4.g: ਵੇਲ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਪੰਡਤੀ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
4.t: vel na paieeaa pa(n)ddatee j hovai lekh puraan ||
4.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, cannot find that time, even if it is written in the Puraanas.

4.g: ਵਖਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਾਦੀਆ ਜਿ ਲਿਖਨਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਕੁਰਾਣੁ ॥
4.t: vakhat na paio kaadheeaa j likhan lekh kuraan ||
4.e: That time is not known to the Qazis, who study the Koran.

4.g: ਥਿਤਿ ਵਾਰੁ ਨਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਾਹੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ॥
4.t: thit vaar naa jogee jaanai rut maahu naa koiee ||
4.e: The day and the date are not known to the Yogis, nor is the month or the season.

4.g: ਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਿਰਠੀ ਕਉ ਸਾਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
4.t: jaa karataa siraThee kau saaje aape jaanai soiee ||
4.e: The Creator who created this creation-only He Himself knows.

4.g: ਕਿਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਾ ਕਿਵ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਵਰਨੀ ਕਿਵ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
4.t: kiv kar aakhaa kiv saalaahee kiau varanee kiv jaanaa ||
4.e: How can we speak of Him? How can we praise Him? How can we describe Him? How can we know Him?

5.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਇਕ ਦੂ ਇਕੁ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
5.t: naanak aakhan sabh ko aakhai ik dhoo ik siaanaa ||
5.e: O Nanak, everyone speaks of Him, each one wiser than the rest.

5.g: ਵਡਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਵਡੀ ਨਾਈ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
5.t: vaddaa saahib vaddee naiee keetaa jaa kaa hovai ||
5.e: Great is the Master, Great is His Name. Whatever happens is according to His Will.

5.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਪੌ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਨ ਸੋਹੈ ॥੨੧॥
5.t: naanak je ko aapau jaanai agai giaa na sohai ||21||
5.e: O Nanak, one who claims to know everything shall not be decorated in the world hereafter. ||21||
There are nether worlds beneath nether worlds, and hundreds of thousands of heavenly worlds above.

5.g: ਓੜਕ ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਿ ਥਕੇ ਵੇਦ ਕਹਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਾਤ ॥
5.t: oRak oRak bhaal thake vedh kahan ik vaat ||
5.e: The Vedas say that you can search and search for them all, until you grow weary.

5.g: ਸਹਸ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਕਹਨਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਅਸੁਲੂ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
5.t: sahas aThaareh kahan katebaa asuloo ik dhaat ||
5.e: The scriptures say that there are 18,000 worlds, but in reality, there is only One Universe.

5.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਲੇਖੈ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
5.t: lekhaa hoi ta likheeaai lekhai hoi vinaas ||
5.e: If you try to write an account of this, you will surely finish yourself before you finish writing it.

5.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੨੨॥
5.t: naanak vaddaa aakheeaai aape jaanai aap ||22||
5.e: O Nanak, call Him Great! He Himself knows Himself. ||22||

5.g: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਏਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
5.t: saalaahee saalaeh etee surat na paieeaa ||
5.e: The praisers praise the Lord, but they do not obtain intuitive understanding

5.g: ਨਦੀਆ ਅਤੈ ਵਾਹ ਪਵਹਿ ਸਮੁੰਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ॥
5.t: nadheeaa atai vaeh paveh samu(n)dh na jaane'eeh ||
5.e: the streams and rivers flowing into the ocean do not know its vastness.

5.g: ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਗਿਰਹਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ॥
5.t: samu(n)dh saeh sulataan girahaa setee maal dhan ||
5.e: Even kings and emperors, with mountains of property and oceans of wealth

5.g: ਕੀੜੀ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰਹਿ ॥੨੩॥
5.t: keeRee tul na hovanee je tis manahu na veesareh ||23||
5.e: -these are not even equal to an ant, who does not forget God. ||23||

5.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
5.t: a(n)t na sifatee kahan na a(n)t ||
5.e: Endless are His Praises, endless are those who speak them.

5.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਰਣੈ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
5.t: a(n)t na karanai dhen na a(n)t ||
5.e: Endless are His Actions, endless are His Gifts.

5.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਵੇਖਣਿ ਸੁਣਣਿ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥
5.t: a(n)t na vekhan sunan na a(n)t ||
5.e: Endless is His Vision, endless is His Hearing.

5.g: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥
5.t: a(n)t na jaapai kiaa man ma(n)t ||
5.e: His limits cannot be perceived. What is the Mystery of His Mind?
The limits of the created universe cannot be perceived.
Its limits here and beyond cannot be perceived.
Many struggle to know His limits,

5.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
5.t: taa ke a(n)t na paae jaeh ||
5.e: but His limits cannot be found.
No one can know these limits.
The more you say about them, the more there still remains to be said.
Great is the Master, High is His Heavenly Home.
Highest of the High, above all is His Name.
Only one as Great and as High as God
can know His Lofty and Exalted State.
Only He Himself is that Great. He Himself knows Himself.
O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, He bestows His Blessings. ||24||
His Blessings are so abundant that there can be no written account of them.
The Great Giver does not hold back anything.
There are so many great, heroic warriors begging at the Door of the Infinite Lord.
So many contemplate and dwell upon Him, that they cannot be counted.
So many waste away to death engaged in corruption.
So many take and take again, and then deny receiving.
So many foolish consumers keep on consuming.
So many endure distress, deprivation and constant abuse.
Even these are Your Gifts, O Great Giver!
Liberation from bondage comes only by Your Will.
No one else has any say in this.
If some fool should presume to say that he does,
he shall learn, and feel the effects of his folly.
He Himself knows, He Himself gives.
Few, very few are those who acknowledge this.
One who is blessed to sing the Praises of the Lord,
O Nanak, is the king of kings. ||25||
Priceless are His Virtues, Priceless are His Dealings.
Priceless are His Dealers, Priceless are His Treasures.
Priceless are those who come to Him, Priceless are those who buy from Him.
Priceless is Love for Him, Priceless is absorption into Him.
Priceless is the Divine Law of Dharma, Priceless is the Divine Court of Justice.
Priceless are the scales, priceless are the weights.
Priceless are His Blessings, Priceless is His Banner and Insignia.
Priceless is His Mercy, Priceless is His Royal Command.
Priceless, O Priceless beyond expression!
Speak of Him continually, and remain absorbed in His Love.
The Vedas and the Puraanas speak.
The scholars speak and lecture.
Brahma speaks, Indra speaks.

6.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਗੋਪੀ ਤੈ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ॥
6.t: aakheh gopee tai govi(n)dh ||
6.e: The Gopis and Krishna speak.

6.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਈਸਰ ਆਖਹਿ ਸਿਧ ॥
6.t: aakheh ieesar aakheh sidh ||
6.e: Shiva speaks, the Siddhas speak.

6.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਬੁਧ ॥
6.t: aakheh kete keete budh ||
6.e: The many created Buddhas speak.

6.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਦਾਨਵ ਆਖਹਿ ਦੇਵ ॥
6.t: aakheh dhaanav aakheh dhev ||
6.e: The demons speak, the demi-gods speak.

6.g: ਆਖਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵ ॥
6.t: aakheh sur nar mun jan sev ||
6.e: The spiritual warriors, the heavenly beings, the silent sages, the humble and serviceful speak.

6.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਆਖਹਿ ਆਖਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
6.t: kete aakheh aakhan paeh ||
6.e: Many speak and try to describe Him.

6.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
6.t: kete keh keh uTh uTh jaeh ||
6.e: Many have spoken of Him over and over again, and have then arisen and departed.

6.g: ਏਤੇ ਕੀਤੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥
6.t: ete keete hor kareh ||
6.e: If He were to create as many again as there already are,

6.g: ਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਕੇਈ ਕੇਇ ॥
6.t: taa aakh na sakeh keiee kei ||
6.e: even then, they could not describe Him.

6.g: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
6.t: jevadd bhaavai tevadd hoi ||
6.e: He is as Great as He wishes to be.

6.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
6.t: naanak jaanai saachaa soi ||
6.e: O Nanak, the True Lord knows.

6.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬੋਲੁਵਿਗਾੜੁ ॥
6.t: je ko aakhai boluvigaaR ||
6.e: If anyone presumes to describe God,

6.g: ਤਾ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੨੬॥
6.t: taa likheeaai sir gaavaaraa gaavaar ||26||
6.e: he shall be known as the greatest fool of fools! ||26||

6.g: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
6.t: so dhar kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||
6.e: Where is that Gate, and where is that Dwelling, in which You sit and take care of all?

6.g: ਵਾਜੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: vaaje naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete vaavanahaare ||
6.e: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, and countless musicians play on all sorts of instruments there.

6.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: kete raag paree siau kaheean kete gaavanahaare ||
6.e: So many Ragas, so many musicians singing there.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤੁਹਨੋ ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh tuhano paun paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
6.e: The praanic wind, water and fire sing; the Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh chit gupat likh jaaneh likh likh dharam veechaare ||
6.e: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who record actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who judges this record sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਰਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh ieesar baramaa dhevee sohan sadhaa savaare ||
6.e: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned, sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਇੰਦ ਇਦਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh i(n)dh idhaasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
6.e: Indra, seated upon His Throne, sings with the deities at Your Door.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan saadh vichaare ||
6.e: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing; the Saadhus sing in contemplation.

6.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaavan jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaaveh veer karaare ||
6.e: The celibates, the fanatics, the peacefully accepting and the fearless warriors sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
6.t: gaavan pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesar jug jug vedhaa naale ||
6.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਮਛ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh mohaneeaa man mohan suragaa machh piaale ||
6.e: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in this world, in paradise, and in the underworld of the subconscious sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
6.t: gaavan ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
6.e: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh jodh mahaabal sooraa gaaveh khaanee chaare ||
6.e: The brave and mighty warriors sing; the spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing.

6.g: ਗਾਵਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਵਰਭੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: gaaveh kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal varabha(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe dhaare ||
6.e: The planets, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing.

6.g: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧੁਨੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
6.t: seiee tudhuno gaaveh jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
6.e: They alone sing, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with the Nectar of Your Essence.

6.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
6.t: hor kete gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa veechaare ||
6.e: So many others sing, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I consider them all?

6.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
6.t: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
6.e: That True Lord is True, Forever True, and True is His Name.

6.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
6.t: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
6.e: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

6.g: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
6.t: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
6.e: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

6.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
6.t: kar kar vekhai keetaa aapanaa jiv tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
6.e: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

6.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
6.t: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
6.e: He does whatever He pleases. No order can be issued to Him.

6.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੭॥
6.t: so paatisaahu saahaa paatisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||27||
6.e: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||27||

6.g: ਮੁੰਦਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਰਮੁ ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ॥
6.t: mu(n)dhaa sa(n)tokh saram pat jholee dhiaan kee kareh bibhoot ||
6.e: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes you apply to your body.

6.g: ਖਿੰਥਾ ਕਾਲੁ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
6.t: khi(n)thaa kaal kuaaree kaiaa jugat dda(n)ddaa parateet ||
6.e: Let the remembrance of death be the patched coat you wear, let the purity of virginity be your way in the world, and let faith in the Lord be your walking stick.

6.g: ਆਈ ਪੰਥੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਮਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜੀਤੈ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੁ ॥
6.t: aaiee pa(n)thee sagal jamaatee man jeetai jag jeet ||
6.e: See the brotherhood of all mankind as the highest order of Yogis; conquer your own mind, and conquer the world.

6.g: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
6.t: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
6.e: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

6.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੮॥
6.t: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||28||
6.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||28||

6.g: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦਇਆ ਭੰਡਾਰਣਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਾਦ ॥
6.t: bhugat giaan dhiaa bha(n)ddaaran ghaT ghaT vaajeh naadh ||
6.e: Let spiritual wisdom be your food, and compassion your attendant. The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates in each and every heart.

6.g: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥੀ ਸਭ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਸਾਦ ॥
6.t: aap naath naathee sabh jaa kee ridh sidh avaraa saadh ||
6.e: He Himself is the Supreme Master of all; wealth and miraculous spiritual powers, and all other external tastes and pleasures, are all like beads on a string.

6.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਾਰ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਲੇਖੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਭਾਗ ॥
6.t: sa(n)jog vijog dhui kaar chalaaveh lekhe aaveh bhaag ||
6.e: Union with Him, and separation from Him, come by His Will. We come to receive what is written in our destiny.

7.g: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
7.t: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
7.e: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

7.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੨੯॥
7.t: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||29||
7.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||29||

7.g: ਏਕਾ ਮਾਈ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਿਆਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਚੇਲੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
7.t: ekaa maiee jugat viaaiee tin chele paravaan ||
7.e: The One Divine Mother conceived and gave birth to the three deities.

7.g: ਇਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਇਕੁ ਲਾਏ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
7.t: eik sa(n)saaree ik bha(n)ddaaree ik laae dheebaan ||
7.e: One, the Creator of the World; One, the Sustainer; and One, the Destroyer.

7.g: ਜਿਵ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈ ਜਿਵ ਹੋਵੈ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ॥
7.t: jiv tis bhaavai tivai chalaavai jiv hovai furamaan ||
7.e: He makes things happen according to the Pleasure of His Will. Such is His Celestial Order.

7.g: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਖੈ ਓਨਾ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੁ ॥
7.t: oh vekhai onaa nadhar na aavai bahutaa eh viddaan ||
7.e: He watches over all, but none see Him. How wonderful this is!

7.g: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
7.t: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
7.e: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

7.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੦॥
7.t: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||30||
7.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||30||

7.g: ਆਸਣੁ ਲੋਇ ਲੋਇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
7.t: aasan loi loi bha(n)ddaar ||
7.e: On world after world are His Seats of Authority and His Storehouses.

7.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰ ॥
7.t: jo kichh paiaa su ekaa vaar ||
7.e: Whatever was put into them, was put there once and for all.

7.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
7.t: kar kar vekhai sirajanahaar ||
7.e: Having created the creation, the Creator Lord watches over it.

7.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
7.t: naanak sache kee saachee kaar ||
7.e: O Nanak, True is the Creation of the True Lord.

7.g: ਆਦੇਸੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਆਦੇਸੁ ॥
7.t: aadhes tisai aadhes ||
7.e: I bow to Him, I humbly bow.

7.g: ਆਦਿ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਨਾਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਤਿ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸੁ ॥੩੧॥
7.t: aadh aneel anaadh anaahat jug jug eko ves ||31||
7.e: The Primal One, the Pure Light, without beginning, without end. Throughout all the ages, He is One and the Same. ||31||

7.g: ਇਕ ਦੂ ਜੀਭੌ ਲਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਲਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਖ ਵੀਸ ॥
7.t: eik dhoo jeebhau lakh hoh lakh hoveh lakh vees ||
7.e: If I had 100,000 tongues, and these were then multiplied twenty times more, with each tongue,

7.g: ਲਖੁ ਲਖੁ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
7.t: lakh lakh geRaa aakhe'eeh ek naam jagadhees ||
7.e: I would repeat, hundreds of thousands of times, the Name of the One, the Lord of the Universe.

7.g: ਏਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਵੜੀਆ ਚੜੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਇਕੀਸ ॥
7.t: et raeh pat pavaReeaa chaReeaai hoi ikees ||
7.e: Along this path to our Husband Lord, we climb the steps of the ladder, and come to merge with Him.

7.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਗਲਾ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਾ ਆਈ ਰੀਸ ॥
7.t: sun galaa aakaas kee keeTaa aaiee rees ||
7.e: Hearing of the etheric realms, even worms long to come back home.

7.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਠੀਸ ॥੩੨॥
7.t: naanak nadharee paieeaai kooRee kooRai Thees ||32||
7.e: O Nanak, by His Grace He is obtained. False are the boastings of the false. ||32||

7.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਚੁਪੈ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
7.t: aakhan jor chupai neh jor ||
7.e: No power to speak, no power to keep silent.

7.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਮੰਗਣਿ ਦੇਣਿ ਨ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
7.t: jor na ma(n)gan dhen na jor ||
7.e: No power to beg, no power to give.

7.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮਰਣਿ ਨਹ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
7.t: jor na jeevan maran neh jor ||
7.e: No power to live, no power to die.

7.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਰਾਜਿ ਮਾਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਸੋਰੁ ॥
7.t: jor na raaj maal man sor ||
7.e: No power to rule, with wealth and occult mental powers.

7.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
7.t: jor na suratee giaan veechaar ||
7.e: No power to gain intuitive understanding, spiritual wisdom and meditation.

7.g: ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਛੁਟੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
7.t: jor na jugatee chhuTai sa(n)saar ||
7.e: No power to find the way to escape from the world.

7.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
7.t: jis hath jor kar vekhai soi ||
7.e: He alone has the Power in His Hands. He watches over all.

7.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤਮੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩੩॥
7.t: naanak utam neech na koi ||33||
7.e: O Nanak, no one is high or low. ||33||

7.g: ਰਾਤੀ ਰੁਤੀ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
7.t: raatee rutee thitee vaar ||
7.e: Nights, days, weeks and seasons;

7.g: ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਤਾਲ ॥
7.t: pavan paanee aganee paataal ||
7.e: wind, water, fire and the nether regions

7.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਥਾਪਿ ਰਖੀ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ॥
7.t: tis vich dharatee thaap rakhee dharam saal ||
7.e: in the midst of these, He established the earth as a home for Dharma.

7.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
7.t: tis vich jeea jugat ke ra(n)g ||
7.e: Upon it, He placed the various species of beings.

7.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
7.t: tin ke naam anek ana(n)t ||
7.e: Their names are uncounted and endless.

7.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
7.t: karamee karamee hoi veechaar ||
7.e: By their deeds and their actions, they shall be judged.

7.g: ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਚਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
7.t: sachaa aap sachaa dharabaar ||
7.e: God Himself is True, and True is His Court.

7.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
7.t: tithai sohan pa(n)ch paravaan ||
7.e: There, in perfect grace and ease, sit the self-elect, the self-realized Saints.

7.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
7.t: nadharee karam pavai neesaan ||
7.e: They receive the Mark of Grace from the Merciful Lord.

7.g: ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਓਥੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
7.t: kach pakaiee othai pai ||
7.e: The ripe and the unripe, the good and the bad, shall there be judged.

7.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਪੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੪॥
7.t: naanak giaa jaapai jai ||34||
7.e: O Nanak, when you go home, you will see this. ||34||

7.g: ਧਰਮ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਏਹੋ ਧਰਮੁ ॥
7.t: dharam kha(n)dd kaa eho dharam ||
7.e: This is righteous living in the realm of Dharma.

7.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਕਾ ਆਖਹੁ ਕਰਮੁ ॥
7.t: giaan kha(n)dd kaa aakhahu karam ||
7.e: And now we speak of the realm of spiritual wisdom.

7.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਵੈਸੰਤਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕਾਨ ਮਹੇਸ ॥
7.t: kete pavan paanee vaisa(n)tar kete kaan mahes ||
7.e: So many winds, waters and fires; so many Krishnas and Shivas.

7.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਬਰਮੇ ਘਾੜਤਿ ਘੜੀਅਹਿ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇ ਵੇਸ ॥
7.t: kete barame ghaaRat ghaRe'eh roop ra(n)g ke ves ||
7.e: So many Brahmas, fashioning forms of great beauty, adorned and dressed in many colors.

7.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮੀ ਮੇਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਧੂ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
7.t: keteeaa karam bhoomee mer kete kete dhoo upadhes ||
7.e: So many worlds and lands for working out karma. So very many lessons to be learned!

7.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਇੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਡਲ ਦੇਸ ॥
7.t: kete i(n)dh cha(n)dh soor kete kete ma(n)ddal dhes ||
7.e: So many Indras, so many moons and suns, so many worlds and lands.

7.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਾਥ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਵੇਸ ॥
7.t: kete sidh budh naath kete kete dhevee ves ||
7.e: So many Siddhas and Buddhas, so many Yogic masters. So many goddesses of various kinds.

7.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਮੁਨਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ ॥
7.t: kete dhev dhaanav mun kete kete ratan samu(n)dh ||
7.e: So many demi-gods and demons, so many silent sages. So many oceans of jewels.

7.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਖਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਬਾਣੀ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਤ ਨਰਿੰਦ ॥
7.t: keteeaa khaanee keteeaa baanee kete paat nari(n)dh ||
7.e: So many ways of life, so many languages. So many dynasties of rulers.

7.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੩੫॥
7.t: keteeaa suratee sevak kete naanak a(n)t na a(n)t ||35||
7.e: So many intuitive people, so many selfless servants. O Nanak, His limit has no limit! ||35||

7.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਖੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪਰਚੰਡੁ ॥
7.t: giaan kha(n)dd meh giaan paracha(n)dd ||
7.e: In the realm of wisdom, spiritual wisdom reigns supreme.

7.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਕੋਡ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
7.t: tithai naadh binodh kodd ana(n)dh ||
7.e: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there, amidst the sounds and the sights of bliss.

8.e: In the realm of humility, the Word is Beauty.
Forms of incomparable beauty are fashioned there.

8.g: ਤਾ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਕਥੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
8.t: taa keeaa galaa katheeaa naa jaeh ||
8.e: These things cannot be described.
One who tries to speak of these shall regret the attempt.

8.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਬੁਧਿ ॥
8.t: tithai ghaReeaai surat mat man budh ||
8.e: The intuitive consciousness, intellect and understanding of the mind are shaped there.

8.g: ਤਿਥੈ ਘੜੀਐ ਸੁਰਾ ਸਿਧਾ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ ॥੩੬॥
8.t: tithai ghaReeaai suraa sidhaa kee sudh ||36||
8.e: The consciousness of the spiritual warriors and the Siddhas, the beings of spiritual perfection, are shaped there. ||36||
In the realm of karma, the Word is Power.
No one else dwells there,
except the warriors of great power, the spiritual heroes.
They are totally fulfilled, imbued with the Lord's Essence.
Myriads of Sitas are there, cool and calm in their majestic glory.

8.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਕਥਨੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
8.t: taa ke roop na kathane jaeh ||
8.e: Their beauty cannot be described.

8.g: ਨਾ ਓਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਨ ਠਾਗੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
8.t: naa oh mareh na Thaage jaeh ||
8.e: Neither death nor deception comes to those,

8.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
8.t: jin kai raam vasai man maeh ||
8.e: within whose minds the Lord abides.
The devotees of many worlds dwell there.
They celebrate; their minds are imbued with the True Lord.
In the realm of Truth, the Formless Lord abides.
Having created the creation, He watches over it. By His Glance of Grace, He bestows happiness.
There are planets, solar systems and galaxies.

8.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਥੈ ਤ ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤ ॥
8.t: je ko kathai ta a(n)t na a(n)t ||
8.e: If one speaks of them, there is no limit, no end.
There are worlds upon worlds of His Creation.

8.g: ਜਿਵ ਜਿਵ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਵ ਕਾਰ ॥
8.t: jiv jiv hukam tivai tiv kaar ||
8.e: As He commands, so they exist.
He watches over all, and contemplating the creation, He rejoices.
O Nanak, to describe this is as hard as steel! ||37||
Let self-control be the furnace, and patience the goldsmith.
Let understanding be the anvil, and spiritual wisdom the tools.
With the Fear of God as the bellows, fan the flames of tapa, the body's inner heat.
In the crucible of love, melt the Nectar of the Name,
and mint the True Coin of the Shabad, the Word of God.

8.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਰ ॥
8.t: jin kau nadhar karam tin kaar ||
8.e: Such is the karma of those upon whom He has cast His Glance of Grace.
O Nanak, the Merciful Lord, by His Grace, uplifts and exalts them. ||38||
Shalok:

8.g: ਪਵਣੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਮਹਤੁ ॥
8.t: pavan guroo paanee pitaa maataa dharat mahat ||
8.e: Air is the Guru, Water is the Father, and Earth is the Great Mother of all.

8.g: ਦਿਵਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਖੇਲੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ॥
8.t: dhivas raat dhui dhaiee dhaiaa khelai sagal jagat ||
8.e: Day and night are each like the nanny and her caregiving husband, in whose lap the whole world is at play.
Good deeds and bad deeds-the record is read out in the Presence of the Lord of Dharma.

8.g: ਕਰਮੀ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣੀ ਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
8.t: karamee aapo aapanee ke neRai ke dhoor ||
8.e: According to their own actions, some are drawn closer, and some are driven farther away.

8.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗਏ ਮਸਕਤਿ ਘਾਲਿ ॥
8.t: jinee naam dhiaaiaa ge masakat ghaal ||
8.e: Those who have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and departed after having worked by the sweat of their brows

8.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਕੇਤੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
8.t: naanak te mukh ujale ketee chhuTee naal ||1||
8.e: -O Nanak, their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord, and many are saved along with them! ||1||

8.t: so dhar raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa
8.e: So Dar ~ That Door. Raag Aasaa, First Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

8.g: ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਹਾ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਬਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
8.t: so dhar teraa kehaa so ghar kehaa jit beh sarab samaale ||
8.e: Where is That Door of Yours, and where is That Home, in which You sit and take care of all?

8.g: ਵਾਜੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਸੰਖਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਵਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
8.t: vaaje tere naadh anek asa(n)khaa kete tere vaavanahaare ||
8.e: The Sound-current of the Naad vibrates there for You, and countless musicians play all sorts of instruments there for You.

8.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
8.t: kete tere raag paree siau kahe'eeh kete tere gaavanahaare ||
8.e: There are so many Ragas and musical harmonies to You; so many minstrels sing hymns of You.

8.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਾਜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥
8.t: gaavan tudhano pavan paanee baisa(n)tar gaavai raajaa dharam dhuaare ||
8.e: Wind, water and fire sing of You. The Righteous Judge of Dharma sings at Your Door.

8.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
8.t: gaavan tudhano chit gupat likh jaanan likh likh dharam beechaare ||
8.e: Chitr and Gupt, the angels of the conscious and the subconscious who keep the record of actions, and the Righteous Judge of Dharma who reads this record, sing of You.

8.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਈਸਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
8.t: gaavan tudhano ieesar brahamaa dhevee sohan tere sadhaa savaare ||
8.e: Shiva, Brahma and the Goddess of Beauty, ever adorned by You, sing of You.

8.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਬੈਠੇ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
8.t: gaavan tudhano i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan baiThe dhevatiaa dhar naale ||
8.e: Indra, seated on His Throne, sings of You, with the deities at Your Door.

8.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਾਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
8.t: gaavan tudhano sidh samaadhee a(n)dhar gaavan tudhano saadh beechaare ||
8.e: The Siddhas in Samaadhi sing of You; the Saadhus sing of You in contemplation.

9.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਵੀਰ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
9.t: gaavan tudhano jatee satee sa(n)tokhee gaavan tudhano veer karaare ||
9.e: The celibates, the fanatics, and the peacefully accepting sing of You; the fearless warriors sing of You.

9.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਨਿ ਰਖੀਸੁਰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਵੇਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
9.t: gaavan tudhano pa(n)ddit paRan rakheesur jug jug vedhaa naale ||
9.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars who recite the Vedas, with the supreme sages of all the ages, sing of You.

9.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੋਹਣੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਸੁਰਗੁ ਮਛੁ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
9.t: gaavan tudhano mohaneeaa man mohan surag machh piaale ||
9.e: The Mohinis, the enchanting heavenly beauties who entice hearts in paradise, in this world, and in the underworld of the subconscious, sing of You.

9.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਰਤਨ ਉਪਾਏ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
9.t: gaavan tudhano ratan upaae tere aThasaTh teerath naale ||
9.e: The celestial jewels created by You, and the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, sing of You.

9.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਜੋਧ ਮਹਾਬਲ ਸੂਰਾ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖਾਣੀ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
9.t: gaavan tudhano jodh mahaabal sooraa gaavan tudhano khaanee chaare ||
9.e: The brave and mighty warriors sing of You. The spiritual heroes and the four sources of creation sing of You.

9.g: ਗਾਵਨਿ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
9.t: gaavan tudhano kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal brahama(n)ddaa kar kar rakhe tere dhaare ||
9.e: The worlds, solar systems and galaxies, created and arranged by Your Hand, sing of You.

9.g: ਸੇਈ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਨਿ ਰਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥
9.t: seiee tudhano gaavan jo tudh bhaavan rate tere bhagat rasaale ||
9.e: They alone sing of You, who are pleasing to Your Will. Your devotees are imbued with Your Sublime Essence.

9.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਗਾਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਮੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਨਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
9.t: hor kete tudhano gaavan se mai chit na aavan naanak kiaa beechaare ||
9.e: So many others sing of You, they do not come to mind. O Nanak, how can I think of them all?

9.g: ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥
9.t: soiee soiee sadhaa sach saahib saachaa saachee naiee ||
9.e: That True Lord is True, forever True, and True is His Name.

9.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
9.t: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee rachanaa jin rachaiee ||
9.e: He is, and shall always be. He shall not depart, even when this Universe which He has created departs.

9.g: ਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਭਾਤੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
9.t: ra(n)gee ra(n)gee bhaatee kar kar jinasee maiaa jin upaiee ||
9.e: He created the world, with its various colors, species of beings, and the variety of Maya.

9.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
9.t: kar kar dhekhai keetaa aapanaa jiau tis dhee vaddiaaiee ||
9.e: Having created the creation, He watches over it Himself, by His Greatness.

9.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
9.t: jo tis bhaavai soiee karasee fir hukam na karanaa jaiee ||
9.e: He does whatever He pleases. No one can issue any order to Him.

9.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਹਣੁ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
9.t: so paatisaahu saahaa patisaahib naanak rahan rajaiee ||1||
9.e: He is the King, the King of kings, the Supreme Lord and Master of kings. Nanak remains subject to His Will. ||1||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Hearing of His Greatness, everyone calls Him Great.
But just how Great His Greatness is-this is known only to those who have seen Him.
His Value cannot be estimated; He cannot be described.
Those who describe You, Lord, remain immersed and absorbed in You. ||1||

9.g: ਵਡੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥
9.t: vadde mere saahibaa gahir ga(n)bheeraa gunee gaheeraa ||
9.e: O my Great Lord and Master of Unfathomable Depth, You are the Ocean of Excellence.

9.g: ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਤਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਚੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
9.t: koi na jaanai teraa ketaa kevadd cheeraa ||1|| rahaau ||
9.e: No one knows the extent or the vastness of Your Expanse. ||1||Pause||
All the intuitives met and practiced intuitive meditation.
All the appraisers met and made the appraisal.
The spiritual teachers, the teachers of meditation, and the teachers of teachers

9.g: ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
9.t: kahan na jaiee teree til vaddiaaiee ||2||
9.e: -they cannot describe even an iota of Your Greatness. ||2||

9.g: ਸਭਿ ਸਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਪ ਸਭਿ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥
9.t: sabh sat sabh tap sabh cha(n)giaaieeaa ||
9.e: All Truth, all austere discipline, all goodness,
all the great miraculous spiritual powers of the Siddhas

9.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
9.t: tudh vin sidhee kinai na paieeaa ||
9.e: without You, no one has attained such powers.
They are received only by Your Grace. No one can block them or stop their flow. ||3||
What can the poor helpless creatures do?
Your Praises are overflowing with Your Treasures.

9.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
9.t: jis too dheh tisai kiaa chaaraa ||
9.e: Those, unto whom You give-how can they think of any other?
O Nanak, the True One embellishes and exalts. ||4||2||
Aasaa, First Mehla:
Chanting it, I live; forgetting it, I die.
It is so difficult to chant the True Name.
If someone feels hunger for the True Name,
that hunger shall consume his pain. ||1||
How can I forget Him, O my mother?
True is the Master, True is His Name. ||1||Pause||
Trying to describe even an iota of the Greatness of the True Name,
people have grown weary, but they have not been able to evaluate it.

9.g: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਆਖਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
9.t: je sabh mil kai aakhan paeh ||
9.e: Even if everyone were to gather together and speak of Him,

9.g: ਵਡਾ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
9.t: vaddaa na hovai ghaaT na jai ||2||
9.e: He would not become any greater or any lesser. ||2||

9.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
9.t: naa oh marai na hovai sog ||
9.e: That Lord does not die; there is no reason to mourn.
He continues to give, and His Provisions never run short.
This Virtue is His alone; there is no other like Him.

9.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਆ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
9.t: naa ko hoaa naa ko hoi ||3||
9.e: There never has been, and there never will be. ||3||
As Great as You Yourself are, O Lord, so Great are Your Gifts.

10.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਕੀਤੀ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
10.t: jin dhin kar kai keetee raat ||
10.e: The One who created the day also created the night.

10.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਹਿ ਤੇ ਕਮਜਾਤਿ ॥
10.t: khasam visaareh te kamajaat ||
10.e: Those who forget their Lord and Master are vile and despicable.

10.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਝੁ ਸਨਾਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
10.t: naanak naavai baajh sanaat ||4||3||
10.e: O Nanak, without the Name, they are wretched outcasts. ||4||3||

10.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
10.t: raag goojaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
10.e: Raag Goojaree, Fourth Mehla:

10.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਪੁਰਖਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
10.t: har ke jan satigur satapurakhaa binau karau gur paas ||
10.e: O humble servant of the Lord, O True Guru, O True Primal Being: I offer my humble prayer to You, O Guru.

10.g: ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
10.t: ham keere kiram satigur saranaiee kar dhiaa naam paragaas ||1||
10.e: I am a mere insect, a worm. O True Guru, I seek Your Sanctuary. Please be merciful, and bless me with the Light of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

10.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
10.t: mere meet gurdhev mo kau raam naam paragaas ||
10.e: O my Best Friend, O Divine Guru, please enlighten me with the Name of the Lord.

10.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
10.t: gurmat naam meraa praan sakhaiee har keerat hamaree raharaas ||1|| rahaau ||
10.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Naam is my breath of life. The Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is my life's occupation. ||1||Pause||

10.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
10.t: har jan ke vadd bhaag vaddere jin har har saradhaa har piaas ||
10.e: The servants of the Lord have the greatest good fortune; they have faith in the Lord, and a longing for the Lord.

10.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
10.t: har har naam milai tirapataaseh mil sa(n)gat gun paragaas ||2||
10.e: Obtaining the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, they are satisfied; joining the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation, their virtues shine forth. ||2||

10.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਜਮ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
10.t: jin har har har ras naam na paiaa te bhaagaheen jam paas ||
10.e: Those who have not obtained the Sublime Essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are most unfortunate; they are led away by the Messenger of Death.

10.g: ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਏ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
10.t: jo satigur saran sa(n)gat nahee aae dhirag jeeve dhirag jeevaas ||3||
10.e: Those who have not sought the Sanctuary of the True Guru and the Sangat, the Holy Congregation-cursed are their lives, and cursed are their hopes of life. ||3||

10.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲਿਖਾਸਿ ॥
10.t: jin har jan satigur sa(n)gat paiee tin dhur masatak likhiaa likhaas ||
10.e: Those humble servants of the Lord who have attained the Company of the True Guru, have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed on their foreheads.

10.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
10.t: dhan dha(n)n satasa(n)gat jit har ras paiaa mil jan naanak naam paragaas ||4||4||
10.e: Blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Lord's Essence is obtained. Meeting with His humble servant, O Nanak, the Light of the Naam shines forth. ||4||4||

10.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
10.t: raag goojaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
10.e: Raag Goojaree, Fifth Mehla:

10.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਜਾ ਆਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
10.t: kaahe re man chitaveh udham jaa aahar har jeeau pariaa ||
10.e: Why, O mind, do you plot and plan, when the Dear Lord Himself provides for your care?

10.g: ਸੈਲ ਪਥਰ ਮਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
10.t: sail pathar meh ja(n)t upaae taa kaa rijak aagai kar dhariaa ||1||
10.e: From rocks and stones He created living beings; He places their nourishment before them. ||1||

10.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥
10.t: mere maadhau jee satasa(n)gat mile su tariaa ||
10.e: O my Dear Lord of souls, one who joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is saved.

10.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੂਕੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਹਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
10.t: gur parasaadh param padh paiaa sooke kaasaT hariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
10.e: By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained, and the dry wood blossoms forth again in lush greenery. ||1||Pause||

10.g: ਜਨਨਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
10.t: janan pitaa lok sut banitaa koi na kis kee dhariaa ||
10.e: Mothers, fathers, friends, children and spouses-no one is the support of anyone else.

10.g: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਮਨ ਭਉ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
10.t: sir sir rijak sa(n)baahe Thaakur kaahe man bhau kariaa ||2||
10.e: For each and every person, our Lord and Master provides sustenance. Why are you so afraid, O mind? ||2||

10.g: ਊਡੇ ਊਡਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੈ ਕੋਸਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਬਚਰੇ ਛਰਿਆ ॥
10.t: uoodde uoodd aavai sai kosaa tis paachhai bachare chhariaa ||
10.e: The flamingoes fly hundreds of miles, leaving their young ones behind.

10.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਵਣੁ ਖਲਾਵੈ ਕਵਣੁ ਚੁਗਾਵੈ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
10.t: tin kavan khalaavai kavan chugaavai man meh simaran kariaa ||3||
10.e: Who feeds them, and who teaches them to feed themselves? Have you ever thought of this in your mind? ||3||

10.g: ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਾਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
10.t: sabh nidhaan dhas asaT sidhaan Thaakur kar tal dhariaa ||
10.e: All the nine treasures, and the eighteen supernatural powers are held by our Lord and Master in the Palm of His Hand.

10.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
10.t: jan naanak bal bal sadh bal jaieeaai teraa a(n)t na paaraavariaa ||4||5||
10.e: Servant Nanak is devoted, dedicated, forever a sacrifice to You, Lord. Your Expanse has no limit, no boundary. ||4||5||

10.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ
10.t: raag aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa so purakhu
10.e: Raag Aasaa, Fourth Mehla, So Purakh ~ That Primal Being:

10.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
10.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
10.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

10.g: ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
10.t: so purakh nira(n)jan har purakh nira(n)jan har agamaa agam apaaraa ||
10.e: That Primal Being is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord, the Primal Being, is Immaculate and Pure. The Lord is Inaccessible, Unreachable and Unrivalled.

10.g: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
10.t: sabh dhiaaveh sabh dhiaaveh tudh jee har sache sirajanahaaraa ||
10.e: All meditate, all meditate on You, Dear Lord, O True Creator Lord.

10.g: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
10.t: sabh jeea tumaare jee too(n) jeeaa kaa dhaataaraa ||
10.e: All living beings are Yours-You are the Giver of all souls.

10.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
10.t: har dhiaavahu sa(n)tahu jee sabh dhookh visaaranahaaraa ||
10.e: Meditate on the Lord, O Saints; He is the Dispeller of all sorrow.

10.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੀ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
10.t: har aape Thaakur har aape sevak jee kiaa naanak ja(n)t vichaaraa ||1||
10.e: The Lord Himself is the Master, the Lord Himself is the Servant. O Nanak, the poor beings are wretched and miserable! ||1||

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
11.t: too(n) ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar jee har eko purakh samaanaa ||
11.e: You are constant in each and every heart, and in all things. O Dear Lord, you are the One.

11.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥
11.t: eik dhaate ik bhekhaaree jee sabh tere choj viddaanaa ||
11.e: Some are givers, and some are beggars. This is all Your Wondrous Play.

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਜੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
11.t: too(n) aape dhaataa aape bhugataa jee hau tudh bin avar na jaanaa ||
11.e: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. I know no other than You.

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
11.t: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t bea(n)t jee tere kiaa gun aakh vakhaanaa ||
11.e: You are the Supreme Lord God, Limitless and Infinite. What Virtues of Yours can I speak of and describe?

11.g: ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਜੋ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥੨॥
11.t: jo seveh jo seveh tudh jee jan naanak tin kurabaanaa ||2||
11.e: Unto those who serve You, unto those who serve You, Dear Lord, servant Nanak is a sacrifice. ||2||

11.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ॥
11.t: har dhiaaveh har dhiaaveh tudh jee se jan jug meh sukhavaasee ||
11.e: Those who meditate on You, Lord, those who meditate on You-those humble beings dwell in peace in this world.

11.g: ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਭਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਤੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
11.t: se mukat se mukat bhe jin har dhiaaiaa jee tin tooTee jam kee faasee ||
11.e: They are liberated, they are liberated-those who meditate on the Lord. For them, the noose of death is cut away.

11.g: ਜਿਨ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਸਭੁ ਗਵਾਸੀ ॥
11.t: jin nirabhau jin har nirabhau dhiaaiaa jee tin kaa bhau sabh gavaasee ||
11.e: Those who meditate on the Fearless One, on the Fearless Lord-all their fears are dispelled.

11.g: ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਸਮਾਸੀ ॥
11.t: jin seviaa jin seviaa meraa har jee te har har roop samaasee ||
11.e: Those who serve, those who serve my Dear Lord, are absorbed into the Being of the Lord, Har, Har.

11.g: ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
11.t: se dha(n)n se dha(n)n jin har dhiaaiaa jee jan naanak tin bal jaasee ||3||
11.e: Blessed are they, blessed are they, who meditate on their Dear Lord. Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||3||

11.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਜੀ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
11.t: teree bhagat teree bhagat bha(n)ddaar jee bhare bia(n)t bea(n)taa ||
11.e: Devotion to You, devotion to You, is a treasure overflowing, infinite and beyond measure.

11.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਅਨੰਤਾ ॥
11.t: tere bhagat tere bhagat salaahan tudh jee har anik anek ana(n)taa ||
11.e: Your devotees, Your devotees praise You, Dear Lord, in many and various and countless ways.

11.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੀ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਹਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ ॥
11.t: teree anik teree anik kareh har poojaa jee tap taapeh japeh bea(n)taa ||
11.e: For You, many, for You, so very many perform worship services, O Dear Infinite Lord; they practice disciplined meditation and chant endlessly.

11.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਤੇਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਪੜਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੰਤਾ ॥
11.t: tere anek tere anek paReh bahu simirat saasat jee kar kiriaa khaT karam kara(n)taa ||
11.e: For You, many, for You, so very many read the various Simritees and Shaastras. They perform rituals and religious rites.

11.g: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਭਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ॥੪॥
11.t: se bhagat se bhagat bhale jan naanak jee jo bhaaveh mere har bhagava(n)taa ||4||
11.e: Those devotees, those devotees are sublime, O servant Nanak, who are pleasing to my Dear Lord God. ||4||

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
11.t: too(n) aadh purakh apara(n)par karataa jee tudh jevadd avar na koiee ||
11.e: You are the Primal Being, the Most Wonderful Creator. There is no other as Great as You.

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਏਕੋ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
11.t: too(n) jug jug eko sadhaa sadhaa too(n) eko jee too(n) nihachal karataa soiee ||
11.e: Age after age, You are the One. Forever and ever, You are the One. You never change, O Creator Lord.

11.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
11.t: tudh aape bhaavai soiee varatai jee too(n) aape kareh su hoiee ||
11.e: Everything happens according to Your Will. You Yourself accomplish all that occurs.

11.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਭ ਗੋਈ ॥
11.t: tudh aape sirasaT sabh upaiee jee tudh aape siraj sabh goiee ||
11.e: You Yourself created the entire universe, and having fashioned it, You Yourself shall destroy it all.

11.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਜੀ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਕਾ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੫॥੧॥
11.t: jan naanak gun gaavai karate ke jee jo sabhasai kaa jaanoiee ||5||1||
11.e: Servant Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Dear Creator, the Knower of all. ||5||1||

11.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
11.t: aasaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
11.e: Aasaa, Fourth Mehla:

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਮੈਡਾ ਸਾਂਈ ॥
11.t: too(n) karataa sachiaar maiddaa saa(n)iee ||
11.e: You are the True Creator, my Lord and Master.

11.g: ਜੋ ਤਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਥੀਸੀ ਜੋ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
11.t: jo tau bhaavai soiee theesee jo too(n) dheh soiee hau paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
11.e: Whatever pleases You comes to pass. As You give, so do we receive. ||1||Pause||

11.g: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
11.t: sabh teree too(n) sabhanee dhiaaiaa ||
11.e: All belong to You, all meditate on you.

11.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
11.t: jis no kirapaa kareh tin naam ratan paiaa ||
11.e: Those who are blessed with Your Mercy obtain the Jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

11.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਧਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
11.t: gurmukh laadhaa manmukh gavaiaa ||
11.e: The Gurmukhs obtain it, and the self-willed manmukhs lose it.

11.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
11.t: tudh aap vichhoRiaa aap milaiaa ||1||
11.e: You Yourself separate them from Yourself, and You Yourself reunite with them again. ||1||

11.g: ਤੂੰ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਭ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
11.t: too(n) dhareeaau sabh tujh hee maeh ||
11.e: You are the River of Life; all are within You.

11.g: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
11.t: tujh bin dhoojaa koiee naeh ||
11.e: There is no one except You.

11.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
11.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh teraa khel ||
11.e: All living beings are Your playthings.

11.g: ਵਿਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੨॥
11.t: vijog mil vichhuRiaa sa(n)jogee mel ||2||
11.e: The separated ones meet, and by great good fortune, those suffering in separation are reunited once again. ||2||

11.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਜਾਣਾਇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
11.t: jis no too jaanaieh soiee jan jaanai ||
11.e: They alone understand, whom You inspire to understand;

11.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
11.t: har gun sadh hee aakh vakhaanai ||
11.e: they continually chant and repeat the Lord's Praises.

11.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
11.t: jin har seviaa tin sukh paiaa ||
11.e: Those who serve You find peace.

11.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
11.t: sahaje hee har naam samaiaa ||3||
11.e: They are intuitively absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||3||

12.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
12.t: too aape karataa teraa keeaa sabh hoi ||
12.e: You Yourself are the Creator. Everything that happens is by Your Doing.

12.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
12.t: tudh bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
12.e: There is no one except You.

12.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
12.t: too kar kar vekheh jaaneh soi ||
12.e: You created the creation; You behold it and understand it.

12.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
12.t: jan naanak gurmukh paragaT hoi ||4||2||
12.e: O servant Nanak, the Lord is revealed through the Gurmukh, the Living Expression of the Guru's Word. ||4||2||

12.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
12.t: aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
12.e: Aasaa, First Mehla:

12.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
12.t: tit saravaraRai bhieele nivaasaa paanee paavak tineh keeaa ||
12.e: In that pool, people have made their homes, but the water there is as hot as fire!

12.g: ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
12.t: pa(n)kaj moh pag nahee chaalai ham dhekhaa teh ddoobeeale ||1||
12.e: In the swamp of emotional attachment, their feet cannot move. I have seen them drowning there. ||1||

12.g: ਮਨ ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
12.t: man ek na chetas mooR manaa ||
12.e: In your mind, you do not remember the One Lord-you fool!

12.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
12.t: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
12.e: You have forgotten the Lord; your virtues shall wither away. ||1||Pause||

12.g: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
12.t: naa hau jatee satee nahee paRiaa moorakh mugadhaa janam bhiaa ||
12.e: I am not celibate, nor truthful, nor scholarly. I was born foolish and ignorant into this world.

12.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੩॥
12.t: pranavat naanak tin kee saranaa jin too naahee veesariaa ||2||3||
12.e: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who have not forgotten You, O Lord! ||2||3||

12.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
12.t: aasaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
12.e: Aasaa, Fifth Mehla:

12.g: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹੁਰੀਆ ॥
12.t: bhiee paraapat maanukh dhehureeaa ||
12.e: This human body has been given to you.

12.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
12.t: gobi(n)dh milan kee ieh teree bareeaa ||
12.e: This is your chance to meet the Lord of the Universe.

12.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਜ ਤੇਰੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਕਾਮ ॥
12.t: avar kaaj terai kitai na kaam ||
12.e: Nothing else will work.

12.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮ ॥੧॥
12.t: mil saadhasa(n)gat bhaj keval naam ||1||
12.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; vibrate and meditate on the Jewel of the Naam. ||1||

12.g: ਸਰੰਜਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਰਨ ਕੈ ॥
12.t: sara(n)jaam laag bhavajal taran kai ||
12.e: Make every effort to cross over this terrifying world-ocean.

12.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
12.t: janam birathaa jaat ra(n)g maiaa kai ||1|| rahaau ||
12.e: You are squandering this life uselessly in the love of Maya. ||1||Pause||

12.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
12.t: jap tap sa(n)jam dharam na kamaiaa ||
12.e: I have not practiced meditation, self-discipline, self-restraint or righteous living.

12.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
12.t: sevaa saadh na jaaniaa har raiaa ||
12.e: I have not served the Holy; I have not acknowledged the Lord, my King.

12.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥
12.t: kahu naanak ham neech kara(n)maa ||
12.e: Says Nanak, my actions are contemptible!

12.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਰਮਾ ॥੨॥੪॥
12.t: saran pare kee raakhahu saramaa ||2||4||
12.e: O Lord, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, preserve my honor! ||2||4||

12.g: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧
12.t: sohilaa raag gauRee dheepakee mahalaa pehilaa
12.e: Sohilaa ~ The Song Of Praise. Raag Gauree Deepakee, First Mehla:

12.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
12.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
12.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

12.g: ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
12.t: jai ghar keerat aakheeaai karate kaa hoi beechaaro ||
12.e: In that house where the Praises of the Creator are chanted and contemplated

12.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸਿਵਰਿਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
12.t: tit ghar gaavahu sohilaa sivarih sirajanahaaro ||1||
12.e: -in that house, sing Songs of Praise; meditate and remember the Creator Lord. ||1||

12.g: ਤੁਮ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ॥
12.t: tum gaavahu mere nirabhau kaa sohilaa ||
12.e: Sing the Songs of Praise of my Fearless Lord.

12.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੋਹਿਲੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
12.t: hau vaaree jit sohilai sadhaa sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
12.e: I am a sacrifice to that Song of Praise which brings eternal peace. ||1||Pause||

12.g: ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਦੇਖੈਗਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
12.t: nit nit jeeaRe samaaleean dhekhaigaa dhevanahaar ||
12.e: Day after day, He cares for His beings; the Great Giver watches over all.

12.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
12.t: tere dhaanai keemat naa pavai tis dhaate kavan sumaar ||2||
12.e: Your Gifts cannot be appraised; how can anyone compare to the Giver? ||2||

12.g: ਸੰਬਤਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
12.t: sa(n)bat saahaa likhiaa mil kar paavahu tel ||
12.e: The day of my wedding is pre-ordained. Come, gather together and pour the oil over the threshold.

12.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਸਜਣ ਅਸੀਸੜੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੩॥
12.t: dheh sajan aseesaReeaa jiau hovai saahib siau mel ||3||
12.e: My friends, give me your blessings, that I may merge with my Lord and Master. ||3||

12.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਏਹੋ ਪਾਹੁਚਾ ਸਦੜੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥
12.t: ghar ghar eho paahuchaa sadhaRe nit pava(n)n ||
12.e: Unto each and every home, into each and every heart, this summons is sent out; the call comes each and every day.

12.g: ਸਦਣਹਾਰਾ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਿਹ ਆਵੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੧॥
12.t: sadhanahaaraa simareeaai naanak se dheh aava(n)n ||4||1||
12.e: Remember in meditation the One who summons us; O Nanak, that day is drawing near! ||4||1||

12.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
12.t: raag aasaa mahalaa pehilaa ||
12.e: Raag Aasaa, First Mehla:

12.g: ਛਿਅ ਘਰ ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
12.t: chhia ghar chhia gur chhia upadhes ||
12.e: There are six schools of philosophy, six teachers, and six sets of teachings.

12.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਸ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥
12.t: gur gur eko ves anek ||1||
12.e: But the Teacher of teachers is the One, who appears in so many forms. ||1||

12.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
12.t: baabaa jai ghar karate keerat hoi ||
12.e: O Baba: that system in which the Praises of the Creator are sung

12.g: ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
12.t: so ghar raakh vaddaiee toi ||1|| rahaau ||
12.e: -follow that system; in it rests true greatness. ||1||Pause||

12.g: ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
12.t: visue chasiaa ghaReeaa paharaa thitee vaaree maahu hoaa ||
12.e: The seconds, minutes and hours, days, weeks and months,

12.g: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਏਕੋ ਰੁਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
12.t: sooraj eko rut anek ||
12.e: and the various seasons originate from the one sun;

13.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਵੇਸ ॥੨॥੨॥
13.t: naanak karate ke kete ves ||2||2||
13.e: O Nanak, in just the same way, the many forms originate from the Creator. ||2||2||

13.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
13.t: raag dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
13.e: Raag Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

13.g: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
13.t: gagan mai thaal rav cha(n)dh dheepak bane taarikaa ma(n)ddal janak motee ||
13.e: Upon that cosmic plate of the sky, the sun and the moon are the lamps. The stars and their orbs are the studded pearls.

13.g: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
13.t: dhoop malaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banarai foola(n)t jotee ||1||
13.e: The fragrance of sandalwood in the air is the temple incense, and the wind is the fan. All the plants of the world are the altar flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

13.g: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
13.t: kaisee aaratee hoi || bhav kha(n)ddanaa teree aaratee ||
13.e: What a beautiful Aartee, lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of Fear, this is Your Ceremony of Light.

13.g: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
13.t: anahataa sabadh vaaja(n)t bheree ||1|| rahaau ||
13.e: The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad is the vibration of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

13.g: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹਹਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋੁਹੀ ॥
13.t: sahas tav nain nan nain heh toh kau sahas moorat nanaa ek tuohee ||
13.e: You have thousands of eyes, and yet You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms, and yet You do not have even one.

13.g: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
13.t: sahas padh bimal nan ek padh ga(n)dh bin sahas tav ga(n)dh iv chalat mohee ||2||
13.e: You have thousands of Lotus Feet, and yet You do not have even one foot. You have no nose, but you have thousands of noses. This Play of Yours entrances me. ||2||

13.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
13.t: sabh meh jot jot hai soi ||
13.e: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.

13.g: ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
13.t: tis dhai chaanan sabh meh chaanan hoi ||
13.e: By this Illumination, that Light is radiant within all.

13.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
13.t: gur saakhee jot paragaT hoi ||
13.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Light shines forth.

13.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
13.t: jo tis bhaavai su aaratee hoi ||3||
13.e: That which is pleasing to Him is the lamp-lit worship service. ||3||

13.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
13.t: har charan kaval makara(n)dh lobhit mano anadhinuo moh aahee piaasaa ||
13.e: My mind is enticed by the honey-sweet Lotus Feet of the Lord. Day and night, I thirst for them.

13.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
13.t: kirapaa jal dheh naanak saari(n)g kau hoi jaa te terai nai vaasaa ||4||3||
13.e: Bestow the Water of Your Mercy upon Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, so that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||3||

13.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
13.t: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
13.e: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehla:

13.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
13.t: kaam karodh nagar bahu bhariaa mil saadhoo kha(n)ddal kha(n)ddaa he ||
13.e: The body-village is filled to overflowing with anger and sexual desire; these were broken into bits when I met with the Holy Saint.

13.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
13.t: poorab likhat likhe gur paiaa man har liv ma(n)ddal ma(n)ddaa he ||1||
13.e: By pre-ordained destiny, I have met with the Guru. I have entered into the realm of the Lord's Love. ||1||

13.g: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
13.t: kar saadhoo a(n)julee pun vaddaa he ||
13.e: Greet the Holy Saint with your palms pressed together; this is an act of great merit.

13.g: ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
13.t: kar dda(n)ddaut pun vaddaa he ||1|| rahaau ||
13.e: Bow down before Him; this is a virtuous action indeed. ||1||Pause||

13.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
13.t: saakat har ras saadh na jaaniaa tin a(n)tar haumai ka(n)ddaa he ||
13.e: The wicked shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not know the Taste of the Lord's Sublime Essence. The thorn of egotism is embedded deep within them.

13.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
13.t: jiau jiau chaleh chubhai dhukh paaveh jamakaal saheh sir dda(n)ddaa he ||2||
13.e: The more they walk away, the deeper it pierces them, and the more they suffer in pain, until finally, the Messenger of Death smashes his club against their heads. ||2||

13.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
13.t: har jan har har naam samaane dhukh janam maran bhav kha(n)ddaa he ||
13.e: The humble servants of the Lord are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. The pain of birth and the fear of death are eradicated.

13.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
13.t: abinaasee purakh paiaa paramesar bahu sobh kha(n)dd brahama(n)ddaa he ||3||
13.e: They have found the Imperishable Supreme Being, the Transcendent Lord God, and they receive great honor throughout all the worlds and realms. ||3||

13.g: ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
13.t: ham gareeb masakeen prabh tere har raakh raakh vadd vaddaa he ||
13.e: I am poor and meek, God, but I belong to You! Save me-please save me, O Greatest of the Great!

13.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੪॥
13.t: jan naanak naam adhaar Tek hai har naame hee sukh ma(n)ddaa he ||4||4||
13.e: Servant Nanak takes the Sustenance and Support of the Naam. In the Name of the Lord, he enjoys celestial peace. ||4||4||

13.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
13.t: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa panjavaa ||
13.e: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fifth Mehla:

13.g: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤ ਟਹਲ ਕੀ ਬੇਲਾ ॥
13.t: karau bena(n)tee sunahu mere meetaa sa(n)t Tahal kee belaa ||
13.e: Listen, my friends, I beg of you: now is the time to serve the Saints!

13.g: ਈਹਾ ਖਾਟਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਆਗੈ ਬਸਨੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
13.t: e'eehaa khaaT chalahu har laahaa aagai basan suhelaa ||1||
13.e: In this world, earn the profit of the Lord's Name, and hereafter, you shall dwell in peace. ||1||

13.g: ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਾਰੇ ॥ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
13.t: aaudh ghaTai dhinas rainaare || man gur mil kaaj savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
13.e: This life is diminishing, day and night. Meeting with the Guru, your affairs shall be resolved. ||1||Pause||

13.g: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਸੰਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
13.t: eih sa(n)saar bikaar sa(n)se meh tario braham giaanee ||
13.e: This world is engrossed in corruption and cynicism. Only those who know God are saved.

13.g: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਪੀਆਵੈ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
13.t: jiseh jagai peeaavai ih ras akath kathaa tin jaanee ||2||
13.e: Only those who are awakened by the Lord to drink in this Sublime Essence, come to know the Unspoken Speech of the Lord. ||2||

13.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਸੋਈ ਬਿਹਾਝਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
13.t: jaa kau aae soiee bihaajhahu har gur te maneh baseraa ||
13.e: Purchase only that for which you have come into the world, and through the Guru, the Lord shall dwell within your mind.

13.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
13.t: nij ghar mahal paavahu sukh sahaje bahur na hoigo feraa ||3||
