13.e: Within the home of your own inner being, you shall obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence with intuitive ease. You shall not be consigned again to the wheel of reincarnation. ||3||

13.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
13.t: a(n)tarajaamee purakh bidhaate saradhaa man kee poore ||
13.e: O Inner-knower, Searcher of Hearts, O Primal Being, Architect of Destiny: please fulfill this yearning of my mind.

13.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
13.t: naanak dhaas ihai sukh maagai mo kau kar sa(n)tan kee dhoore ||4||5||
13.e: Nanak, Your slave, begs for this happiness: let me be the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||5||

14.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
14.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
14.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

14.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
14.t: raag sireeraag mahalaa pahilaa 1 ghar pehilaa ||
14.e: Raag Siree Raag, First Mehla, First House:

14.g: ਮੋਤੀ ਤ ਮੰਦਰ ਊਸਰਹਿ ਰਤਨੀ ਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
14.t: motee ta ma(n)dhar uoosareh ratanee ta hoh jaRaau ||
14.e: If I had a palace made of pearls, inlaid with jewels,

14.g: ਕਸਤੂਰਿ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਅਗਰਿ ਚੰਦਨਿ ਲੀਪਿ ਆਵੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
14.t: kasatoor ku(n)goo agar cha(n)dhan leep aavai chaau ||
14.e: scented with musk, saffron and sandalwood, a sheer delight to behold

14.g: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
14.t: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||1||
14.e: -seeing this, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||1||

14.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
14.t: har bin jeeau jal bal jaau ||
14.e: Without the Lord, my soul is scorched and burnt.

14.g: ਮੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
14.t: mai aapanaa gur poochh dhekhiaa avar naahee thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
14.e: I consulted my Guru, and now I see that there is no other place at all. ||1||Pause||

14.g: ਧਰਤੀ ਤ ਹੀਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਤੀ ਪਲਘਿ ਲਾਲ ਜੜਾਉ ॥
14.t: dharatee ta heere laal jaRatee palagh laal jaRaau ||
14.e: If the floor of this palace was a mosaic of diamonds and rubies, and if my bed was encased with rubies,

14.g: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਣੀ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਰੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਪਸਾਉ ॥
14.t: mohanee mukh manee sohai kare ra(n)g pasaau ||
14.e: and if heavenly beauties, their faces adorned with emeralds, tried to entice me with sensual gestures of love

14.g: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
14.t: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||2||
14.e: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||2||

14.g: ਸਿਧੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਲਾਈ ਰਿਧਿ ਆਖਾ ਆਉ ॥
14.t: sidh hovaa sidh laiee ridh aakhaa aau ||
14.e: If I were to become a Siddha, and work miracles, summon wealth

14.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਸਾ ਲੋਕੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
14.t: gupat paragaT hoi baisaa lok raakhai bhaau ||
14.e: and become invisible and visible at will, so that people would hold me in awe

14.g: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
14.t: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||3||
14.e: -seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||3||

14.g: ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਹੋਵਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਸਕਰ ਤਖਤਿ ਰਾਖਾ ਪਾਉ ॥
14.t: sulataan hovaa mel lasakar takhat raakhaa paau ||
14.e: If I were to become an emperor and raise a huge army, and sit on a throne,

14.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਕਰੀ ਬੈਠਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭ ਵਾਉ ॥
14.t: hukam haasal karee baiThaa naanakaa sabh vaau ||
14.e: issuing commands and collecting taxes-O Nanak, all of this could pass away like a puff of wind.

14.g: ਮਤੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੂਲਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
14.t: mat dhekh bhoolaa veesarai teraa chit na aavai naau ||4||1||
14.e: Seeing these, I might go astray and forget You, and Your Name would not enter into my mind. ||4||1||

14.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
14.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
14.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

14.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਪਵਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅਪਿਆਉ ॥
14.t: koT koTee meree aarajaa pavan peean apiaau ||
14.e: If I could live for millions and millions of years, and if the air was my food and drink,

14.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਗੁਫੈ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸਉਣ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
14.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui gufai na dhekhaa supanai saun na thaau ||
14.e: and if I lived in a cave and never saw either the sun or the moon, and if I never slept, even in dreams

14.g: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
14.t: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||1||
14.e: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||1||

14.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਇ ॥
14.t: saachaa nira(n)kaar nij thai ||
14.e: The True Lord, the Formless One, is Himself in His Own Place.

14.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਣਾ ਜੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
14.t: sun sun aakhan aakhanaa je bhaavai kare tamai ||1|| rahaau ||
14.e: I have heard, over and over again, and so I tell the tale; as it pleases You, Lord, please instill within me the yearning for You. ||1||Pause||

14.g: ਕੁਸਾ ਕਟੀਆ ਵਾਰ ਵਾਰ ਪੀਸਣਿ ਪੀਸਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
14.t: kusaa kaTeeaa vaar vaar peesan peesaa pai ||
14.e: If I was slashed and cut into pieces, over and over again, and put into the mill and ground into flour,

14.g: ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲੀਆ ਭਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
14.t: agee setee jaaleeaa bhasam setee ral jaau ||
14.e: burnt by fire and mixed with ashes

14.g: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
14.t: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||2||
14.e: -even then, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||2||

14.g: ਪੰਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਜੇ ਭਵਾ ਸੈ ਅਸਮਾਨੀ ਜਾਉ ॥
14.t: pa(n)khee hoi kai je bhavaa sai asamaanee jaau ||
14.e: If I was a bird, soaring and flying through hundreds of heavens,

14.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਵਊ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੀਆ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥
14.t: nadharee kisai na aavuoo naa kichh peeaa na khaau ||
14.e: and if I was invisible, neither eating nor drinking anything

14.g: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੩॥
14.t: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||3||
14.e: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||3||

15.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾਗਦ ਲਖ ਮਣਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
15.t: naanak kaagadh lakh manaa paR paR keechai bhaau ||
15.e: O Nanak, if I had hundreds of thousands of stacks of paper, and if I were to read and recite and embrace love for the Lord,

15.g: ਮਸੂ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਪਉਣੁ ਚਲਾਉ ॥
15.t: masoo toT na aaviee lekhan paun chalaau ||
15.e: and if ink were never to fail me, and if my pen were able to move like the wind

15.g: ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਹਉ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
15.t: bhee teree keemat naa pavai hau kevadd aakhaa naau ||4||2||
15.e: -even so, I could not estimate Your Value. How can I describe the Greatness of Your Name? ||4||2||

15.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
15.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
15.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

15.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਲੇਖੈ ਖਾਣਾ ਖਾਉ ॥
15.t: lekhai bolan bolanaa lekhai khaanaa khaau ||
15.e: As it is pre-ordained, people speak their words. As it is pre-ordained, they consume their food.

15.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਵਾਟ ਚਲਾਈਆ ਲੇਖੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਵੇਖਾਉ ॥
15.t: lekhai vaaT chalaieeaa lekhai sun vekhaau ||
15.e: As it is pre-ordained, they walk along the way. As it is pre-ordained, they see and hear.

15.g: ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਹ ਲਵਾਈਅਹਿ ਪੜੇ ਕਿ ਪੁਛਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
15.t: lekhai saeh lavaie'eeh paRe k puchhan jaau ||1||
15.e: As it is pre-ordained, they draw their breath. Why should I go and ask the scholars about this? ||1||

15.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਚਨਾ ਧੋਹੁ ॥
15.t: baabaa maiaa rachanaa dhoh ||
15.e: O Baba, the splendor of Maya is deceptive.

15.g: ਅੰਧੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਏਹ ਨ ਓਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
15.t: a(n)dhai naam visaariaa naa tis eh na oh ||1|| rahaau ||
15.e: The blind man has forgotten the Name; he is in limbo, neither here nor there. ||1||Pause||

15.g: ਜੀਵਣ ਮਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਏਥੈ ਖਾਜੈ ਕਾਲਿ ॥
15.t: jeevan maranaa jai kai ethai khaajai kaal ||
15.e: Life and death come to all who are born. Everything here gets devoured by Death.

15.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਬਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
15.t: jithai beh samajhaieeaai tithai koi na chalio naal ||
15.e: He sits and examines the accounts, there where no one goes along with anyone.

15.g: ਰੋਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਬੰਨਹਿ ਪੰਡ ਪਰਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
15.t: rovan vaale jetaRe sabh ba(n)neh pa(n)dd paraal ||2||
15.e: Those who weep and wail might just as well all tie bundles of straw. ||2||

15.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
15.t: sabh ko aakhai bahut bahut ghaT na aakhai koi ||
15.e: Everyone says that God is the Greatest of the Great. No one calls Him any less.

15.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਵਡਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
15.t: keemat kinai na paieeaa kahan na vaddaa hoi ||
15.e: No one can estimate His Worth. By speaking of Him, His Greatness is not increased.

15.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰਿ ਜੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਲੋਅ ॥੩॥
15.t: saachaa saahab ek too hor jeeaa kete loa ||3||
15.e: You are the One True Lord and Master of all the other beings, of so many worlds. ||3||

15.g: ਨੀਚਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਚ ਜਾਤਿ ਨੀਚੀ ਹੂ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ॥ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਵਡਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਰੀਸ ॥
15.t: neechaa a(n)dhar neech jaat neechee hoo at neech || naanak tin kai sa(n)g saath vaddiaa siau kiaa rees ||
15.e: Nanak seeks the company of the lowest of the low class, the very lowest of the low. Why should he try to compete with the great?

15.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਨੀਚ ਸਮਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸੀਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
15.t: jithai neech samaaleean tithai nadhar teree bakhasees ||4||3||
15.e: In that place where the lowly are cared for-there, the Blessings of Your Glance of Grace rain down. ||4||3||

15.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
15.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
15.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

15.g: ਲਬੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਚੂਹੜਾ ਠਗਿ ਖਾਧਾ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
15.t: lab kutaa kooR choohaRaa Thag khaadhaa muradhaar ||
15.e: Greed is a dog; falsehood is a filthy street-sweeper. Cheating is eating a rotting carcass.

15.g: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰ ਮਲੁ ਮੁਖ ਸੁਧੀ ਅਗਨਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ॥
15.t: par ni(n)dhaa par mal mukh sudhee agan karodh cha(n)ddaal ||
15.e: Slandering others is putting the filth of others into your own mouth. The fire of anger is the outcaste who burns dead bodies at the crematorium.

15.g: ਰਸ ਕਸ ਆਪੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
15.t: ras kas aap salaahanaa e karam mere karataar ||1||
15.e: I am caught in these tastes and flavors, and in self-conceited praise. These are my actions, O my Creator! ||1||

15.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
15.t: baabaa boleeaai pat hoi ||
15.e: O Baba, speak only that which will bring you honor.

15.g: ਊਤਮ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਨੀਚ ਕਰਮ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
15.t: uootam se dhar uootam kahe'eeh neech karam beh roi ||1|| rahaau ||
15.e: They alone are good, who are judged good at the Lord's Door. Those with bad karma can only sit and weep. ||1||Pause||

15.g: ਰਸੁ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਰੁਪਾ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਰਮਲ ਕੀ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
15.t: ras suinaa ras rupaa kaaman ras paramal kee vaas ||
15.e: The pleasures of gold and silver, the pleasures of women, the pleasure of the fragrance of sandalwood,

15.g: ਰਸੁ ਘੋੜੇ ਰਸੁ ਸੇਜਾ ਮੰਦਰ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
15.t: ras ghoRe ras sejaa ma(n)dhar ras meeThaa ras maas ||
15.e: the pleasure of horses, the pleasure of a soft bed in a palace, the pleasure of sweet treats and the pleasure of hearty meals

15.g: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਕੈ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
15.t: ete ras sareer ke kai ghaT naam nivaas ||2||
15.e: -these pleasures of the human body are so numerous; how can the Naam, the Name of the Lord, find its dwelling in the heart? ||2||

15.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਬੋਲਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
15.t: jit boliaai pat paieeaai so boliaa paravaan ||
15.e: Those words are acceptable, which, when spoken, bring honor.

15.g: ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਿ ਵਿਗੁਚਣਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਅਜਾਣ ॥
15.t: fikaa bol viguchanaa sun moorakh man ajaan ||
15.e: Harsh words bring only grief. Listen, O foolish and ignorant mind!

15.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕਿ ਕਹਣ ਵਖਾਣ ॥੩॥
15.t: jo tis bhaaveh se bhale hor k kahan vakhaan ||3||
15.e: Those who are pleasing to Him are good. What else is there to be said? ||3||

15.g: ਤਿਨ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
15.t: tin mat tin pat tin dhan palai jin hiradhai rahiaa samai ||
15.e: Wisdom, honor and wealth are in the laps of those whose hearts remain permeated with the Lord.

15.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਅਵਰ ਸੁਆਲਿਉ ਕਾਇ ॥
15.t: tin kaa kiaa saalaahanaa avar suaaliau kai ||
15.e: What praise can be offered to them? What other adornments can be bestowed upon them?

15.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਦਾਨਿ ਨ ਨਾਇ ॥੪॥੪॥
15.t: naanak nadharee baahare raacheh dhaan na nai ||4||4||
15.e: O Nanak, those who lack the Lord's Glance of Grace cherish neither charity nor the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

15.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
15.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
15.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

15.g: ਅਮਲੁ ਗਲੋਲਾ ਕੂੜ ਕਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥
15.t: amal galolaa kooR kaa dhitaa dhevanahaar ||
15.e: The Great Giver has given the intoxicating drug of falsehood.

15.g: ਮਤੀ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
15.t: matee maran visaariaa khusee keetee dhin chaar ||
15.e: The people are intoxicated; they have forgotten death, and they have fun for a few days.

15.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਫੀਆ ਰਾਖਣ ਕਉ ਦਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
15.t: sach miliaa tin sofeeaa raakhan kau dharavaar ||1||
15.e: Those who do not use intoxicants are true; they dwell in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

15.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਕਉ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
15.t: naanak saache kau sach jaan ||
15.e: O Nanak, know the True Lord as True.

15.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
15.t: jit seviaai sukh paieeaai teree dharageh chalai maan ||1|| rahaau ||
15.e: Serving Him, peace is obtained; you shall go to His Court with honor. ||1||Pause||

15.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਰਾ ਗੁੜ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
15.t: sach saraa guR baaharaa jis vich sachaa naau ||
15.e: The Wine of Truth is not fermented from molasses. The True Name is contained within it.

16.g: ਸੁਣਹਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਜੇਤੜੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
16.t: suneh vakhaaneh jetaRe hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
16.e: I am a sacrifice to those who hear and chant the True Name.

16.g: ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਖੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਏ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
16.t: taa man kheevaa jaaneeaai jaa mahalee paae thaau ||2||
16.e: Only one who obtains a room in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is deemed to be truly intoxicated. ||2||

16.g: ਨਾਉ ਨੀਰੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਸਤੁ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਤਨਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
16.t: naau neer cha(n)giaaieeaa sat paramal tan vaas ||
16.e: Bathe in the waters of Goodness and apply the scented oil of Truth to your body,

16.g: ਤਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਲਖ ਦਾਤੀ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
16.t: taa mukh hovai ujalaa lakh dhaatee ik dhaat ||
16.e: and your face shall become radiant. This is the gift of 100,000 gifts.

16.g: ਦੂਖ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਹਿ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਜਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
16.t: dhookh tisai peh aakhe'eeh sookh jisai hee paas ||3||
16.e: Tell your troubles to the One who is the Source of all comfort. ||3||

16.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ॥
16.t: so kiau manahu visaareeaai jaa ke jeea paraan ||
16.e: How can you forget the One who created your soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life?

16.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
16.t: tis vin sabh apavitr hai jetaa painan khaan ||
16.e: Without Him, all that we wear and eat is impure.

16.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਗਲਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
16.t: hor galaa(n) sabh kooReeaa tudh bhaavai paravaan ||4||5||
16.e: Everything else is false. Whatever pleases Your Will is acceptable. ||4||5||

16.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
16.t: sireeraag mahal pehilaa ||
16.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

16.g: ਜਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਘਸਿ ਮਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
16.t: jaal moh ghas mas kar mat kaagadh kar saar ||
16.e: Burn emotional attachment, and grind it into ink. Transform your intelligence into the purest of paper.

16.g: ਭਾਉ ਕਲਮ ਕਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
16.t: bhaau kalam kar chit lekhaaree gur puchh likh beechaar ||
16.e: Make the love of the Lord your pen, and let your consciousness be the scribe. Then, seek the Guru's Instructions, and record these deliberations.

16.g: ਲਿਖੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਲਿਖੁ ਲਿਖੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
16.t: likh naam saalaeh likh likh a(n)t na paaraavaar ||1||
16.e: Write the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; write over and over again that He has no end or limitation. ||1||

16.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਏਹੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
16.t: baabaa eh lekhaa likh jaan ||
16.e: O Baba, write such an account,

16.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
16.t: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai tithai hoi sachaa neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
16.e: that when it is asked for, it will bring the Mark of Truth. ||1||Pause||

16.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਦ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਸਦ ਚਾਉ ॥
16.t: jithai mileh vaddiaaieeaa sadh khuseeaa sadh chaau ||
16.e: There, where greatness, eternal peace and everlasting joy are bestowed,

16.g: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਿਕਲਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
16.t: tin mukh Tike nikaleh jin man sachaa naau ||
16.e: the faces of those whose minds are attuned to the True Name are anointed with the Mark of Grace.

16.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਗਲੀ ਵਾਉ ਦੁਆਉ ॥੨॥
16.t: karam milai taa paieeaai naahee galee vaau dhuaau ||2||
16.e: If one receives God's Grace, then such honors are received, and not by mere words. ||2||

16.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਉਠਿ ਰਖੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਵ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
16.t: eik aaveh ik jaeh uTh rakhe'eeh naav salaar ||
16.e: Some come, and some arise and depart. They give themselves lofty names.

16.g: ਇਕਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੇ ਦਰਵਾਰ ॥
16.t: eik upaae ma(n)gate ikanaa vadde dharavaar ||
16.e: Some are born beggars, and some hold vast courts.

16.g: ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਵੇਕਾਰ ॥੩॥
16.t: agai giaa jaaneeaai vin naavai vekaar ||3||
16.e: Going to the world hereafter, everyone shall realize that without the Name, it is all useless. ||3||

16.g: ਭੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਛਿਜੈ ਦੇਹ ॥
16.t: bhai terai ddar agalaa khap khap chhijai dheh ||
16.e: I am terrified by the Fear of You, God. Bothered and bewildered, my body is wasting away.

16.g: ਨਾਵ ਜਿਨਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੋਦੇ ਡਿਠੇ ਖੇਹ ॥
16.t: naav jinaa sulataan khaan hodhe ddiThe kheh ||
16.e: Those who are known as sultans and emperors shall be reduced to dust in the end.

16.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਤੁਟੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੪॥੬॥
16.t: naanak uThee chaliaa sabh kooRe tuTe neh ||4||6||
16.e: O Nanak, arising and departing, all false attachments are cut away. ||4||6||

16.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
16.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
16.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

16.g: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਮਿਠੇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਾਲੋਣੇ ॥
16.t: sabh ras miThe ma(n)niaai suniaai saalone ||
16.e: Believing, all tastes are sweet. Hearing, the salty flavors are tasted;

16.g: ਖਟ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਰਣ ਨਾਦ ਕੀਏ ॥
16.t: khaT turasee mukh bolanaa maaran naadh ke'ee ||
16.e: chanting with one's mouth, the spicy flavors are savored. All these spices have been made from the Sound-current of the Naad.

16.g: ਛਤੀਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਏਕੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
16.t: chhateeh a(n)mirat bhaau ek jaa kau nadhar karei ||1||
16.e: The thirty-six flavors of ambrosial nectar are in the Love of the One Lord; they are tasted only by one who is blessed by His Glance of Grace. ||1||

16.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
16.t: baabaa hor khaanaa khusee khuaar ||
16.e: O Baba, the pleasures of other foods are false.

16.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
16.t: jit khaadhai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
16.e: Eating them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

16.g: ਰਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਸੁਪੇਦੀ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
16.t: rataa painan man rataa supedhee sat dhaan ||
16.e: My mind is imbued with the Lord's Love; it is dyed a deep crimson. Truth and charity are my white clothes.

16.g: ਨੀਲੀ ਸਿਆਹੀ ਕਦਾ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਪੈਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
16.t: neelee siaahee kadhaa karanee pahiran pair dhiaan ||
16.e: Erasing the blackness of sin is my wearing of blue clothes, and meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet is my robe of honor.

16.g: ਕਮਰਬੰਦੁ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
16.t: kamaraba(n)dh sa(n)tokh kaa dhan joban teraa naam ||2||
16.e: Contentment is my cummerbund, Your Name is my wealth and youth. ||2||

16.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
16.t: baabaa hor painan khusee khuaar ||
16.e: O Baba, the pleasures of other clothes are false.

16.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
16.t: jit paidhai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
16.e: Wearing them, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

16.g: ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰ ਸੁਇਨੇ ਸਾਖਤਿ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਾਟ ॥
16.t: ghoRe paakhar suine saakhat boojhan teree vaaT ||
16.e: The understanding of Your Way, Lord, is horses, saddles and bags of gold for me.

16.g: ਤਰਕਸ ਤੀਰ ਕਮਾਣ ਸਾਂਗ ਤੇਗਬੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਧਾਤੁ ॥
16.t: tarakas teer kamaan saa(n)g tegaba(n)dh gun dhaat ||
16.e: The pursuit of virtue is my bow and arrow, my quiver, sword and scabbard.

16.g: ਵਾਜਾ ਨੇਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
16.t: vaajaa nejaa pat siau paragaT karam teraa meree jaat ||3||
16.e: To be distinguished with honor is my drum and banner. Your Mercy is my social status. ||3||

16.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਚੜਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
16.t: baabaa hor chaRanaa khusee khuaar ||
16.e: O Baba, the pleasures of other rides are false.

16.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਚੜਿਐ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
16.t: jit chaRiaai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||
16.e: By such rides, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||

16.g: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਖੁਸੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
16.t: ghar ma(n)dhar khusee naam kee nadhar teree paravaar ||
16.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the pleasure of houses and mansions. Your Glance of Grace is my family, Lord.

17.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਸੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਆਖਣੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
17.t: hukam soiee tudh bhaavasee hor aakhan bahut apaar ||
17.e: The Hukam of Your Command is the pleasure of Your Will, Lord. To say anything else is far beyond anyone's reach.

17.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪੂਛਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
17.t: naanak sachaa paatisaahu poochh na kare beechaar ||4||
17.e: O Nanak, the True King does not seek advice from anyone else in His decisions. ||4||

17.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਉਣਾ ਖੁਸੀ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
17.t: baabaa hor saunaa khusee khuaar ||
17.e: O Baba, the pleasure of other sleep is false.

17.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੁਤੈ ਤਨੁ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥
17.t: jit sutai tan peeReeaai man meh chaleh vikaar ||1|| rahaau ||4||7||
17.e: By such sleep, the body is ruined, and wickedness and corruption enter into the mind. ||1||Pause||4||7||

17.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
17.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
17.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

17.g: ਕੁੰਗੂ ਕੀ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਲਲਿਤਾ ਅਗਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
17.t: ku(n)goo kee kaa(n)iaa ratanaa kee lalitaa agar vaas tan saas ||
17.e: With the body of saffron, and the tongue a jewel, and the breath of the body pure fragrant incense;

17.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਕਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਟਿਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੁ ॥
17.t: aThasaTh teerath kaa mukh Tikaa tit ghaT mat vigaas ||
17.e: with the face anointed at the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, and the heart illuminated with wisdom

17.g: ਓਤੁ ਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
17.t: ot matee saalaahanaa sach naam gunataas ||1||
17.e: -with that wisdom, chant the Praises of the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

17.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਰ ਹੋਰ ॥
17.t: baabaa hor mat hor hor ||
17.e: O Baba, other wisdom is useless and irrelevant.

17.g: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਵੇਰ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜਾ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
17.t: je sau ver kamaieeaai kooRai kooRaa jor ||1|| rahaau ||
17.e: If falsehood is practiced a hundred times, it is still false in its effects. ||1||Pause||

17.g: ਪੂਜ ਲਗੈ ਪੀਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
17.t: pooj lagai peer aakheeaai sabh milai sa(n)saar ||
17.e: You may be worshipped and adored as a Pir (a spiritual teacher); you may be welcomed by all the world;

17.g: ਨਾਉ ਸਦਾਏ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਿਧੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ॥
17.t: naau sadhaae aapanaa hovai sidh sumaar ||
17.e: you may adopt a lofty name, and be known to have supernatural spiritual powers

17.g: ਜਾ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭਾ ਪੂਜ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
17.t: jaa pat lekhai naa pavai sabhaa pooj khuaar ||2||
17.e: -even so, if you are not accepted in the Court of the Lord, then all this adoration is false. ||2||

17.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
17.t: jin kau satigur thaapiaa tin meT na sakai koi ||
17.e: No one can overthrow those who have been established by the True Guru.

17.g: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
17.t: onaa a(n)dhar naam nidhaan hai naamo paragaT hoi ||
17.e: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is within them, and through the Naam, they are radiant and famous.

17.g: ਨਾਉ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
17.t: naau poojeeaai naau ma(n)neeaai akha(n)dd sadhaa sach soi ||3||
17.e: They worship the Naam, and they believe in the Naam. The True One is forever Intact and Unbroken. ||3||

17.g: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਕੇਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
17.t: khehoo kheh ralaieeaai taa jeeau kehaa hoi ||
17.e: When the body mingles with dust, what happens to the soul?

17.g: ਜਲੀਆ ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਉਠੀ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
17.t: jaleeaa sabh siaanapaa uThee chaliaa roi ||
17.e: All clever tricks are burnt away, and you shall depart crying.

17.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਐ ਦਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੮॥
17.t: naanak naam visaariaai dhar giaa kiaa hoi ||4||8||
17.e: O Nanak, those who forget the Naam-what will happen when they go to the Court of the Lord? ||4||8||

17.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
17.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
17.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

17.g: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਵੀਥਰੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਝੂਰਿ ॥
17.t: gunava(n)tee gun veetharai aaugunava(n)tee jhoor ||
17.e: The virtuous wife exudes virtue; the unvirtuous suffer in misery.

17.g: ਜੇ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਵਰੁ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਨਹ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
17.t: je loReh var kaamanee neh mileeaai pir koor ||
17.e: If you long for your Husband Lord, O soul-bride, you must know that He is not met by falsehood.

17.g: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
17.t: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa paieeaai pir dhoor ||1||
17.e: No boat or raft can take you to Him. Your Husband Lord is far away. ||1||

17.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਅਡੋਲੁ ॥
17.t: mere Thaakur poorai takhat addol ||
17.e: My Lord and Master is Perfect; His Throne is Eternal and Immovable.

17.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
17.t: gurmukh pooraa je kare paieeaai saach atol ||1|| rahaau ||
17.e: One who attains perfection as Gurmukh, obtains the Immeasurable True Lord. ||1||Pause||

17.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲ ॥ ਮੋਤੀ ਹੀਰਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟ ਰੀਸਾਲ ॥
17.t: prabh harima(n)dhar sohanaa tis meh maanak laal || motee heeraa niramalaa ka(n)chan koT reesaal ||
17.e: The Palace of the Lord God is so beautiful. Within it, there are gems, rubies, pearls and flawless diamonds. A fortress of gold surrounds this Source of Nectar.

17.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਗੜਿ ਕਿਉ ਚੜਉ ਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥
17.t: bin pauRee gaR kiau chaRau gur har dhiaan nihaal ||2||
17.e: How can I climb up to the Fortress without a ladder? By meditating on the Lord, through the Guru, I am blessed and exalted. ||2||

17.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
17.t: gur pauRee beRee guroo gur tulahaa har naau ||
17.e: The Guru is the Ladder, the Guru is the Boat, and the Guru is the Raft to take me to the Lord's Name.

17.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਰੀਆਉ ॥
17.t: gur sar saagar bohitho gur teerath dhareeaau ||
17.e: The Guru is the Boat to carry me across the world-ocean; the Guru is the Sacred Shrine of Pilgrimage, the Guru is the Holy River.

17.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਊਜਲੀ ਸਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ॥੩॥
17.t: je tis bhaavai uoojalee sat sar naavan jaau ||3||
17.e: If it pleases Him, I bathe in the Pool of Truth, and become radiant and pure. ||3||

17.g: ਪੂਰੋ ਪੂਰੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
17.t: pooro pooro aakheeaai poorai takhat nivaas ||
17.e: He is called the Most Perfect of the Perfect. He sits upon His Perfect Throne.

17.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ॥
17.t: poorai thaan suhaavanai poorai aas niraas ||
17.e: He looks so Beautiful in His Perfect Place. He fulfills the hopes of the hopeless.

17.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਿਉ ਘਾਟੈ ਗੁਣ ਤਾਸ ॥੪॥੯॥
17.t: naanak pooraa je milai kiau ghaaTai gun taas ||4||9||
17.e: O Nanak, if one obtains the Perfect Lord, how can his virtues decrease? ||4||9||

17.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
17.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
17.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

17.g: ਆਵਹੁ ਭੈਣੇ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਆਹ ॥
17.t: aavahu bhaine gal mileh a(n)k sahelaReeaaeh ||
17.e: Come, my dear sisters and spiritual companions; hug me close in your embrace.

17.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਕੰਤ ਕੀਆਹ ॥
17.t: mil kai kareh kahaaneeaa sa(n)mrath ka(n)t keeaaeh ||
17.e: Let's join together, and tell stories of our All-powerful Husband Lord.

17.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਅਸਾਹ ॥੧॥
17.t: saache saahib sabh gun aaugan sabh asaeh ||1||
17.e: All Virtues are in our True Lord and Master; we are utterly without virtue. ||1||

17.g: ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
17.t: karataa sabh ko terai jor ||
17.e: O Creator Lord, all are in Your Power.

17.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
17.t: ek sabadh beechaareeaai jaa too taa kiaa hor ||1|| rahaau ||
17.e: I dwell upon the One Word of the Shabad. You are mine-what else do I need? ||1||Pause||

17.g: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਤੁਸੀ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਕਿਨੀ ਗੁਣਂੀ ॥
17.t: jai puchhahu sohaaganee tusee raaviaa kinee guna(n)ee ||
17.e: Go, and ask the happy soul-brides, ""By what virtuous qualities do you enjoy your Husband Lord?""

17.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੀ ॥
17.t: sahaj sa(n)tokh seegaareeaa miThaa bolanee ||
17.e: "We are adorned with intuitive ease, contentment and sweet words.

17.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਰੀਸਾਲੂ ਤਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
17.t: pir reesaaloo taa milai jaa gur kaa sabadh sunee ||2||
17.e: We meet with our Beloved, the Source of Joy, when we listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.""||2||

18.g: ਕੇਤੀਆ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਕੇਵਡ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
18.t: keteeaa tereeaa kudharatee kevadd teree dhaat ||
18.e: You have so many Creative Powers, Lord; Your Bountiful Blessings are so Great.

18.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
18.t: kete tere jeea ja(n)t sifat kareh dhin raat ||
18.e: So many of Your beings and creatures praise You day and night.

18.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਤੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ॥੩॥
18.t: kete tere roop ra(n)g kete jaat ajaat ||3||
18.e: You have so many forms and colors, so many classes, high and low. ||3||

18.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
18.t: sach milai sach uoopajai sach meh saach samai ||
18.e: Meeting the True One, Truth wells up. The truthful are absorbed into the True Lord.

18.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਗਵੈ ਗੁਰਬਚਨੀ ਭਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
18.t: surat hovai pat uoogavai gurbachanee bhau khai ||
18.e: Intuitive understanding is obtained and one is welcomed with honor, through the Guru's Word, filled with the Fear of God.

18.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
18.t: naanak sachaa paatisaahu aape le milai ||4||10||
18.e: O Nanak, the True King absorbs us into Himself. ||4||10||

18.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
18.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
18.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

18.g: ਭਲੀ ਸਰੀ ਜਿ ਉਬਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੁਈ ਘਰਾਹੁ ॥
18.t: bhalee saree j ubaree haumai muiee gharaahu ||
18.e: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart was subdued.

18.g: ਦੂਤ ਲਗੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
18.t: dhoot lage fir chaakaree satigur kaa vesaahu ||
18.e: The evil energies have been made to serve me, since I placed my faith in the True Guru.

18.g: ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
18.t: kalap tiaagee baadh hai sachaa veparavaahu ||1||
18.e: I have renounced my useless schemes, by the Grace of the True, Carefree Lord. ||1||

18.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
18.t: man re sach milai bhau jai ||
18.e: O mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs.

18.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕਿਉ ਥੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
18.t: bhai bin nirabhau kiau theeaai gurmukh sabadh samai ||1|| rahaau ||
18.e: Without the Fear of God, how can anyone become fearless? Become Gurmukh, and immerse yourself in the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

18.g: ਕੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
18.t: ketaa aakhan aakheeaai aakhan toT na hoi ||
18.e: How can we describe Him with words? There is no end to the descriptions of Him.

18.g: ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
18.t: ma(n)gan vaale ketaRe dhaataa eko soi ||
18.e: There are so many beggars, but He is the only Giver.

18.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
18.t: jis ke jeea paraan hai man vasiaai sukh hoi ||2||
18.e: He is the Giver of the soul, and the praanaa, the breath of life; when He dwells within the mind, there is peace. ||2||

18.g: ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਾਜੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਾਇ ॥
18.t: jag supanaa baajee banee khin meh khel khelai ||
18.e: The world is a drama, staged in a dream. In a moment, the play is played out.

18.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਏਕਸੇ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
18.t: sa(n)jogee mil ekase vijogee uTh jai ||
18.e: Some attain union with the Lord, while others depart in separation.

18.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
18.t: jo tis bhaanaa so theeaai avar na karanaa jai ||3||
18.e: Whatever pleases Him comes to pass; nothing else can be done. ||3||

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
18.t: gurmukh vasat vesaaheeaai sach vakhar sach raas ||
18.e: The Gurmukhs purchase the Genuine Article. The True Merchandise is purchased with the True Capital.

18.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
18.t: jinee sach vana(n)jiaa gur poore saabaas ||
18.e: Those who purchase this True Merchandise through the Perfect Guru are blessed.

18.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
18.t: naanak vasat pachhaanasee sach saudhaa jis paas ||4||11||
18.e: O Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine Article. ||4||11||

18.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ੧ ॥
18.t: sireeraag mahal pehilaa ||
18.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

18.g: ਧਾਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਉ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
18.t: dhaat milai fun dhaat kau sifatee sifat samai ||
18.e: As metal merges with metal, those who chant the Praises of the Lord are absorbed into the Praiseworthy Lord.

18.g: ਲਾਲੁ ਗੁਲਾਲੁ ਗਹਬਰਾ ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਉ ॥
18.t: laal gulaal gahabaraa sachaa ra(n)g chaRaau ||
18.e: Like the poppies, they are dyed in the deep crimson color of Truthfulness.

18.g: ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
18.t: sach milai sa(n)tokheeaa har jap ekai bhai ||1||
18.e: Those contented souls who meditate on the Lord with single-minded love, meet the True Lord. ||1||

18.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ॥
18.t: bhaiee re sa(n)t janaa kee ren ||
18.e: O Siblings of Destiny, become the dust of the feet of the humble Saints.

18.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਧੇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
18.t: sa(n)t sabhaa gur paieeaai mukat padhaarath dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
18.e: In the Society of the Saints, the Guru is found. He is the Treasure of Liberation, the Source of all good fortune. ||1||Pause||

18.g: ਊਚਉ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
18.t: uoochau thaan suhaavanaa uoopar mahal muraar ||
18.e: Upon that Highest Plane of Sublime Beauty, stands the Mansion of the Lord.

18.g: ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਦੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
18.t: sach karanee dhe paieeaai dhar ghar mahal piaar ||
18.e: By true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves which leads to the Mansion of the Beloved, is found.

18.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
18.t: gurmukh man samajhaieeaai aatam raam beechaar ||2||
18.e: The Gurmukhs train their minds to contemplate the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

18.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
18.t: tirabidh karam kamaie'eeh aas a(n)dhesaa hoi ||
18.e: By actions committed under the influence of the three qualities, hope and anxiety are produced.

18.g: ਕਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
18.t: kiau gur bin tirakuTee chhuTasee sahaj miliaai sukh hoi ||
18.e: Without the Guru, how can anyone be released from these three qualities? Through intuitive wisdom, we meet with Him and find peace.

18.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥੩॥
18.t: nij ghar mahal pachhaaneeaai nadhar kare mal dhoi ||3||
18.e: Within the home of the self, the Mansion of His Presence is realized when He bestows His Glance of Grace and washes away our pollution. ||3||

18.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਘਰ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
18.t: bin gur mail na utarai bin har kiau ghar vaas ||
18.e: Without the Guru, this pollution is not removed. Without the Lord, how can there be any homecoming?

18.g: ਏਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਆਸ ॥
18.t: eko sabadh veechaareeaai avar tiaagai aas ||
18.e: Contemplate the One Word of the Shabad, and abandon other hopes.

18.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਈਐ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
18.t: naanak dhekh dhikhaieeaai hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||4||12||
18.e: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him. ||4||12||

18.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
18.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
18.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

18.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
18.t: dhirag jeevan dhohaaganee muThee dhoojai bhai ||
18.e: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality.

18.g: ਕਲਰ ਕੇਰੀ ਕੰਧ ਜਿਉ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਿਰਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
18.t: kalar keree ka(n)dh jiau ahinis kir ddeh pai ||
18.e: Like a wall of sand, day and night, she crumbles, and eventually, she breaks down altogether.

18.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
18.t: bin sabadhai sukh naa theeaai pir bin dhookh na jai ||1||
18.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, peace does not come. Without her Husband Lord, her suffering does not end. ||1||

18.g: ਮੁੰਧੇ ਪਿਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
18.t: mu(n)dhe pir bin kiaa seegaar ||
18.e: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?

19.g: ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਈ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
19.t: dhar ghar ddoiee na lahai dharageh jhooTh khuaar ||1|| rahaau ||
19.e: In this world, you shall not find any shelter; in the world hereafter, being false, you shall suffer. ||1||Pause||

19.g: ਆਪਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਭੁਲਈ ਸਚਾ ਵਡ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ॥
19.t: aap sujaan na bhuliee sachaa vadd kirasaan ||
19.e: The True Lord Himself knows all; He makes no mistakes. He is the Great Farmer of the Universe.

19.g: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇ ਦਾਣੁ ॥
19.t: pahilaa dharatee saadh kai sach naam dhe dhaan ||
19.e: First, He prepares the ground, and then He plants the Seed of the True Name.

19.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
19.t: nau nidh upajai naam ek karam pavai neesaan ||2||
19.e: The nine treasures are produced from Name of the One Lord. By His Grace, we obtain His Banner and Insignia. ||2||

19.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਜੁ ਅਚਾਰੁ ॥
19.t: gur kau jaan na jaaniee kiaa tis chaj achaar ||
19.e: Some are very knowledgeable, but if they do not know the Guru, then what is the use of their lives?

19.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
19.t: a(n)dhulai naam visaariaa manmukh a(n)dh gubaar ||
19.e: The blind have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The self-willed manmukhs are in utter darkness.

19.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
19.t: aavan jaan na chukiee mar janamai hoi khuaar ||3||
19.e: Their comings and goings in reincarnation do not end; through death and rebirth, they are wasting away. ||3||

19.g: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਕੁੰਗੂ ਮਾਂਗ ਸੰਧੂਰੁ ॥
19.t: cha(n)dhan mol anaiaa ku(n)goo maa(n)g sa(n)dhoor ||
19.e: The bride may buy sandalwood oil and perfumes, and apply them in great quantities to her hair;

19.g: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਪਾਨਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਪੂਰੁ ॥
19.t: choaa cha(n)dhan bahu ghanaa paanaa naal kapoor ||
19.e: she may sweeten her breath with betel leaf and camphor,

19.g: ਜੇ ਧਨ ਕੰਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤ ਸਭਿ ਅਡੰਬਰ ਕੂੜੁ ॥੪॥
19.t: je dhan ka(n)t na bhaaviee ta sabh adda(n)bar kooR ||4||
19.e: but if this bride is not pleasing to her Husband Lord, then all these trappings are false. ||4||

19.g: ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਾਦਿ ਹਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
19.t: sabh ras bhogan baadh heh sabh seegaar vikaar ||
19.e: Her enjoyment of all pleasures is futile, and all her decorations are corrupt.

19.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਸੋਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
19.t: jab lag sabadh na bhedheeaai kiau sohai gurdhuaar ||
19.e: Until she has been pierced through with the Shabad, how can she look beautiful at Guru's Gate?

19.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੧੩॥
19.t: naanak dha(n)n suhaaganee jin seh naal piaar ||5||13||
19.e: O Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband Lord. ||5||13||

19.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
19.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
19.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

19.g: ਸੁੰਞੀ ਦੇਹ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
19.t: su(n)n(j)ee dheh ddaraavanee jaa jeeau vichahu jai ||
19.e: The empty body is dreadful, when the soul goes out from within.

19.g: ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਦੀ ਵਿਝਵੀ ਧੂਉ ਨ ਨਿਕਸਿਓ ਕਾਇ ॥
19.t: bhaeh bala(n)dhee vijhavee dhooau na nikasio kai ||
19.e: The burning fire of life is extinguished, and the smoke of the breath no longer emerges.

19.g: ਪੰਚੇ ਰੁੰਨੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਭਰੇ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
19.t: pa(n)che ru(n)ne dhukh bhare binase dhoojai bhai ||1||
19.e: The five relatives (the senses) weep and wail painfully, and waste away through the love of duality. ||1||

19.g: ਮੂੜੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
19.t: mooRe raam japahu gun saar ||
19.e: You fool: chant the Name of the Lord, and preserve your virtue.

19.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
19.t: haumai mamataa mohanee sabh muThee aha(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
19.e: Egotism and possessiveness are very enticing; egotistical pride has plundered everyone. ||1||Pause||

19.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿ ॥
19.t: jinee naam visaariaa dhoojee kaarai lag ||
19.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are attached to affairs of duality.

19.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ॥
19.t: dhubidhaa laage pach mue a(n)tar tirasanaa ag ||
19.e: Attached to duality, they putrefy and die; they are filled with the fire of desire within.

19.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਠਗਿ ॥੨॥
19.t: gur raakhe se ubare hor muThee dha(n)dhai Thag ||2||
19.e: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved; all others are cheated and plundered by deceitful worldly affairs. ||2||

19.g: ਮੁਈ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗਇਆ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ॥
19.t: muiee pareet piaar giaa muaa vair virodh ||
19.e: Love dies, and affection vanishes. Hatred and alienation die.

19.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਥਕਾ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ॥
19.t: dha(n)dhaa thakaa hau muiee mamataa maiaa karodh ||
19.e: Entanglements end, and egotism dies, along with attachment to Maya, possessiveness and anger.

19.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰੋਧੁ ॥੩॥
19.t: karam milai sach paieeaai gurmukh sadhaa nirodh ||3||
19.e: Those who receive His Mercy obtain the True One. The Gurmukhs dwell forever in balanced restraint. ||3||

19.g: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
19.t: sachee kaarai sach milai gurmat palai pai ||
19.e: By true actions, the True Lord is met, and the Guru's Teachings are found.

19.g: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਜੰਮੈ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
19.t: so nar ja(n)mai naa marai naa aavai naa jai ||
19.e: Then, they are not subject to birth and death; they do not come and go in reincarnation.

19.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਸੋ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
19.t: naanak dhar paradhaan so dharageh paidhaa jai ||4||14||
19.e: O Nanak, they are respected at the Lord's Gate; they are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord. ||4||14||

19.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲ ੧ ॥
19.t: sireeraag mahal 1 ||
19.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

19.g: ਤਨੁ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਮਾਟੀ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੂਰੁ ॥
19.t: tan jal bal maaTee bhiaa man maiaa moh manoor ||
19.e: The body is burnt to ashes; by its love of Maya, the mind is rusted through.

19.g: ਅਉਗਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਾਗੂ ਭਏ ਕੂਰਿ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਤੂਰੁ ॥
19.t: aaugan fir laagoo bhe koor vajaavai toor ||
19.e: Demerits become one's enemies, and falsehood blows the bugle of attack.

19.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਡੋਬੇ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੧॥
19.t: bin sabadhai bharamaieeaai dhubidhaa ddobe poor ||1||
19.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, people wander lost in reincarnation. Through the love of duality, multitudes have been drowned. ||1||

19.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
19.t: man re sabadh tarahu chit lai ||
19.e: O mind, swim across, by focusing your consciousness on the Shabad.

19.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
19.t: jin gurmukh naam na boojhiaa mar janamai aavai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
19.e: Those who do not become Gurmukh do not understand the Naam; they die, and continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

19.g: ਤਨੁ ਸੂਚਾ ਸੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
19.t: tan soochaa so aakheeaai jis meh saachaa naau ||
19.e: That body is said to be pure, in which the True Name abides.

19.g: ਭੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
19.t: bhai sach raatee dhehuree jihavaa sach suaau ||
19.e: One whose body is imbued with the Fear of the True One, and whose tongue savors Truthfulness,

19.g: ਸਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਾਉ ॥੨॥
19.t: sachee nadhar nihaaleeaai bahuR na paavai taau ||2||
19.e: is brought to ecstasy by the True Lord's Glance of Grace. That person does not have to go through the fire of the womb again. ||2||

19.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਨਾ ਭਇਆ ਪਵਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
19.t: saache te pavanaa bhiaa pavanai te jal hoi ||
19.e: From the True Lord came the air, and from the air came water.

19.g: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮੋਇ ॥
19.t: jal te tirabhavan saajiaa ghaT ghaT jot samoi ||
19.e: From water, He created the three worlds; in each and every heart He has infused His Light.

19.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
19.t: niramal mailaa naa theeaai sabadh rate pat hoi ||3||
19.e: The Immaculate Lord does not become polluted. Attuned to the Shabad, honor is obtained. ||3||

19.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
19.t: eih man saach sa(n)tokhiaa nadhar kare tis maeh ||
19.e: One whose mind is contented with Truthfulness, is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace.

20.g: ਪੰਚ ਭੂਤ ਸਚਿ ਭੈ ਰਤੇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਚੀ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
20.t: pa(n)ch bhoot sach bhai rate jot sachee man maeh ||
20.e: The body of the five elements is dyed in the Fear of the True One; the mind is filled with the True Light.

20.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
20.t: naanak aaugan veesare gur raakhe pat taeh ||4||15||
20.e: O Nanak, your demerits shall be forgotten; the Guru shall preserve your honor. ||4||15||

20.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
20.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
20.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

20.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇੜੀ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
20.t: naanak beRee sach kee tareeaai gur veechaar ||
20.e: O Nanak, the Boat of Truth will ferry you across; contemplate the Guru.

20.g: ਇਕਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਜਾਵਹੀ ਪੂਰਿ ਭਰੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
20.t: eik aaveh ik jaavahee poor bhare aha(n)kaar ||
20.e: Some come, and some go; they are totally filled with egotism.

20.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਮਤੀ ਬੂਡੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
20.t: manahaTh matee booddeeaai gurmukh sachu su taar ||1||
20.e: Through stubborn-mindedness, the intellect is drowned; one who becomes Gurmukh and truthful is saved. ||1||

20.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
20.t: gur bin kiau tareeaai sukh hoi ||
20.e: Without the Guru, how can anyone swim across to find peace?

20.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
20.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too mai avar na dhoojaa koi ||1|| rahaau ||
20.e: As it pleases You, Lord, You save me. There is no other for me at all. ||1||Pause||

20.g: ਆਗੈ ਦੇਖਉ ਡਉ ਜਲੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਹਰਿਓ ਅੰਗੂਰੁ ॥
20.t: aagai dhekhau ddau jalai paachhai hario a(n)goor ||
20.e: In front of me, I see the jungle burning; behind me, I see green plants sprouting.

20.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
20.t: jis te upajai tis te binasai ghaT ghaT sach bharapoor ||
20.e: We shall merge into the One from whom we came. The True One is pervading each and every heart.

20.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
20.t: aape mel milaavahee saachai mahal hadhoor ||2||
20.e: He Himself unites us in Union with Himself; the True Mansion of His Presence is close at hand. ||2||

20.g: ਸਾਹਿ ਸਾਹਿ ਤੁਝੁ ਸੰਮਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੇਉ ॥
20.t: saeh saeh tujh sa(n)malaa kadhe na visaareau ||
20.e: With each and every breath, I dwell upon You; I shall never forget You.

20.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੇਉ ॥
20.t: jiau jiau saahab man vasai gurmukh a(n)mrit peau ||
20.e: The more the Lord and Master dwells within the mind, the more the Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

20.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮੇਉ ॥੩॥
20.t: man tan teraa too dhanee garab nivaar sameau ||3||
20.e: Mind and body are Yours; You are my Master. Please rid me of my pride, and let me merge with You. ||3||

20.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
20.t: jin eh jagat upaiaa tirabhavan kar aakaar ||
20.e: The One who formed this universe created the creation of the three worlds.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
20.t: gurmukh chaanan jaaneeaai manmukh mugadh gubaar ||
20.e: The Gurmukh knows the Divine Light, while the foolish self-willed manmukh gropes around in the darkness.

20.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
20.t: ghaT ghaT jot nira(n)taree boojhai gurmat saar ||4||
20.e: One who sees that Light within each and every heart understands the Essence of the Guru's Teachings. ||4||

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥
20.t: gurmukh jinee jaaniaa tin keechai saabaas ||
20.e: Those who understand are Gurmukh; recognize and applaud them.

20.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
20.t: sache setee ral mile sache gun paragaas ||
20.e: They meet and merge with the True One. They become the Radiant Manifestation of the Excellence of the True One.

20.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੫॥੧੬॥
20.t: naanak naam sa(n)tokheeaa jeeau pi(n)dd prabh paas ||5||16||
20.e: O Nanak, they are contented with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. They offer their bodies and souls to God. ||5||16||

20.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
20.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
20.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

20.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਮਿਲੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਏਹ ॥
20.t: sun man mitr piaariaa mil velaa hai eh ||
20.e: Listen, O my mind, my friend, my darling: now is the time to meet the Lord.

20.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
20.t: jab lag joban saas hai tab lag ih tan dheh ||
20.e: As long as there is youth and breath, give this body to Him.

20.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥
20.t: bin gun kaam na aaviee ddeh dderee tan kheh ||1||
20.e: Without virtue, it is useless; the body shall crumble into a pile of dust. ||1||

20.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
20.t: mere man lai laahaa ghar jaeh ||
20.e: O my mind, earn the profit, before you return home.

20.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
20.t: gurmukh naam salaaheeaai haumai nivaree bhaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
20.e: The Gurmukh praises the Naam, and the fire of egotism is extinguished. ||1||Pause||

20.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੰਢਣੁ ਗੰਢੀਐ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੜਿ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
20.t: sun sun ga(n)ddan ga(n)ddeeaai likh paR bujheh bhaar ||
20.e: Again and again, we hear and tell stories; we read and write and understand loads of knowledge,

20.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਅਗਲੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
20.t: tirasanaa ahinis agalee haumai rog vikaar ||
20.e: but still, desires increase day and night, and the disease of egotism fills us with corruption.

20.g: ਓਹੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਤੋਲਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
20.t: oh veparavaahu atolavaa gurmat keemat saar ||2||
20.e: That Carefree Lord cannot be appraised; His Real Value is known only through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

20.g: ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਲਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ॥
20.t: lakh siaanap je karee lakh siau preet milaap ||
20.e: Even if someone has hundreds of thousands of clever mental tricks, and the love and company of hundreds of thousands of people

20.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੂਖ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
20.t: bin sa(n)gat saadh na dhraapeeaa bin naavai dhookh sa(n)taap ||
20.e: still, without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he will not feel satisfied. Without the Name, all suffer in sorrow.

20.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੁ ॥੩॥
20.t: har jap jeeare chhuTeeaai gurmukh cheenai aap ||3||
20.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, O my soul, you shall be emancipated; as Gurmukh, you shall come to understand your own self. ||3||

20.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਵੇਚਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
20.t: tan man gur peh vechiaa man dheeaa sir naal ||
20.e: I have sold my body and mind to the Guru, and I have given my mind and head as well.

20.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
20.t: tirabhavan khoj dda(n)ddoliaa gurmukh khoj nihaal ||
20.e: I was seeking and searching for Him throughout the three worlds; then, as Gurmukh, I sought and found Him.

20.g: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੭॥
20.t: satagur mel milaiaa naanak so prabh naal ||4||17||
20.e: The True Guru has united me in Union, O Nanak, with that God. ||4||17||

20.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
20.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
20.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

20.g: ਮਰਣੈ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਆਸ ॥
20.t: maranai kee chi(n)taa nahee jeevan kee nahee aas ||
20.e: I have no anxiety about dying, and no hope of living.

20.g: ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੀ ਲੇਖੈ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
20.t: too sarab jeeaa pratipaalahee lekhai saas giraas ||
20.e: You are the Cherisher of all beings; You keep the account of our breaths and morsels of food.

20.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
20.t: a(n)tar gurmukh too vaseh jiau bhaavai tiau nirajaas ||1||
20.e: You abide within the Gurmukh. As it pleases You, You decide our allotment. ||1||

20.g: ਜੀਅਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
20.t: jeeare raam japat man maan ||
20.e: O my soul, chant the Name of the Lord; the mind will be pleased and appeased.

20.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਲਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
20.t: a(n)tar laagee jal bujhee paiaa gurmukh giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
20.e: The raging fire within is extinguished; the Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||

21.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੰਕ ਉਤਾਰਿ ॥
21.t: a(n)tar kee gat jaaneeaai gur mileeaai sa(n)k utaar ||
21.e: Know the state of your inner being; meet with the Guru and get rid of your skepticism.

21.g: ਮੁਇਆ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਿਤੁ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
21.t: muiaa jit ghar jaieeaai tit jeevadhiaa mar maar ||
21.e: To reach your True Home after you die, you must conquer death while you are still alive.

21.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
21.t: anahadh sabadh suhaavane paieeaai gur veechaar ||2||
21.e: The beautiful, Unstruck Sound of the Shabad is obtained, contemplating the Guru. ||2||

21.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
21.t: anahadh baanee paieeaai teh haumai hoi binaas ||
21.e: The Unstruck Melody of Gurbani is obtained, and egotism is eliminated.

21.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
21.t: satagur seve aapanaa hau sadh kurabaanai taas ||
21.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru.

21.g: ਖੜਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਈਐ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
21.t: khaR dharageh painaieeaai mukh har naam nivaas ||3||
21.e: They are dressed in robes of honor in the Court of the Lord; the Name of the Lord is on their lips. ||3||

21.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੁ ॥
21.t: jeh dhekhaa teh rav rahe siv sakatee kaa mel ||
21.e: Wherever I look, I see the Lord pervading there, in the union of Shiva and Shakti, of consciousness and matter.

21.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਬੰਧੀ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੁ ॥
21.t: tirahu gun ba(n)dhee dhehuree jo aaiaa jag so khel ||
21.e: The three qualities hold the body in bondage; whoever comes into the world is subject to their play.

21.g: ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹਹਿ ਨ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੪॥
21.t: vijogee dhukh vichhuRe manmukh laheh na mel ||4||
21.e: Those who separate themselves from the Lord wander lost in misery. The self-willed manmukhs do not attain union with Him. ||4||

21.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚ ਭੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
21.t: man bairaagee ghar vasai sach bhai raataa hoi ||
21.e: If the mind becomes balanced and detached, and comes to dwell in its own true home, imbued with the Fear of God,

21.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਹਾਰਸੁ ਭੋਗਵੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
21.t: giaan mahaaras bhogavai baahuR bhookh na hoi ||
21.e: then it enjoys the essence of supreme spiritual wisdom; it shall never feel hunger again.

21.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧੮॥
21.t: naanak ih man maar mil bhee fir dhukh na hoi ||5||18||
21.e: O Nanak, conquer and subdue this mind; meet with the Lord, and you shall never again suffer in pain. ||5||18||

21.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
21.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
21.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

21.g: ਏਹੁ ਮਨੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਲੋਭੇ ਲਗਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: eh mano moorakh lobheeaa lobhe lagaa luobhaan ||
21.e: This foolish mind is greedy; through greed, it becomes even more attached to greed.

21.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਕਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਵਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: sabadh na bheejai saakataa dhuramat aavan jaan ||
21.e: The evil-minded shaaktas, the faithless cynics, are not attuned to the Shabad; they come and go in reincarnation.

21.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
21.t: saadhoo satagur je milai taa paieeaai gunee nidhaan ||1||
21.e: One who meets with the Holy True Guru finds the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

21.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੋਡਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: man re haumai chhodd gumaan ||
21.e: O mind, renounce your egotistical pride.

21.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
21.t: har gur saravar sev too paaveh dharageh maan ||1|| rahaau ||
21.e: Serve the Lord, the Guru, the Sacred Pool, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

21.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: raam naam jap dhinas raat gurmukh har dhan jaan ||
21.e: Chant the Name of the Lord day and night; become Gurmukh, and know the Wealth of the Lord.

21.g: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
21.t: sabh sukh har ras bhogane sa(n)t sabhaa mil giaan ||
21.e: All comforts and peace, and the Essence of the Lord, are enjoyed by acquiring spiritual wisdom in the Society of the Saints.

21.g: ਨਿਤਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
21.t: nit ahinis har prabh seviaa satagur dheeaa naam ||2||
21.e: Day and night, continually serve the Lord God; the True Guru has given the Naam. ||2||

21.g: ਕੂਕਰ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: kookar kooR kamaieeaai gur ni(n)dhaa pachai pachaan ||
21.e: Those who practice falsehood are dogs; those who slander the Guru shall burn in their own fire.

21.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਖੁਲਹਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: bharame bhoolaa dhukh ghano jam maar karai khulahaan ||
21.e: They wander lost and confused, deceived by doubt, suffering in terrible pain. The Messenger of Death shall beat them to a pulp.

21.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਭਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
21.t: manmukh sukh na paieeaai gurmukh sukh subhaan ||3||
21.e: The self-willed manmukhs find no peace, while the Gurmukhs are wondrously joyful. ||3||

21.g: ਐਥੈ ਧੰਧੁ ਪਿਟਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: aaithai dha(n)dh piTaieeaai sach likhat paravaan ||
21.e: In this world, people are engrossed in false pursuits, but in the world hereafter, only the account of your true actions is accepted.

21.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
21.t: har sajan gur sevadhaa gur karanee paradhaan ||
21.e: The Guru serves the Lord, His Intimate Friend. The Guru's actions are supremely exalted.

21.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੧੯॥
21.t: naanak naam na veesarai karam sachai neesaan ||4||19||
21.e: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the True Lord shall bless you with His Mark of Grace. ||4||19||

21.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
21.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
21.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

21.g: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
21.t: eik til piaaraa veesarai rog vaddaa man maeh ||
21.e: Forgetting the Beloved, even for a moment, the mind is afflicted with terrible diseases.

21.g: ਕਿਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
21.t: kiau dharageh pat paieeaai jaa har na vasai man maeh ||
21.e: How can honor be attained in His Court, if the Lord does not dwell in the mind?

21.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
21.t: gur miliaai sukh paieeaai agan marai gun maeh ||1||
21.e: Meeting with the Guru, peace is found. The fire is extinguished in His Glorious Praises. ||1||

21.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
21.t: man re ahinis har gun saar ||
21.e: O mind, enshrine the Praises of the Lord, day and night.

21.g: ਜਿਨ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
21.t: jin khin pal naam na veesarai te jan virale sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
21.e: One who does not forget the Naam, for a moment or even an instant-how rare is such a person in this world! ||1||Pause||

21.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
21.t: jotee jot milaieeaai suratee surat sa(n)jog ||
21.e: When one's light merges into the Light, and one's intuitive consciousness is joined with the Intuitive Consciousness,

21.g: ਹਿੰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਤੁ ਗਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
21.t: hi(n)saa haumai gat ge naahee sahasaa sog ||
21.e: then one's cruel and violent instincts and egotism depart, and skepticism and sorrow are taken away.

21.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
21.t: gurmukh jis har man vasai tis mele gur sa(n)jog ||2||
21.e: The Lord abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, who merges in the Lord's Union, through the Guru. ||2||

21.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
21.t: kaiaa kaaman je karee bhoge bhoganahaar ||
21.e: If I surrender my body like a bride, the Enjoyer will enjoy me.

21.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
21.t: tis siau neh na keejiee jo dheesai chalanahaar ||
21.e: Do not make love with one who is just a passing show.

21.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
21.t: gurmukh raveh sohaaganee so prabh sej bhataar ||3||
21.e: The Gurmukh is ravished like the pure and happy bride on the Bed of God, her Husband. ||3||

22.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਮਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
22.t: chaare agan nivaar mar gurmukh har jal pai ||
22.e: The Gurmukh puts out the four fires, with the Water of the Lord's Name.

22.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਅਘਾਇ ॥
22.t: a(n)tar kamal pragaasiaa a(n)mrit bhariaa aghai ||
22.e: The lotus blossoms deep within the heart, and filled with Ambrosial Nectar, one is satisfied.

22.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੦॥
22.t: naanak satagur meet kar sach paaveh dharageh jai ||4||20||
22.e: O Nanak, make the True Guru your friend; going to His Court, you shall obtain the True Lord. ||4||20||

22.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
22.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
22.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

22.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
22.t: har har japahu piaariaa gurmat le har bol ||
22.e: Meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, O my beloved; follow the Guru's Teachings, and speak of the Lord.

22.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਚ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਤੁਲੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੋਲਿ ॥
22.t: man sach kasavaTee laieeaai tuleeaai poorai tol ||
22.e: Apply the Touchstone of Truth to your mind, and see if it comes up to its full weight.

22.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲਿ ॥੧॥
22.t: keemat kinai na paieeaai ridh maanak mol amol ||1||
22.e: No one has found the worth of the ruby of the heart; its value cannot be estimated. ||1||

22.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
22.t: bhaiee re har heeraa gur maeh ||
22.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the Diamond of the Lord is within the Guru.

22.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
22.t: satasa(n)gat satagur paieeaai ahinis sabadh salaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
22.e: The True Guru is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. Day and night, praise the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

22.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਗਾਸਿ ॥
22.t: sach vakhar dhan raas lai paieeaai gur paragaas ||
22.e: The True Merchandise, Wealth and Capital are obtained through the Radiant Light of the Guru.

22.g: ਜਿਉ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਐ ਤਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਿ ॥
22.t: jiau agan marai jal paiaai tiau tirasanaa dhaasan dhaas ||
22.e: Just as fire is extinguished by pouring on water, desire becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves.

22.g: ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਇਉ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਸਿ ॥੨॥
22.t: jam ja(n)dhaar na lagiee iau bhaujal tarai taraas ||2||
22.e: The Messenger of Death will not touch you; in this way, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean, carrying others across with you. ||2||

22.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥
22.t: gurmukh kooR na bhaaviee sach rate sach bhai ||
22.e: The Gurmukhs do not like falsehood. They are imbued with Truth; they love only Truth.

22.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਂਇ ॥
22.t: saakat sach na bhaaviee kooRai kooRee paa(n)i ||
22.e: The shaaktas, the faithless cynics, do not like the Truth; false are the foundations of the false.

22.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਐ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
22.t: sach rate gur meliaai sache sach samai ||3||
22.e: Imbued with Truth, you shall meet the Guru. The true ones are absorbed into the True Lord. ||3||

22.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਹੀਰੁ ॥
22.t: man meh maanak laal naam ratan padhaarath heer ||
22.e: Within the mind are emeralds and rubies, the Jewel of the Naam, treasures and diamonds.

22.g: ਸਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
22.t: sach vakhar dhan naam hai ghaT ghaT gahir ga(n)bheer ||
22.e: The Naam is the True Merchandise and Wealth; in each and every heart, His Presence is deep and profound.

22.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੀਰੁ ॥੪॥੨੧॥
22.t: naanak gurmukh paieeaai dhiaa kare har heer ||4||21||
22.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Diamond of the Lord, by His Kindness and Compassion. ||4||21||

22.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
22.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
22.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

22.g: ਭਰਮੇ ਭਾਹਿ ਨ ਵਿਝਵੈ ਜੇ ਭਵੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
22.t: bharame bhaeh na vijhavai je bhavai dhisa(n)tar dhes ||
22.e: The fire of doubt is not extinguished, even by wandering through foreign lands and countries.

22.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
22.t: a(n)tar mail na utarai dhirag jeevan dhirag ves ||
22.e: If inner filth is not removed, one's life is cursed, and one's clothes are cursed.

22.g: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥੧॥
22.t: hor kitai bhagat na hoviee bin satigur ke upadhes ||1||
22.e: There is no other way to perform devotional worship, except through the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||

22.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
22.t: man re gurmukh agan nivaar ||
22.e: O mind, become Gurmukh, and extinguish the fire within.

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
22.t: gur kaa kahiaa man vasai haumai tirasanaa maar ||1|| rahaau ||
22.e: Let the Words of the Guru abide within your mind; let egotism and desires die. ||1||Pause||

22.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
22.t: man maanak niramol hai raam naam pat pai ||
22.e: The jewel of the mind is priceless; through the Name of the Lord, honor is obtained.

22.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
22.t: mil satasa(n)gat har paieeaai gurmukh har liv lai ||
22.e: Join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and find the Lord. The Gurmukh embraces love for the Lord.

22.g: ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
22.t: aap giaa sukh paiaa mil salalai salal samai ||2||
22.e: Give up your selfishness, and you shall find peace; like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption. ||2||

22.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸੁ ਅਉਗੁਣਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
22.t: jin har har naam na chetio su aaugun aavai jai ||
22.e: Those who have not contemplated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are unworthy; they come and go in reincarnation.

22.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸੁ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚੈ ਪਚਾਇ ॥
22.t: jis satagur purakh na bheTio su bhaujal pachai pachai ||
22.e: One who has not met with the True Guru, the Primal Being, is bothered and bewildered in the terrifying world-ocean.

22.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਜੀਉ ਨਿਰਮੋਲੁ ਹੈ ਇਉ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
22.t: eih maanak jeeau niramol hai iau kauddee badhalai jai ||3||
22.e: This jewel of the soul is priceless, and yet it is being squandered like this, in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

22.g: ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਜਾਣ ॥
22.t: ji(n)naa satagur ras milai se poore purakh sujaan ||
22.e: Those who joyfully meet with the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and wise.

22.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
22.t: gur mil bhaujal la(n)gheeaai dharageh pat paravaan ||
22.e: Meeting with the Guru, they cross over the terrifying world-ocean. In the Court of the Lord, they are honored and approved.

22.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੨੨॥
22.t: naanak te mukh ujale dhun upajai sabadh neesaan ||4||22||
22.e: O Nanak, their faces are radiant; the Music of the Shabad, the Word of God, wells up within them. ||4||22||

22.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
22.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
22.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

22.g: ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਹੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
22.t: vanaj karahu vanajaariho vakhar leh samaal ||
22.e: Make your deals, dealers, and take care of your merchandise.

22.g: ਤੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
22.t: taisee vasat visaaheeaai jaisee nibahai naal ||
22.e: Buy that object which will go along with you.

22.g: ਅਗੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਲੈਸੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
22.t: agai saahu sujaan hai laisee vasat samaal ||1||
22.e: In the next world, the All-knowing Merchant will take this object and care for it. ||1||

22.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
22.t: bhaiee re raam kahahu chit lai ||
22.e: O Siblings of Destiny, chant the Lord's Name, and focus your consciousness on Him.

22.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਲੈ ਚਲਹੁ ਸਹੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
22.t: har jas vakhar lai chalahu sahu dhekhai pateeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
22.e: Take the Merchandise of the Lord's Praises with you. Your Husband Lord shall see this and approve. ||1||Pause||

23.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
23.t: jinaa raas na sach hai kiau tinaa sukh hoi ||
23.e: Those who do not have the Assets of Truth-how can they find peace?

23.g: ਖੋਟੈ ਵਣਜਿ ਵਣੰਜਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਟਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
23.t: khoTai vanaj vana(n)jiaai man tan khoTaa hoi ||
23.e: By dealing their deals of falsehood, their minds and bodies become false.

23.g: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਨਿਤ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
23.t: faahee faathe mirag jiau dhookh ghano nit roi ||2||
23.e: Like the deer caught in the trap, they suffer in terrible agony; they continually cry out in pain. ||2||

23.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਪੋਤੈ ਨਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
23.t: khoTe potai naa paveh tin har gur dharas na hoi ||
23.e: The counterfeit coins are not put into the Treasury; they do not obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord-Guru.

23.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਖੋਟਿ ਨ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
23.t: khoTe jaat na pat hai khoT na seejhas koi ||
23.e: The false ones have no social status or honor. No one succeeds through falsehood.

23.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
23.t: khoTe khoT kamaavanaa aai giaa pat khoi ||3||
23.e: Practicing falsehood again and again, people come and go in reincarnation, and forfeit their honor. ||3||

23.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
23.t: naanak man samajhaieeaai gur kai sabadh saalaeh ||
23.e: O Nanak, instruct your mind through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and praise the Lord.

23.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਭਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਿਨਾਹ ॥
23.t: raam naam ra(n)g ratiaa bhaar na bharam tinaeh ||
23.e: Those who are imbued with the love of the Name of the Lord are not loaded down by doubt.

23.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹ ॥੪॥੨੩॥
23.t: har jap laahaa agalaa nirabhau har man maeh ||4||23||
23.e: Those who chant the Name of the Lord earn great profits; the Fearless Lord abides within their minds. ||4||23||

23.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
23.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
23.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Second House:

23.g: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਫੁਲੜਾ ਨਾਠੀਅੜੇ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
23.t: dhan joban ar fulaRaa naaTheeaRe dhin chaar ||
23.e: Wealth, the beauty of youth and flowers are guests for only a few days.

23.g: ਪਬਣਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਪਤ ਜਿਉ ਢਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਜੁੰਮਣਹਾਰ ॥੧॥
23.t: paban kere pat jiau ddal ddul ju(n)manahaar ||1||
23.e: Like the leaves of the water-lily, they wither and fade and finally die. ||1||

23.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਜਾ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਨਉ ਹੁਲਾ ॥
23.t: ra(n)g maan lai piaariaa jaa joban nau hulaa ||
23.e: Be happy, dear beloved, as long as your youth is fresh and delightful.

23.g: ਦਿਨ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਥਕੇ ਭਇਆ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
23.t: dhin thoRaRe thake bhiaa puraanaa cholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
23.e: But your days are few-you have grown weary, and now your body has grown old. ||1||Pause||

23.g: ਸਜਣ ਮੇਰੇ ਰੰਗੁਲੇ ਜਾਇ ਸੁਤੇ ਜੀਰਾਣਿ ॥
23.t: sajan mere ra(n)gule jai sute jeeraan ||
23.e: My playful friends have gone to sleep in the graveyard.

23.g: ਹੰ ਭੀ ਵੰਞਾ ਡੁਮਣੀ ਰੋਵਾ ਝੀਣੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
23.t: ha(n) bhee va(n)n(j)aa ddumanee rovaa jheenee baan ||2||
23.e: In my double-mindedness, I shall have to go as well. I cry in a feeble voice. ||2||

23.g: ਕੀ ਨ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ ਗੋਰੀਏ ਆਪਣ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
23.t: kee na sunehee gore'e aapan ka(n)nee soi ||
23.e: Haven't you heard the call from beyond, O beautiful soul-bride?

23.g: ਲਗੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਪੇਈਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
23.t: lagee aaveh saahurai nit na peieeaa hoi ||3||
23.e: You must go to your in-laws; you cannot stay with your parents forever. ||3||

23.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਤੀ ਪੇਈਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਵਿਰਤੀ ਸੰਨਿ ॥
23.t: naanak sutee peieeaai jaan viratee sa(n)n ||
23.e: O Nanak, know that she who sleeps in her parents' home is plundered in broad daylight.

23.g: ਗੁਣਾ ਗਵਾਈ ਗੰਠੜੀ ਅਵਗਣ ਚਲੀ ਬੰਨਿ ॥੪॥੨੪॥
23.t: gunaa gavaiee ga(n)ThaRee avagan chalee ba(n)n ||4||24||
23.e: She has lost her bouquet of merits; gathering one of demerits, she departs. ||4||24||

23.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ੨ ॥
23.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar dhoojaa 2 ||
23.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Second House:

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਆਪਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
23.t: aape raseeaa aap ras aape raavanahaar ||
23.e: He Himself is the Enjoyer, and He Himself is the Enjoyment. He Himself is the Ravisher of all.

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਚੋਲੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
23.t: aape hovai cholaRaa aape sej bhataar ||1||
23.e: He Himself is the Bride in her dress, He Himself is the Bridegroom on the bed. ||1||

23.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
23.t: ra(n)g rataa meraa saahib rav rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
23.e: My Lord and Master is imbued with love; He is totally permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਛੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਜਾਲੁ ॥
23.t: aape maachhee machhulee aape paanee jaal ||
23.e: He Himself is the fisherman and the fish; He Himself is the water and the net.

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਾਲ ਮਣਕੜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
23.t: aape jaal manakaRaa aape a(n)dhar laal ||2||
23.e: He Himself is the sinker, and He Himself is the bait. ||2||

23.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
23.t: aape bahu bidh ra(n)gulaa sakhe'ee meraa laal ||
23.e: He Himself loves in so many ways. O sister soul-brides, He is my Beloved.

23.g: ਨਿਤ ਰਵੈ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੩॥
23.t: nit ravai sohaaganee dhekh hamaaraa haal ||3||
23.e: He continually ravishes and enjoys the happy soul-brides; just look at the plight I am in without Him! ||3||

23.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਤੂ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਤੂ ਹੰਸੁ ॥
23.t: pranavai naanak benatee too saravar too ha(n)s ||
23.e: Prays Nanak, please hear my prayer: You are the pool, and You are the soul-swan.

23.g: ਕਉਲੁ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਕਵੀਆ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ॥੪॥੨੫॥
23.t: kaul too hai kaveeaa too hai aape vekh vigas ||4||25||
23.e: You are the lotus flower of the day and You are the water-lily of the night. You Yourself behold them, and blossom forth in bliss. ||4||25||

23.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
23.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar teejaa ||
23.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:

23.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਰੋ ਸਲਿਲ ਆਪਾਉ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਪਾਣੀ ॥
23.t: eih tan dharatee beej karamaa karo salil aapaau saari(n)gapaanee ||
23.e: Make this body the field, and plant the seed of good actions. Water it with the Name of the Lord, who holds all the world in His Hands.

23.g: ਮਨੁ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਇਉ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
23.t: man kirasaan har ridhai ja(n)mai lai iau paavas padh nirabaanee ||1||
23.e: Let your mind be the farmer; the Lord shall sprout in your heart, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

23.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
23.t: kaahe garabas mooRe maiaa ||
23.e: You fool! Why are you so proud of Maya?

23.g: ਪਿਤ ਸੁਤੋ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
23.t: pit suto sagal kaalatr maataa tere hoh na a(n)t sakhaiaa || rahaau ||
23.e: Father, children, spouse, mother and all relatives-they shall not be your helpers in the end. ||Pause||

23.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਿਰਖਾ ਕਰੇ ਇਨ ਤਜਿ ਆਤਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
23.t: bikhai bikaar dhusaT kirakhaa kare in taj aatamai hoi dhiaaiee ||
23.e: So weed out evil, wickedness and corruption; leave these behind, and let your soul meditate on God.

23.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਬ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮਧੁ ਆਸ੍ਰਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
23.t: jap tap sa(n)jam hoh jab raakhe kamal bigasai madh aasramaiee ||2||
23.e: When chanting, austere meditation and self-discipline become your protectors, then the lotus blossoms forth, and the honey trickles out. ||2||

23.g: ਬੀਸ ਸਪਤਾਹਰੋ ਬਾਸਰੋ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਖੋੜਾ ਨਿਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਾਰੈ ॥
23.t: bees sapataaharo baasaro sa(n)grahai teen khoRaa nit kaal saarai ||
23.e: Bring the twenty-seven elements of the body under your control, and throughout the three stages of life, remember death.

23.g: ਦਸ ਅਠਾਰ ਮੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੋ ਚੀਨੈ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਵ ਏਕੁ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥੨੬॥
23.t: dhas aThaar mai apara(n)paro cheenai kahai naanak iv ek taarai ||3||26||
23.e: See the Infinite Lord in the ten directions, and in all the variety of nature. Says Nanak, in this way, the One Lord shall carry you across. ||3||26||

24.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:

24.g: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
24.t: amal kar dharatee beej sabadho kar sach kee aab nit dheh paanee ||
24.e: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

24.g: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
24.t: hoi kirasaan ieemaan ja(n)mai lai bhisat dhojak mooRe ev jaanee ||1||
24.e: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||
Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

24.g: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
24.t: maal kai maanai roop kee sobhaa it bidhee janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
24.e: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

24.g: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
24.t: aaib tan chikaRo ih man meeddako kamal kee saar nahee mool paiee ||
24.e: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

24.g: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
24.t: bhaur usataadh nit bhaakhiaa bole kiau boojhai jaa neh bujhaiee ||2||
24.e: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

24.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
24.t: aakhan sunanaa paun kee baanee ih man rataa maiaa ||
24.e: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

24.g: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
24.t: khasam kee nadhar dhileh pasi(n)dhe jinee kar ek dhiaaiaa ||3||
24.e: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

24.g: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
24.t: teeh kar rakhe pa(n)j kar saathee naau saitaan mat kaT jaiee ||
24.e: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

24.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
24.t: naanak aakhai raeh pai chalanaa maal dhan kit koo sa(n)jiaahee ||4||27||
24.e: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

24.g: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
24.t: soiee maulaa jin jag mauliaa hariaa keeaa sa(n)saaro ||
24.e: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

24.g: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
24.t: aab khaak jin ba(n)dh rahaiee dha(n)n sirajanahaaro ||1||
24.e: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||
Death, O Mullah-death will come,
so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

24.g: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
24.t: taa too mulaa taa too kaajee jaaneh naam khudhaiee ||
24.e: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

24.g: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
24.t: je bahuteraa paRiaa hoveh ko rahai na bhareeaai paiee ||2||
24.e: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

24.g: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
24.t: soiee kaajee jin aap tajiaa ik naam keeaa aadhaaro ||
24.e: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

24.g: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
24.t: hai bhee hosee jai na jaasee sachaa sirajanahaaro ||3||
24.e: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

24.g: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
24.t: pa(n)j vakhat nivaaj gujaareh paReh kateb kuraanaa ||
24.e: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

24.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
24.t: naanak aakhai gor sadheiee rahio peenaa khaanaa ||4||28||
24.e: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:
The dogs of greed are with me.
In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.
