Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

24.g: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
24.t: mai pat kee pa(n)dh na karanee kee kaar ||
24.e: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.
I am deformed and horribly disfigured.
Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

24.g: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
24.t: mai ehaa aas eho aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
24.e: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||
With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!
Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||
I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.
I am a robber-I rob the world.
I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||
I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

24.g: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
24.t: hau kiaa muh dhesaa dhusaT chor ||
24.e: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.
Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:
There is one awareness among all created beings.
None have been created without this awareness.

25.e: As is their awareness, so is their way.
According to the account of our actions, we come and go in reincarnation. ||1||
Why, O soul, do you try such clever tricks?

25.g: ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਵੈ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.t: levai dhevai ddil na paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
25.e: Taking away and giving back, God does not delay. ||1||Pause||
All beings belong to You; all beings are Yours. O Lord and Master,
how can You become angry with them?
Even if You, O Lord and Master, become angry with them,
still, You are theirs, and they are Yours. ||2||
We are foul-mouthed; we spoil everything with our foul words.
You weigh us in the balance of Your Glance of Grace.
When one's actions are right, the understanding is perfect.
Without good deeds, it becomes more and more deficient. ||3||
Prays Nanak, what is the nature of the spiritual people?
They are self-realized; they understand God.
By Guru's Grace, they contemplate Him;
such spiritual people are honored in His Court. ||4||30||
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:

25.g: ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ਮੈ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਲਹਾ ॥
25.t: too dhareeaau dhaanaa beenaa mai machhulee kaise a(n)t lahaa ||
25.e: You are the River, All-knowing and All-seeing. I am just a fish-how can I find Your limit?

25.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੧॥
25.t: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh teh too hai tujh te nikasee fooT maraa ||1||
25.e: Wherever I look, You are there. Outside of You, I would burst and die. ||1||

25.g: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਉ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
25.t: n jaanaa meau na jaanaa jaalee ||
25.e: I do not know of the fisherman, and I do not know of the net.

25.g: ਜਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਾ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.t: jaa dhukh laagai taa tujhai samaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
25.e: But when the pain comes, then I call upon You. ||1||Pause||
You are present everywhere. I had thought that You were far away.

25.g: ਜੋ ਕਛੁ ਕਰੀ ਸੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
25.t: jo kachh karee su terai hadhoor ||
25.e: Whatever I do, I do in Your Presence.
You see all my actions, and yet I deny them.
I have not worked for You, or Your Name. ||2||
Whatever You give me, that is what I eat.

25.g: ਬਿਆ ਦਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
25.t: biaa dhar naahee kai dhar jaau ||
25.e: There is no other door-unto which door should I go?
Nanak offers this one prayer:
this body and soul are totally Yours. ||3||

25.g: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪੇ ਮੰਝਿ ਮਿਆਨੋੁ ॥
25.t: aape neRai dhoor aape hee aape ma(n)jh miaanuo ||
25.e: He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away; He Himself is in-between.

25.g: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਹਾਨੋੁ ॥
25.t: aape vekhai sune aape hee kudharat kare jahaanuo ||
25.e: He Himself beholds, and He Himself listens. By His Creative Power, He created the world.

25.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਵਾਨੋੁ ॥੪॥੩੧॥
25.t: jo tis bhaavai naanakaa hukam soiee paravaanuo ||4||31||
25.e: Whatever pleases Him, O Nanak-that Command is acceptable. ||4||31||
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fourth House:
Why should the created beings feel pride in their minds?
The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver.
As it pleases Him, He may give, or not give.
What can be done by the order of the created beings? ||1||
He Himself is True; Truth is pleasing to His Will.
The spiritually blind are unripe and imperfect, inferior and worthless. ||1||Pause||
The One who owns the trees of the forest and the plants of the garden
according to their nature, He gives them all their names.
The Flower and the Fruit of the Lord's Love are obtained by pre-ordained destiny.
As we plant, so we harvest and eat. ||2||
The wall of the body is temporary, as is the soul-mason within it.
The flavor of the intellect is bland and insipid without the Salt.
O Nanak, as He wills, He makes things right.
Without the Name, no one is approved. ||3||32||
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Fifth House:

25.g: ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਈ ਨਹ ਛਲੈ ਨਹ ਘਾਉ ਕਟਾਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਕੈ ॥
25.t: achhal chhalaiee neh chhalai neh ghaau kaTaaraa kar sakai ||
25.e: The Undeceiveable is not deceived by deception. He cannot be wounded by any dagger.

25.g: ਜਿਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਟਲ ਪਲੈ ॥੧॥
25.t: jiau saahib raakhai tiau rahai is lobhee kaa jeeau Tal palai ||1||
25.e: As our Lord and Master keeps us, so do we exist. The soul of this greedy person is tossed this way and that. ||1||

25.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਤੇਲ ਦੀਵਾ ਕਿਉ ਜਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.t: bin tel dheevaa kiau jalai ||1|| rahaau ||
25.e: Without the oil, how can the lamp be lit? ||1||Pause||

25.g: ਪੋਥੀ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥ ਭਉ ਵਟੀ ਇਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
25.t: pothee puraan kamaieeaai || bhau vaTee it tan paieeaai ||
25.e: Let the reading of your prayer book be the oil, and let the Fear of God be the wick for the lamp of this body.
Light this lamp with the understanding of Truth. ||2||
Use this oil to light this lamp.

25.g: ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤਉ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
25.t: kar chaanan saahib tau milai ||1|| rahaau ||
25.e: Light it, and meet your Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
This body is softened with the Word of the Guru's Bani;
you shall find peace, doing seva (selfless service).

26.g: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀਆ ॥੩॥
26.t: sabh dhuneeaa aavan jaaneeaa ||3||
26.e: All the world continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||

26.g: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
26.t: vich dhuneeaa sev kamaieeaai ||
26.e: In the midst of this world, do seva,

26.g: ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
26.t: taa dharageh baisan paieeaai ||
26.e: and you shall be given a place of honor in the Court of the Lord.

26.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੩੩॥
26.t: kahu naanak baeh luddaieeaai ||4||33||
26.e: Says Nanak, swing your arms in joy! ||4||33||

26.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧
26.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa
26.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla, First House:

26.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
26.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
26.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

26.g: ਹਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
26.t: hau satigur sevee aapanaa ik man ik chit bhai ||
26.e: I serve my True Guru with single-minded devotion, and lovingly focus my consciousness on Him.

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਨ ਕਾਮਨਾ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
26.t: satigur man kaamanaa teerath hai jis no dhei bujhai ||
26.e: The True Guru is the mind's desire and the sacred shrine of pilgrimage, for those unto whom He has given this understanding.

26.g: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਾ ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
26.t: man chi(n)dhiaa var paavanaa jo ichhai so fal pai ||
26.e: The blessings of the wishes of the mind are obtained, and the fruits of one's desires.

26.g: ਨਾਉ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
26.t: naau dhiaaieeaai naau ma(n)geeaai naame sahaj samai ||1||
26.e: Meditate on the Name, worship the Name, and through the Name, you shall be absorbed in intuitive peace and poise. ||1||

26.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
26.t: man mere har ras chaakh tikh jai ||
26.e: O my mind, drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and your thirst shall be quenched.

26.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
26.t: jinee gurmukh chaakhiaa sahaje rahe samai ||1|| rahaau ||
26.e: Those Gurmukhs who have tasted it remain intuitively absorbed in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

26.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
26.t: jinee satigur seviaa tinee paiaa naam nidhaan ||
26.e: Those who serve the True Guru obtain the Treasure of the Naam.

26.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
26.t: a(n)tar har ras rav rahiaa chookaa man abhimaan ||
26.e: Deep within, they are drenched with the Essence of the Lord, and the egotistical pride of the mind is subdued.

26.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਮਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
26.t: hiradhai kamal pragaasiaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||
26.e: The heart-lotus blossoms forth, and they intuitively center themselves in meditation.

26.g: ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
26.t: man niramal har rav rahiaa paiaa dharageh maan ||2||
26.e: Their minds become pure, and they remain immersed in the Lord; they are honored in His Court. ||2||

26.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
26.t: satigur sevan aapanaa te virale sa(n)saar ||
26.e: Those who serve the True Guru in this world are very rare.

26.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
26.t: haumai mamataa maar kai har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
26.e: Those who keep the Lord enshrined in their hearts subdue egotism and possessiveness.

26.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
26.t: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinaa naame lagaa piaar ||
26.e: I am a sacrifice to those who are in love with the Naam.

26.g: ਸੇਈ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
26.t: seiee sukhe'ee chahu jugee jinaa naam akhuT apaar ||3||
26.e: Those who attain the Inexhaustible Name of the Infinite Lord remain happy throughout the four ages. ||3||

26.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
26.t: gur miliaai naam paieeaai chookai moh piaas ||
26.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam is obtained, and the thirst of emotional attachment departs.

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
26.t: har setee man rav rahiaa ghar hee maeh udhaas ||
26.e: When the mind is permeated with the Lord, one remains detached within the home of the heart.

26.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
26.t: jinaa har kaa saadh aaiaa hau tin balihaarai jaas ||
26.e: I am a sacrifice to those who enjoy the Sublime Taste of the Lord.

26.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
26.t: naanak nadharee paieeaai sach naam gunataas ||4||1||34||
26.e: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace, the True Name, the Treasure of Excellence, is obtained. ||4||1||34||

26.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
26.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
26.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

26.g: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਈਐ ਮਨਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
26.t: bahu bhekh kar bharamaieeaai man hiradhai kapaT kamai ||
26.e: People wear all sorts of costumes and wander all around, but in their hearts and minds, they practice deception.

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਮਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
26.t: har kaa mahal na paaviee mar visaTaa maeh samai ||1||
26.e: They do not attain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and after death, they sink into manure. ||1||

26.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
26.t: man re gireh hee maeh udhaas ||
26.e: O mind, remain detached in the midst of your household.

26.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
26.t: sach sa(n)jam karanee so kare gurmukh hoi paragaas ||1|| rahaau ||
26.e: Practicing truth, self-discipline and good deeds, the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||1||Pause||

26.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਗਤਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰੈ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
26.t: gur kai sabadh man jeetiaa gat mukat gharai meh pai ||
26.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the mind is conquered, and one attains the State of Liberation in one's own home.

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
26.t: har kaa naam dhiaaieeaai satasa(n)gat mel milai ||2||
26.e: So meditate on the Name of the Lord; join and merge with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||2||

26.g: ਜੇ ਲਖ ਇਸਤਰੀਆ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
26.t: je lakh isatareeaa bhog kareh nav kha(n)dd raaj kamaeh ||
26.e: You may enjoy the pleasures of hundreds of thousands of women, and rule the nine continents of the world.

26.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
26.t: bin satigur sukh na paaviee fir fir jonee paeh ||3||
26.e: But without the True Guru, you will not find peace; you will be reincarnated over and over again. ||3||

26.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਹਿਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
26.t: har haar ka(n)Th jinee pahiriaa gur charanee chit lai ||
26.e: Those who wear the Necklace of the Lord around their necks, and focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet

26.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਿਛੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
26.t: tinaa pichhai ridh sidh firai onaa til na tamai ||4||
26.e: -wealth and supernatural spiritual powers follow them, but they do not care for such things at all. ||4||

26.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
26.t: jo prabh bhaavai so theeaai avar na karanaa jai ||
26.e: Whatever pleases God's Will comes to pass. Nothing else can be done.

26.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥੩੫॥
26.t: jan naanak jeevai naam lai har dhevahu sahaj subhai ||5||2||35||
26.e: Servant Nanak lives by chanting the Naam. O Lord, please give it to me, in Your Natural Way. ||5||2||35||

27.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
27.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa ||
27.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla, First House:

27.g: ਜਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਿਰਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
27.t: jis hee kee sirakaar hai tis hee kaa sabh koi ||
27.e: Everyone belongs to the One who rules the Universe.

27.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
27.t: gurmukh kaar kamaavanee sach ghaT paragaT hoi ||
27.e: The Gurmukh practices good deeds, and the truth is revealed in the heart.

27.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
27.t: a(n)tar jis kai sach vasai sache sachee soi ||
27.e: True is the reputation of the true, within whom truth abides.

27.g: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
27.t: sach mile se na vichhuReh tin nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||1||
27.e: Those who meet the True Lord are not separated again; they come to dwell in the home of the self deep within. ||1||

27.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
27.t: mere raam mai har bin avar na koi ||
27.e: O my Lord! Without the Lord, I have no other at all.

27.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
27.t: satagur sach prabh niramalaa sabadh milaavaa hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
27.e: The True Guru leads us to meet the Immaculate True God through the Word of His Shabad. ||1||Pause||

27.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
27.t: sabadh milai so mil rahai jis nau aape le milai ||
27.e: One whom the Lord merges into Himself is merged in the Shabad, and remains so merged.

27.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੋ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
27.t: dhoojai bhai ko naa milai fir fir aavai jai ||
27.e: No one merges with Him through the love of duality; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation.

27.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
27.t: sabh meh ik varatadhaa eko rahiaa samai ||
27.e: The One Lord permeates all. The One Lord is pervading everywhere.

27.g: ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
27.t: jis nau aap dhiaal hoi so gurmukh naam samai ||2||
27.e: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord shows His Kindness, is absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

27.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵਾਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
27.t: paR paR pa(n)ddit jotakee vaadh kareh beechaar ||
27.e: After all their reading, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the astrologers argue and debate.

27.g: ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਵੀ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
27.t: mat budh bhavee na bujhiee a(n)tar lobh vikaar ||
27.e: Their intellect and understanding are perverted; they just don't understand. They are filled with greed and corruption.

27.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
27.t: lakh chauraaseeh bharamadhe bhram bhram hoi khuaar ||
27.e: Through 8.4 million incarnations they wander lost and confused; through all their wandering and roaming, they are ruined.

27.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
27.t: poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa koi na meTanahaar ||3||
27.e: They act according to their pre-ordained destiny, which no one can erase. ||3||

27.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
27.t: satagur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir dheejai aap gavai ||
27.e: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru. Surrender your head; give up your selfishness.

27.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
27.t: sabadh mileh taa har milai sevaa pavai sabh thai ||
27.e: Realizing the Shabad, one meets with the Lord, and all one's service is accepted.

27.g: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
27.t: paaras parasiaai paaras hoi jotee jot samai ||
27.e: By personally experiencing the Personality of the Guru, one's own personality is uplifted, and one's light merges into the Light.

27.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੪॥
27.t: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin satagur miliaa aai ||4||
27.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny come to meet the True Guru. ||4||

27.g: ਮਨ ਭੁਖਾ ਭੁਖਾ ਮਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਤ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
27.t: man bhukhaa bhukhaa mat kareh mat too kareh pookaar ||
27.e: O mind, don't cry out that you are hungry, always hungry; stop complaining.

27.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
27.t: lakh chauraaseeh jin siree sabhasai dhei adhaar ||
27.e: The One who created the 8.4 million species of beings gives sustenance to all.

27.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
27.t: nirabhau sadhaa dhiaal hai sabhanaa karadhaa saar ||
27.e: The Fearless Lord is forever Merciful; He takes care of all.

27.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੫॥੩॥੩੬॥
27.t: naanak gurmukh bujheeaai paieeaai mokh dhuaar ||5||3||36||
27.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, and finds the Door of Liberation. ||5||3||36||

27.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
27.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
27.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

27.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
27.t: jinee sun kai ma(n)niaa tinaa nij ghar vaas ||
27.e: Those who hear and believe, find the home of the self deep within.

27.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
27.t: gurmatee saalaeh sach har paiaa gunataas ||
27.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, they praise the True Lord; they find the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence.

27.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥
27.t: sabadh rate se niramale hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||
27.e: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, they are immaculate and pure. I am forever a sacrifice to them.

27.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਹੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
27.t: hiradhai jin kai har vasai tit ghaT hai paragaas ||1||
27.e: Those people, within whose hearts the Lord abides, are radiant and enlightened. ||1||

27.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
27.t: man mere har har niramal dhiaai ||
27.e: O my mind, meditate on the Immaculate Lord, Har, Har.

27.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
27.t: dhur masatak jin kau likhiaa se gurmukh rahe liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
27.e: Those whose have such pre-ordained destiny written on their foreheads-those Gurmukhs remain absorbed in the Lord's Love. ||1||Pause||

27.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
27.t: har sa(n)tahu dhekhahu nadhar kar nikaT vasai bharapoor ||
27.e: O Saints, see clearly that the Lord is near at hand; He is pervading everywhere.

27.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
27.t: gurmat jinee pachhaaniaa se dhekheh sadhaa hadhoor ||
27.e: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings realize Him, and see Him Ever-present.

27.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਤਿਨ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
27.t: jin gun tin sadh man vasai aaugunava(n)tiaa dhoor ||
27.e: He dwells forever in the minds of the virtuous. He is far removed from those worthless people who lack virtue.

27.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗੁਣ ਤੈ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਦੇ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
27.t: manmukh gun tai baahare bin naavai maradhe jhoor ||2||
27.e: The self-willed manmukhs are totally without virtue. Without the Name, they die in frustration. ||2||

27.g: ਜਿਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
27.t: jin sabadh guroo sun ma(n)niaa tin man dhiaaiaa har soi ||
27.e: Those who hear and believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad, meditate on the Lord in their minds.

27.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
27.t: anadhin bhagatee ratiaa man tan niramal hoi ||
27.e: Night and day, they are steeped in devotion; their minds and bodies become pure.

27.g: ਕੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
27.t: kooRaa ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kaa binas jai dhukh roi ||
27.e: The color of the world is false and weak; when it washes away, people cry out in pain.

27.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਓਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
27.t: jis a(n)dhar naam pragaas hai oh sadhaa sadhaa thir hoi ||3||
27.e: Those who have the Radiant Light of the Naam within, become steady and stable, forever and ever. ||3||

28.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
28.t: eih janam padhaarath pai kai har naam na chetai liv lai ||
28.e: The blessing of this human life has been obtained, but still, people do not lovingly focus their thoughts on the Name of the Lord.

28.g: ਪਗਿ ਖਿਸਿਐ ਰਹਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਆਗੈ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
28.t: pag khisiaai rahanaa nahee aagai Thaur na pai ||
28.e: Their feet slip, and they cannot stay here any longer. And in the next world, they find no place of rest at all.

28.g: ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
28.t: oh velaa hath na aaviee a(n)t giaa pachhutai ||
28.e: This opportunity shall not come again. In the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

28.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
28.t: jis nadhar kare so ubarai har setee liv lai ||4||
28.e: Those whom the Lord blesses with His Glance of Grace are saved; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

28.g: ਦੇਖਾ ਦੇਖੀ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
28.t: dhekhaa dhekhee sabh kare manmukh boojh na pai ||
28.e: They all show off and pretend, but the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

28.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ ਸੇਵ ਪਈ ਤਿਨ ਥਾਇ ॥
28.t: jin gurmukh hiradhaa sudh hai sev piee tin thai ||
28.e: Those Gurmukhs who are pure of heart-their service is accepted.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
28.t: har gun gaaveh har nit paReh har gun gai samai ||
28.e: They sing the Glorious Praise of the Lord; they read about the Lord each day. Singing the Praise of the Lord, they merge in absorption.

28.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੭॥
28.t: naanak tin kee baanee sadhaa sach hai j naam rahe liv lai ||5||4||37||
28.e: O Nanak, the words of those who are lovingly attuned to the Naam are true forever. ||5||4||37||

28.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
28.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
28.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

28.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
28.t: jinee ik man naam dhiaaiaa gurmatee veechaar ||
28.e: Those who meditate single-mindedly on the Naam, and contemplate the Teachings of the Guru

28.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਸਦ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
28.t: tin ke mukh sadh ujale tit sachai dharabaar ||
28.e: -their faces are forever radiant in the Court of the True Lord.

28.g: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
28.t: oi a(n)mrit peeveh sadhaa sadhaa sachai naam piaar ||1||
28.e: They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar forever and ever, and they love the True Name. ||1||

28.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
28.t: bhaiee re gurmukh sadhaa pat hoi ||
28.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the Gurmukhs are honored forever.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
28.t: har har sadhaa dhiaaieeaai mal haumai kaddai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
28.e: They meditate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, and they wash off the filth of egotism. ||1||Pause||

28.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
28.t: manmukh naam na jaananee vin naavai pat jai ||
28.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Naam. Without the Name, they lose their honor.

28.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਲਾਗੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
28.t: sabadhai saadh na aaio laage dhoojai bhai ||
28.e: They do not savor the Taste of the Shabad; they are attached to the love of duality.

28.g: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ ਪਵਹਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਸੇ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
28.t: visaTaa ke keeRe paveh vich visaTaa se visaTaa maeh samai ||2||
28.e: They are worms in the filth of manure. They fall into manure, and into manure they are absorbed. ||2||

28.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
28.t: tin kaa janam safal hai jo chaleh satagur bhai ||
28.e: Fruitful are the lives of those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

28.g: ਕੁਲੁ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
28.t: kul udhaareh aapanaa dha(n)n janedhee mai ||
28.e: Their families are saved; blessed are the mothers who gave birth to them.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਨਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
28.t: har har naam dhiaaieeaai jis nau kirapaa kare rajai ||3||
28.e: By His Will He grants His Grace; those who are so blessed, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

28.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
28.t: jinee gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa vichahu aap gavai ||
28.e: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; they eradicate selfishness and conceit from within.

28.g: ਓਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
28.t: oi a(n)dharahu baaharahu niramale sache sach samai ||
28.e: They are pure, inwardly and outwardly; they merge into the Truest of the True.

28.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੮॥
28.t: naanak aae se paravaan heh jin gurmatee har dhiaai ||4||5||38||
28.e: O Nanak, blessed is the coming of those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord. ||4||5||38||

28.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
28.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
28.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
28.t: har bhagataa har dhan raas hai gur poochh kareh vaapaar ||
28.e: The devotees of the Lord have the Wealth and Capital of the Lord; with Guru's Advice, they carry on their trade.

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
28.t: har naam salaahan sadhaa sadhaa vakhar har naam adhaar ||
28.e: They praise the Name of the Lord forever and ever. The Name of the Lord is their Merchandise and Support.

28.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
28.t: gur poorai har naam dhiraRaiaa har bhagataa atuT bha(n)ddaar ||1||
28.e: The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord into the Lord's devotees; it is an Inexhaustible Treasure. ||1||

28.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
28.t: bhaiee re is man kau samajhai ||
28.e: O Siblings of Destiny, instruct your minds in this way.

28.g: ਏ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
28.t: e man aalas kiaa kareh gurmukh naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
28.e: O mind, why are you so lazy? Become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam. ||1||Pause||

28.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
28.t: har bhagat har kaa piaar hai je gurmukh kare beechaar ||
28.e: Devotion to the Lord is love for the Lord. The Gurmukh reflects deeply and contemplates.

28.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਬੋਲੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
28.t: paakha(n)dd bhagat na hoviee dhubidhaa bol khuaar ||
28.e: Hypocrisy is not devotion-speaking words of duality leads only to misery.

28.g: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਰਲਾਇਆ ਨਾ ਰਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
28.t: so jan ralaiaa naa ralai jis a(n)tar bibek beechaar ||2||
28.e: Those humble beings who are filled with keen understanding and meditative contemplation-even though they intermingle with others, they remain distinct. ||2||

28.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
28.t: so sevak har aakheeaai jo har raakhai ur dhaar ||
28.e: Those who keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts are said to be the servants of the Lord.

28.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
28.t: man tan saupe aagai dhare haumai vichahu maar ||
28.e: Placing mind and body in offering before the Lord, they conquer and eradicate egotism from within.

28.g: ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
28.t: dhan gurmukh so paravaan hai j kadhe na aavai haar ||3||
28.e: Blessed and acclaimed is that Gurmukh, who shall never be defeated. ||3||

28.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
28.t: karam milai taa paieeaai vin karamai paiaa na jai ||
28.e: Those who receive His Grace find Him. Without His Grace, He cannot be found.

29.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਤਰਸਦੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ॥
29.t: lakh chauraaseeh tarasadhe jis mele so milai har aai ||
29.e: The 8.4 million species of beings all yearn for the Lord. Those whom He unites, come to be united with the Lord.

29.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੯॥
29.t: naanak gurmukh har paiaa sadhaa har naam samai ||4||6||39||
29.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh finds the Lord, and remains forever absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||4||6||39||

29.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
29.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
29.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

29.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
29.t: sukh saagar har naam hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||
29.e: The Name of the Lord is the Ocean of Peace; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

29.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
29.t: anadhin naam dhiaaieeaai sahaje naam samai ||
29.e: Meditating on the Naam, night and day, they are easily and intuitively absorbed in the Naam.

29.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
29.t: a(n)dhar rachai har sach siau rasanaa har gun gai ||1||
29.e: Their inner beings are immersed in the True Lord; they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

29.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
29.t: bhaiee re jag dhukheeaa dhoojai bhai ||
29.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the world is in misery, engrossed in the love of duality.

29.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
29.t: gur saranaiee sukh laheh anadhin naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
29.e: In the Sanctuary of the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Naam night and day. ||1||Pause||

29.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
29.t: saache mail na laagiee man niramal har dhiaai ||
29.e: The truthful ones are not stained by filth. Meditating on the Lord, their minds remain pure.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
29.t: gurmukh sabadh pachhaaneeaai har a(n)mirat naam samai ||
29.e: The Gurmukhs realize the Word of the Shabad; they are immersed in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name.

29.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
29.t: gur giaan pracha(n)dd balaiaa agiaan a(n)dheraa jai ||2||
29.e: The Guru has lit the brilliant light of spiritual wisdom, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. ||2||

29.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
29.t: manmukh maile mal bhare haumai tirasanaa vikaar ||
29.e: The self-willed manmukhs are polluted. They are filled with the pollution of egotism, wickedness and desire.

29.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
29.t: bin sabadhai mail na utarai mar ja(n)meh hoi khuaar ||
29.e: Without the Shabad, this pollution is not washed off; through the cycle of death and rebirth, they waste away in misery.

29.g: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
29.t: dhaatur baajee palach rahe naa uravaar na paar ||3||
29.e: Engrossed in this transitory drama, they are not at home in either this world or the next. ||3||

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
29.t: gurmukh jap tap sa(n)jamee har kai naam piaar ||
29.e: For the Gurmukh, the love of the Name of the Lord is chanting, deep meditation and self-discipline.

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
29.t: gurmukh sadhaa dhiaaieeaai ek naam karataar ||
29.e: The Gurmukh meditates forever on the Name of the One Creator Lord.

29.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੭॥੪੦॥
29.t: naanak naam dhiaaieeaai sabhanaa jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||4||7||40||
29.e: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Support of all beings. ||4||7||40||

29.g: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
29.t: sreeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
29.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

29.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
29.t: manmukh moh viaapiaa bairaag udhaasee na hoi ||
29.e: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment; they are not balanced or detached.

29.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
29.t: sabadh na cheenai sadhaa dhukh har dharageh pat khoi ||
29.e: They do not comprehend the Word of the Shabad. They suffer in pain forever, and lose their honor in the Court of the Lord.

29.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਈਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
29.t: haumai gurmukh khoieeaai naam rate sukh hoi ||1||
29.e: The Gurmukhs shed their ego; attuned to the Naam, they find peace. ||1||

29.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਨਿਤ ਆਸਾ ॥
29.t: mere man ahinis poor rahee nit aasaa ||
29.e: O my mind, day and night, you are always full of wishful hopes.

29.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਰਜਲੈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
29.t: satagur sev moh parajalai ghar hee maeh udhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
29.e: Serve the True Guru, and your emotional attachment shall be totally burnt away; remain detached within the home of your heart. ||1||Pause||

29.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥
29.t: gurmukh karam kamaavai bigasai har bairaag ana(n)dh ||
29.e: The Gurmukhs do good deeds and blossom forth; balanced and detached in the Lord, they are in ecstasy.

29.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਚੰਦੁ ॥
29.t: ahinis bhagat kare dhin raatee haumai maar nicha(n)dh ||
29.e: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night; subduing their ego, they are carefree.

29.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਨੰਦੁ ॥੨॥
29.t: vaddai bhaag satasa(n)gat paiee har paiaa sahaj ana(n)dh ||2||
29.e: By great good fortune, I found the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; I have found the Lord, with intuitive ease and ecstasy. ||2||

29.g: ਸੋ ਸਾਧੂ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੋਈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
29.t: so saadhoo bairaagee soiee hiradhai naam vasaae ||
29.e: That person is a Holy Saadhu, and a renouncer of the world, whose heart is filled with the Naam.

29.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਨ ਤਾਮਸੁ ਮੂਲੇ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
29.t: a(n)tar laag na taamas moole vichahu aap gavaae ||
29.e: His inner being is not touched by anger or dark energies at all; he has lost his selfishness and conceit.

29.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਅਘਾਏ ॥੩॥
29.t: naam nidhaan sataguroo dhikhaaliaa har ras peeaa aghaae ||3||
29.e: The True Guru has revealed to him the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and is satisfied. ||3||

29.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
29.t: jin kinai paiaa saadhasa(n)gatee poorai bhaag bairaag ||
29.e: Whoever has found it, has done so in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Through perfect good fortune, such balanced detachment is attained.

29.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
29.t: manmukh fireh na jaaneh satagur haumai a(n)dhar laag ||
29.e: The self-willed manmukhs wander around lost, but they do not know the True Guru. They are inwardly attached to egotism.

29.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਕੇਹੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੪॥੮॥੪੧॥
29.t: naanak sabadh rate har naam ra(n)gaae bin bhai kehee laag ||4||8||41||
29.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Shabad are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Name. Without the Fear of God, how can they retain this Color? ||4||8||41||

29.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
29.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
29.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

29.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸਉਦਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
29.t: ghar hee saudhaa paieeaai a(n)tar sabh vath hoi ||
29.e: Within the home of your own inner being, the merchandise is obtained. All commodities are within.

29.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
29.t: khin khin naam samaaleeaai gurmukh paavai koi ||
29.e: Each and every moment, dwell on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukhs obtain it.

29.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਹੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
29.t: naam nidhaan akhuT hai vaddabhaag paraapat hoi ||1||
29.e: The Treasure of the Naam is inexhaustible. By great good fortune, it is obtained. ||1||

29.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
29.t: mere man taj ni(n)dhaa haumai aha(n)kaar ||
29.e: O my mind, give up slander, egotism and arrogance.

30.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
30.t: har jeeau sadhaa dhiaai too gurmukh eka(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
30.e: Become Gurmukh, and meditate forever on the Dear Lord, the One and Only Creator. ||1||Pause||

30.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
30.t: gurmukhaa ke mukh ujale gur sabadhee beechaar ||
30.e: The faces of the Gurmukhs are radiant and bright; they reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

30.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਦੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
30.t: halat palat sukh paidhe jap jap ridhai muraar ||
30.e: They obtain peace in this world and the next, chanting and meditating within their hearts on the Lord.

30.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
30.t: ghar hee vich mahal paiaa gur sabadhee veechaar ||2||
30.e: Within the home of their own inner being, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, reflecting on the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

30.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਮੁਹ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਮਥੇ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਲੇ ॥
30.t: satagur te jo muh fereh mathe tin kaale ||
30.e: Those who turn their faces away from the True Guru shall have their faces blackened.

30.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਜੋਹੇ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
30.t: anadhin dhukh kamaavadhe nit johe jam jaale ||
30.e: Night and day, they suffer in pain; they see the noose of Death always hovering above them.

30.g: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਪਰਜਾਲੇ ॥੩॥
30.t: supanai sukh na dhekhanee bahu chi(n)taa parajaale ||3||
30.e: Even in their dreams, they find no peace; they are consumed by the fires of intense anxiety. ||3||

30.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
30.t: sabhanaa kaa dhaataa ek hai aape bakhas karei ||
30.e: The One Lord is the Giver of all; He Himself bestows all blessings.

30.g: ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
30.t: kahanaa kichhoo na jaaviee jis bhaavai tis dhei ||
30.e: No one else has any say in this; He gives just as He pleases.

30.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੪੨॥
30.t: naanak gurmukh paieeaai aape jaanai soi ||4||9||42||
30.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs obtain Him; He Himself knows Himself. ||4||9||42||

30.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
30.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
30.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

30.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥
30.t: sachaa saahib seveeaai sach vaddiaaiee dhei ||
30.e: Serve your True Lord and Master, and you shall be blessed with true greatness.

30.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
30.t: gur parasaadhee man vasai haumai dhoor karei ||
30.e: By Guru's Grace, He abides in the mind, and egotism is driven out.

30.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਤਾ ਰਹੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
30.t: eih man dhaavat taa rahai jaa aape nadhar karei ||1||
30.e: This wandering mind comes to rest, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

30.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
30.t: bhaiee re gurmukh har naam dhiaai ||
30.e: O Siblings of Destiny, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Name of the Lord.

30.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
30.t: naam nidhaan sadh man vasai mahalee paavai thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
30.e: The Treasure of the Naam abides forever within the mind, and one's place of rest is found in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||1||Pause||

30.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸ ਨਉ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
30.t: manmukh man tan a(n)dh hai tis nau Thaur na Thaau ||
30.e: The minds and bodies of the self-willed manmukhs are filled with darkness; they find no shelter, no place of rest.

30.g: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਉਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈਂ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥
30.t: bahu jonee bhaudhaa firai jiau su(n)n(j)ai(n) ghar kaau ||
30.e: Through countless incarnations they wander lost, like crows in a deserted house.

30.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
30.t: gurmatee ghaT chaananaa sabadh milai har naau ||2||
30.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the heart is illuminated. Through the Shabad, the Name of the Lord is received. ||2||

30.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਗੁਬਾਰ ॥
30.t: trai gun bikhiaa a(n)dh hai maiaa moh gubaar ||
30.e: In the corruption of the three qualities, there is blindness; in attachment to Maya, there is darkness.

30.g: ਲੋਭੀ ਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਪੜਿ ਵੇਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
30.t: lobhee an kau sevadhe paR vedhaa karai pookaar ||
30.e: The greedy people serve others, instead of the Lord, although they loudly announce their reading of scriptures.

30.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
30.t: bikhiaa a(n)dhar pach mue naa uravaar na paar ||3||
30.e: They are burnt to death by their own corruption; they are not at home, on either this shore or the one beyond. ||3||

30.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿ ॥
30.t: maiaa moh visaariaa jagat pitaa pratipaal ||
30.e: In attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Father, the Cherisher of the World.

30.g: ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਬਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
30.t: baajhahu guroo achet hai sabh badhee jamakaal ||
30.e: Without the Guru, all are unconscious; they are held in bondage by the Messenger of Death.

30.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੩॥
30.t: naanak gurmat ubare sachaa naam samaal ||4||10||43||
30.e: O Nanak, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be saved, contemplating the True Name. ||4||10||43||

30.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
30.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
30.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

30.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਥਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
30.t: trai gun maiaa moh hai gurmukh chauthaa padh pai ||
30.e: The three qualities hold people in attachment to Maya. The Gurmukh attains the fourth state of higher consciousness.

30.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
30.t: kar kirapaa melaian har naam vasiaa man aai ||
30.e: Granting His Grace, God unites us with Himself. The Name of the Lord comes to abide within the mind.

30.g: ਪੋਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
30.t: potai jin kai pu(n)n hai tin satasa(n)gat melai ||1||
30.e: Those who have the treasure of goodness join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

30.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
30.t: bhaiee re gurmat saach rahaau ||
30.e: O Siblings of Destiny, follow the Guru's Teachings and dwell in truth.

30.g: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
30.t: saacho saach kamaavanaa saachai sabadh milaau ||1|| rahaau ||
30.e: Practice truth, and only truth, and merge in the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||

30.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
30.t: jinee naam pachhaaniaa tin viTahu bal jaau ||
30.e: I am a sacrifice to those who recognize the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

30.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਚਲਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
30.t: aap chhodd charanee lagaa chalaa tin kai bhai ||
30.e: Renouncing selfishness, I fall at their feet, and walk in harmony with His Will.

30.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
30.t: laahaa har har naam milai sahaje naam samai ||2||
30.e: Earning the Profit of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am intuitively absorbed in the Naam. ||2||

30.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
30.t: bin gur mahal na paieeaai naam na paraapat hoi ||
30.e: Without the Guru, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found, and the Naam is not obtained.

30.g: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
30.t: aaisaa satagur loR lahu jidhoo paieeaai sach soi ||
30.e: Seek and find such a True Guru, who shall lead you to the True Lord.

30.g: ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
30.t: asur sa(n)ghaarai sukh vasai jo tis bhaavai su hoi ||3||
30.e: Destroy your evil passions, and you shall dwell in peace. Whatever pleases the Lord comes to pass. ||3||

30.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
30.t: jehaa satagur kar jaaniaa teho jehaa sukh hoi ||
30.e: As one knows the True Guru, so is the peace obtained.

30.g: ਏਹੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
30.t: eh sahasaa moole naahee bhaau laae jan koi ||
30.e: There is no doubt at all about this, but those who love Him are very rare.

30.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੪॥
30.t: naanak ek jot dhui mooratee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||4||11||44||
30.e: O Nanak, the One Light has two forms; through the Shabad, union is attained. ||4||11||44||

31.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
31.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
31.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

31.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਾਣੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ॥
31.t: a(n)mrit chhodd bikhiaa lobhaane sevaa kareh viddaanee ||
31.e: Discarding the Ambrosial Nectar, they greedily grab the poison; they serve others, instead of the Lord.

31.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥
31.t: aapanaa dharam gavaaveh boojheh naahee anadhin dhukh vihaanee ||
31.e: They lose their faith, they have no understanding; night and day, they suffer in pain.

31.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
31.t: manmukh a(n)dh na chetahee ddoob mue bin paanee ||1||
31.e: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not even think of the Lord; they are drowned to death without water. ||1||

31.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਭਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
31.t: man re sadhaa bhajahu har saranaiee ||
31.e: O mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord; seek the Protection of His Sanctuary.

31.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
31.t: gur kaa sabadh a(n)tar vasai taa har visar na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
31.e: If the Word of the Guru's Shabad abides deep within, then you shall not forget the Lord. ||1||Pause||

31.g: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਪੁਤਲਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
31.t: eih sareer maiaa kaa putalaa vich haumai dhusaTee paiee ||
31.e: This body is the puppet of Maya. The evil of egotism is within it.

31.g: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
31.t: aavan jaanaa ja(n)man maranaa manmukh pat gavaiee ||
31.e: Coming and going through birth and death, the self-willed manmukhs lose their honor.

31.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
31.t: satagur sev sadhaa sukh paiaa jotee jot milaiee ||2||
31.e: Serving the True Guru, eternal peace is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light. ||2||

31.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
31.t: satagur kee sevaa at sukhaalee jo ichhe so fal paae ||
31.e: Serving the True Guru brings a deep and profound peace, and one's desires are fulfilled.

31.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਤਪੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
31.t: jat sat tap pavit sareeraa har har ma(n)n vasaae ||
31.e: Abstinence, truthfulness and self-discipline are obtained, and the body is purified; the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within the mind.

31.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
31.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee mil preetam sukh paae ||3||
31.e: Such a person remains blissful forever, day and night. Meeting the Beloved, peace is found. ||3||

31.g: ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
31.t: jo satagur kee saranaagatee hau tin kai bal jaau ||
31.e: I am a sacrifice to those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

31.g: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥
31.t: dhar sachai sachee vaddiaaiee sahaje sach samaau ||
31.e: In the Court of the True One, they are blessed with true greatness; they are intuitively absorbed into the True Lord.

31.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੫॥
31.t: naanak nadharee paieeaai gurmukh mel milaau ||4||12||45||
31.e: O Nanak, by His Glance of Grace He is found; the Gurmukh is united in His Union. ||4||12||45||

31.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
31.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
31.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

31.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਿਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
31.t: manmukh karam kamaavane jiau dhohaagan tan seegaar ||
31.e: The self-willed manmukh performs religious rituals, like the unwanted bride decorating her body.

31.g: ਸੇਜੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
31.t: sejai ka(n)t na aaviee nit nit hoi khuaar ||
31.e: Her Husband Lord does not come to her bed; day after day, she grows more and more miserable.

31.g: ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
31.t: pir kaa mahal na paaviee naa dheesai ghar baar ||1||
31.e: She does not attain the Mansion of His Presence; she does not find the door to His House. ||1||

31.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
31.t: bhaiee re ik man naam dhiaai ||
31.e: O Siblings of Destiny, meditate on the Naam with one-pointed mind.

31.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
31.t: sa(n)taa sa(n)gat mil rahai jap raam naam sukh pai ||1|| rahaau ||
31.e: Remain united with the Society of the Saints; chant the Name of the Lord, and find peace. ||1||Pause||

31.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
31.t: gurmukh sadhaa sohaaganee pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
31.e: The Gurmukh is the happy and pure soul-bride forever. She keeps her Husband Lord enshrined within her heart.

31.g: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਸੇਜੈ ਰਵੈ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
31.t: miThaa boleh niv chaleh sejai ravai bhataar ||
31.e: Her speech is sweet, and her way of life is humble. She enjoys the Bed of her Husband Lord.

31.g: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
31.t: sobhaava(n)tee sohaaganee jin gur kaa het apaar ||2||
31.e: The happy and pure soul-bride is noble; she has infinite love for the Guru. ||2||

31.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਾ ਉਦਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
31.t: poorai bhaag satagur milai jaa bhaagai kaa udhau hoi ||
31.e: By perfect good fortune, one meets the True Guru, when one's destiny is awakened.

31.g: ਅੰਤਰਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
31.t: a(n)tarahu dhukh bhram kaTeeaai sukh paraapat hoi ||
31.e: Suffering and doubt are cut out from within, and peace is obtained.

31.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
31.t: gur kai bhaanai jo chalai dhukh na paavai koi ||3||
31.e: One who walks in harmony with the Guru's Will shall not suffer in pain. ||3||

31.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
31.t: gur ke bhaane vich a(n)mrit hai sahaje paavai koi ||
31.e: The Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, is in the Guru's Will. With intuitive ease, it is obtained.

31.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
31.t: jinaa paraapat tin peeaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
31.e: Those who are destined to have it, drink it in; their egotism is eradicated from within.

31.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੬॥
31.t: naanak gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai sach milaavaa hoi ||4||13||46||
31.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meditates on the Naam, and is united with the True Lord. ||4||13||46||

31.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
31.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
31.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

31.g: ਜਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗੈ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
31.t: jaa pir jaanai aapanaa tan man agai dharei ||
31.e: If you know that He is your Husband Lord, offer your body and mind to Him.

31.g: ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੀਆ ਸੇਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
31.t: sohaaganee karam kamaavadheeaa seiee karam karei ||
31.e: Behave like the happy and pure soul-bride.

31.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧॥
31.t: sahaje saach milaavaRaa saach vaddaiee dhei ||1||
31.e: With intuitive ease, you shall merge with the True Lord, and He shall bless you with true greatness. ||1||

31.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
31.t: bhaiee re gur bin bhagat na hoi ||
31.e: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

31.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
31.t: bin gur bhagat na paieeaai je lochai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
31.e: Without the Guru, devotion is not obtained, even though everyone may long for it. ||1||Pause||

31.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
31.t: lakh chauraaseeh fer piaa kaaman dhoojai bhai ||
31.e: The soul-bride in love with duality goes around the wheel of reincarnation, through 8.4 million incarnations.

31.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
31.t: bin gur needh na aaviee dhukhee rain vihai ||
31.e: Without the Guru, she finds no sleep, and she passes her life-night in pain.

31.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
31.t: bin sabadhai pir na paieeaai birathaa janam gavai ||2||
31.e: Without the Shabad, she does not find her Husband Lord, and her life wastes away in vain. ||2||

32.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੀ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
32.t: hau hau karatee jag firee naa dhan sa(n)pai naal ||
32.e: Practicing egotism, selfishness and conceit, she wanders around the world, but her wealth and property will not go with her.

32.g: ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਈ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
32.t: a(n)dhee naam na chetiee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
32.e: The spiritually blind do not even think of the Naam; they are all bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death.

32.g: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
32.t: satagur miliaai dhan paiaa har naamaa ridhai samaal ||3||
32.e: Meeting the True Guru, the wealth is obtained, contemplating the Name of the Lord in the heart. ||3||

32.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
32.t: naam rate se niramale gur kai sahaj subhai ||
32.e: Those who are attuned to the Naam are immaculate and pure; through the Guru, they obtain intuitive peace and poise.

32.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
32.t: man tan raataa ra(n)g siau rasanaa rasan rasai ||
32.e: Their minds and bodies are dyed in the Color of the Lord's Love, and their tongues savor His Sublime Essence.

32.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਲਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੪੭॥
32.t: naanak ra(n)g na utarai jo har dhur chhoddiaa lai ||4||14||47||
32.e: O Nanak, that Primal Color which the Lord has applied, shall never fade away. ||4||14||47||

32.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
32.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
32.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
32.t: gurmukh kirapaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoiee ||
32.e: By His Grace one becomes Gurmukh, worshipping the Lord with devotion. Without the Guru there is no devotional worship.

32.g: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
32.t: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai soiee ||
32.e: Those whom He unites with Himself, understand and become pure.

32.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
32.t: har jeeau saachaa saachee baanee sabadh milaavaa hoiee ||1||
32.e: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Shabad, we merge with Him. ||1||

32.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
32.t: bhaiee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
32.e: O Siblings of Destiny: those who lack devotion-why have they even bothered to come into the world?

32.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
32.t: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
32.e: They do not serve the Perfect Guru; they waste away their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

32.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
32.t: aape jagajeevan sukhadhaataa aape bakhas milaae ||
32.e: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver of Peace. He Himself forgives, and unites with Himself.

32.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
32.t: jeea ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
32.e: So what about all these poor beings and creatures? What can anyone say?

32.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
32.t: gurmukh aape dhei vaddaiee aape sev karaae ||2||
32.e: He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glory. He Himself enjoins us to His Service. ||2||

32.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
32.t: dhekh kuTa(n)b moh lobhaanaa chaladhiaa naal na jaiee ||
32.e: Gazing upon their families, people are lured and trapped by emotional attachment, but none will go along with them in the end.

32.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
32.t: satagur sev gun nidhaan paiaa tis dhee keem na paiee ||
32.e: Serving the True Guru, one finds the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence. His Value cannot be estimated.

32.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
32.t: har prabh sakhaa meet prabh meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||3||
32.e: The Lord God is my Friend and Companion. God shall be my Helper and Support in the end. ||3||

32.g: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
32.t: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaiee ||
32.e: Within your conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness is not removed.

32.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
32.t: har jeeau dhaataa bhagat vachhal hai kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||
32.e: The Dear Lord is the Giver, the Lover of His devotees. By His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind.

32.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੮॥
32.t: naanak sobhaa surat dhei prabh aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee ||4||15||48||
32.e: O Nanak, by His Grace, He bestows enlightened awareness; God Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||4||15||48||

32.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
32.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
32.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

32.g: ਧਨੁ ਜਨਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਾਇਆ ਧੰਨੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
32.t: dhan jananee jin jaiaa dha(n)n pitaa paradhaan || satagur sev sukh paiaa vichahu giaa gumaan ||
32.e: Blessed is the mother who gave birth; blessed and respected is the father of one who serves the True Guru and finds peace. His arrogant pride is banished from within.

32.g: ਦਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਖੜੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
32.t: dhar sevan sa(n)t jan khaRe pain gunee nidhaan ||1||
32.e: Standing at the Lord's Door, the humble Saints serve Him; they find the Treasure of Excellence. ||1||

32.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
32.t: mere man gur mukh dhiaai har soi ||
32.e: O my mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Lord.

32.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
32.t: gur kaa sabadh man vasai man tan niramal hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
32.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and the body and mind become pure. ||1||Pause||

32.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
32.t: kar kirapaa ghar aaiaa aape miliaa aai ||
32.e: By His Grace, He has come into my home; He Himself has come to meet me.

32.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਰੰਗੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
32.t: gur sabadhee saalaaheeaai ra(n)ge sahaj subhai ||
32.e: Singing His Praises through the Shabads of the Guru, we are dyed in His Color with intuitive ease.

32.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
32.t: sachai sach samaiaa mil rahai na vichhuR jai ||2||
32.e: Becoming truthful, we merge with the True One; remaining blended with Him, we shall never be separated again. ||2||

32.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
32.t: jo kichh karanaa su kar rahiaa avar na karanaa jai ||
32.e: Whatever is to be done, the Lord is doing. No one else can do anything.

32.g: ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੇ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
32.t: chiree vichhu(n)ne melian satagur pa(n)nai pai ||
32.e: Those separated from Him for so long are reunited with Him once again by the True Guru, who takes them into His Own Account.

32.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
32.t: aape kaar karaisee avar na karanaa jai ||3||
32.e: He Himself assigns all to their tasks; nothing else can be done. ||3||

32.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
32.t: man tan rataa ra(n)g siau haumai taj vikaar ||
32.e: One whose mind and body are imbued with the Lord's Love gives up egotism and corruption.

32.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
32.t: ahinis hiradhai rav rahai nirabhau naam nira(n)kaar ||
32.e: Day and night, the Name of the One Lord, the Fearless and Formless One, dwells within the heart.

32.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੯॥
32.t: naanak aap milaian poorai sabadh apaar ||4||16||49||
32.e: O Nanak, He blends us with Himself, through the Perfect, Infinite Word of His Shabad. ||4||16||49||

32.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
32.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
32.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

32.g: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
32.t: govidh gunee nidhaan hai a(n)t na paiaa jai ||
32.e: The Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Excellence; His limits cannot be found.

32.g: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
32.t: kathanee badhanee na paieeaai haumai vichahu jai ||
32.e: He is not obtained by mouthing mere words, but by rooting out ego from within.

33.g: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਦ ਭੈ ਰਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
33.t: satagur miliaai sadh bhai rachai aap vasai man aai ||1||
33.e: Meeting the True Guru, one is permeated forever with the Fear of God, who Himself comes to dwell within the mind. ||1||

33.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
33.t: bhaiee re gurmukh boojhai koi ||
33.e: O Siblings of Destiny, one who becomes Gurmukh and understands this is very rare.

33.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
33.t: bin boojhe karam kamaavane janam padhaarath khoi ||1|| rahaau ||
33.e: To act without understanding is to lose the treasure of this human life. ||1||Pause||

33.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਾਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਾਖੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
33.t: jinee chaakhiaa tinee saadh paiaa bin chaakhe bharam bhulai ||
33.e: Those who have tasted it, enjoy its flavor; without tasting it, they wander in doubt, lost and deceived.

33.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
33.t: a(n)mrit saachaa naam hai kahanaa kachhoo na jai ||
33.e: The True Name is the Ambrosial Nectar; no one can describe it.

33.g: ਪੀਵਤ ਹੂ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
33.t: peevat hoo paravaan bhiaa poorai sabadh samai ||2||
33.e: Drinking it in, one becomes honorable, absorbed in the Perfect Word of the Shabad. ||2||

33.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਰਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
33.t: aape dhei ta paieeaai hor karanaa kichhoo na jai ||
33.e: He Himself gives, and then we receive. Nothing else can be done.

33.g: ਦੇਵਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਕੈ ਹਥਿ ਦਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
33.t: dhevan vaale kai hath dhaat hai guroo dhuaarai pai ||
33.e: The Gift is in the Hands of the Great Giver. At the Guru's Door, in the Gurdwara, it is received.

33.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਹੋਆ ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
33.t: jehaa keeton tehaa hoaa jehe karam kamai ||3||
33.e: Whatever He does, comes to pass. All act according to His Will. ||3||

33.g: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
33.t: jat sat sa(n)jam naam hai vin naavai niramal na hoi ||
33.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is abstinence, truthfulness, and self-restraint. Without the Name, no one becomes pure.

33.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
33.t: poorai bhaag naam man vasai sabadh milaavaa hoi ||
33.e: Through perfect good fortune, the Naam comes to abide within the mind. Through the Shabad, we merge into Him.

33.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੫੦॥
33.t: naanak sahaje hee ra(n)g varatadhaa har gun paavai soi ||4||17||50||
33.e: O Nanak, one who lives in intuitive peace and poise, imbued with the Lord's Love, obtains the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||17||50||

33.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
33.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
33.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

33.g: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਸਾਧੈ ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
33.t: kaa(n)iaa saadhai uradh tap karai vichahu haumai na jai ||
33.e: You may torment your body with extremes of self-discipline, practice intensive meditation and hang upside-down, but your ego will not be eliminated from within.

33.g: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਜੇ ਕਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
33.t: adhiaatam karam je kare naam na kab hee pai ||
33.e: You may perform religious rituals, and still never obtain the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

33.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
33.t: gur kai sabadh jeevat marai har naam vasai man aai ||1||
33.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain dead while yet alive, and the Name of the Lord shall come to dwell within the mind. ||1||

33.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
33.t: sun man mere bhaj satagur saranaa ||
33.e: Listen, O my mind: hurry to the Protection of the Guru's Sanctuary.

33.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਬਿਖੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
33.t: gur parasaadhee chhuTeeaai bikh bhavajal sabadh gur taranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
33.e: By Guru's Grace you shall be saved. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

33.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
33.t: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai dhoojaa bhaau vikaar ||
33.e: Everything under the influence of the three qualities shall perish; the love of duality is corrupting.

33.g: ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਪੜੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਾਧਾ ਨਹ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
33.t: pa(n)ddit paRai ba(n)dhan moh baadhaa neh boojhai bikhiaa piaar ||
33.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read the scriptures, but they are trapped in the bondage of emotional attachment. In love with evil, they do not understand.

33.g: ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਛੂਟੈ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਦਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
33.t: satagur miliaai tirakuTee chhooTai chauthai padh mukat dhuaar ||2||
33.e: Meeting the Guru, the bondage of the three qualities is cut away, and in the fourth state, the Door of Liberation is attained. ||2||

33.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
33.t: gur te maarag paieeaai chookai moh gubaar ||
33.e: Through the Guru, the Path is found, and the darkness of emotional attachment is dispelled.

33.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਉਧਰੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
33.t: sabadh marai taa udharai paae mokh dhuaar ||
33.e: If one dies through the Shabad, then salvation is obtained, and one finds the Door of Liberation.

33.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
33.t: gur parasaadhee mil rahai sach naam karataar ||3||
33.e: By Guru's Grace, one remains blended with the True Name of the Creator. ||3||

33.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਤਿ ਸਬਲ ਹੈ ਛਡੇ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
33.t: eih manooaa at sabal hai chhadde na kitai upai ||
33.e: This mind is very powerful; we cannot escape it just by trying.

33.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਇਦਾ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
33.t: dhoojai bhai dhukh laidhaa bahutee dhei sajai ||
33.e: In the love of duality, people suffer in pain, condemned to terrible punishment.

33.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੫੧॥
33.t: naanak naam lage se ubare haumai sabadh gavai ||4||18||51||
33.e: O Nanak, those who are attached to the Naam are saved; through the Shabad, their ego is banished. ||4||18||51||

33.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
33.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
33.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

33.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਦੇਇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇ ॥
33.t: kirapaa kare gur paieeaai har naamo dhei dhiraRai ||
33.e: By His Grace, the Guru is found, and the Name of the Lord is implanted within.

33.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
33.t: bin gur kinai na paio birathaa janam gavai ||
33.e: Without the Guru, no one has obtained it; they waste away their lives in vain.

33.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
33.t: manmukh karam kamaavane dharageh milai sajai ||1||
33.e: The self-willed manmukhs create karma, and in the Court of the Lord, they receive their punishment. ||1||

33.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇ ॥
33.t: man re dhoojaa bhaau chukai ||
33.e: O mind, give up the love of duality.

33.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
33.t: a(n)tar terai har vasai gur sevaa sukh pai || rahaau ||
33.e: The Lord dwells within you; serving the Guru, you shall find peace. ||Pause||

33.g: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
33.t: sach baanee sach sabadh hai jaa sach dhare piaar ||
33.e: When you love the Truth, your words are true; they reflect the True Word of the Shabad.

33.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥
33.t: har kaa naam man vasai haumai karodh nivaar ||
33.e: The Name of the Lord dwells within the mind; egotism and anger are wiped away.

33.g: ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
33.t: man niramal naam dhiaaieeaai taa paae mokh dhuaar ||2||
33.e: Meditating on the Naam with a pure mind, the Door of Liberation is found. ||2||

33.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸਦਾ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
33.t: haumai vich jag binasadhaa mar ja(n)mai aavai jai ||
33.e: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. It dies and is re-born; it continues coming and going in reincarnation.

33.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
33.t: manmukh sabadh na jaananee jaasan pat gavai ||
33.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not recognize the Shabad; they forfeit their honor, and depart in disgrace.

33.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
33.t: gur sevaa naau paieeaai sache rahai samai ||3||
33.e: Serving the Guru, the Name is obtained, and one remains absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||

34.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
34.t: sabadh ma(n)niaai gur paieeaai vichahu aap gavai ||
34.e: With faith in the Shabad, the Guru is found, and selfishness is eradicated from within.

34.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
34.t: anadhin bhagat kare sadhaa saache kee liv lai ||
34.e: Night and day, worship the True Lord with devotion and love forever.

34.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੫੨॥
34.t: naam padhaarath man vasiaa naanak sahaj samai ||4||19||52||
34.e: The Treasure of the Naam abides in the mind; O Nanak, in the poise of perfect balance, merge into the Lord. ||4||19||52||

34.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
34.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
34.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

34.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
34.t: jinee purakhee satagur na sevio se dhukhe'ee jug chaar ||
34.e: Those who do not serve the True Guru shall be miserable throughout the four ages.

34.g: ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
34.t: ghar hodhaa purakh na pachhaaniaa abhimaan muThe aha(n)kaar ||
34.e: The Primal Being is within their own home, but they do not recognize Him. They are plundered by their egotistical pride and arrogance.

34.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਫਿਟਕਿਆ ਮੰਗਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
34.t: sataguroo kiaa fiTakiaa ma(n)g thake sa(n)saar ||
34.e: Cursed by the True Guru, they wander around the world begging, until they are exhausted.

34.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
34.t: sachaa sabadh na sevio sabh kaaj savaaranahaar ||1||
34.e: They do not serve the True Word of the Shabad, which is the solution to all of their problems. ||1||

34.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
34.t: man mere sadhaa har vekh hadhoor ||
34.e: O my mind, see the Lord ever close at hand.

34.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
34.t: janam maran dhukh paraharai sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||1|| rahaau ||
34.e: He shall remove the pains of death and rebirth; the Word of the Shabad shall fill you to overflowing. ||1||Pause||

34.g: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
34.t: sach salaahan se sache sachaa naam adhaar ||
34.e: Those who praise the True One are true; the True Name is their Support.

34.g: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
34.t: sachee kaar kamaavanee sache naal piaar ||
34.e: They act truthfully, in love with the True Lord.

34.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
34.t: sachaa saahu varatadhaa koi na meTanahaar ||
34.e: The True King has written His Order, which no one can erase.

34.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ॥੨॥
34.t: manmukh mahal na painee kooR muThe kooRiaar ||2||
34.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. The false are plundered by falsehood. ||2||

34.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਜਗੁ ਮੁਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
34.t: haumai karataa jag muaa gur bin ghor a(n)dhaar ||
34.e: Engrossed in egotism, the world perishes. Without the Guru, there is utter darkness.

34.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
34.t: maiaa moh visaariaa sukhadhaataa dhaataar ||
34.e: In emotional attachment to Maya, they have forgotten the Great Giver, the Giver of Peace.

34.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
34.t: satagur seveh taa ubareh sach rakheh ur dhaar ||
34.e: Those who serve the True Guru are saved; they keep the True One enshrined in their hearts.

34.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
34.t: kirapaa te har paieeaai sach sabadh veechaar ||3||
34.e: By His Grace, we find the Lord, and reflect on the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

34.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
34.t: satagur sev man niramalaa haumai taj vikaar ||
34.e: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate and pure; egotism and corruption are discarded.

34.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
34.t: aap chhodd jeevat marai gur kai sabadh veechaar ||
34.e: So abandon your selfishness, and remain dead while yet alive. Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

34.g: ਧੰਧਾ ਧਾਵਤ ਰਹਿ ਗਏ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
34.t: dha(n)dhaa dhaavat reh ge laagaa saach piaar ||
34.e: The pursuit of worldly affairs comes to an end, when you embrace love for the True One.

34.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
34.t: sach rate mukh ujale tit saachai dharabaar ||4||
34.e: Those who are attuned to Truth-their faces are radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||4||

34.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਮੰਨਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
34.t: satagur purakh na ma(n)nio sabadh na lago piaar ||
34.e: Those who do not have faith in the Primal Being, the True Guru, and who do not enshrine love for the Shabad

34.g: ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਜੇਤਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
34.t: eisanaan dhaan jetaa kareh dhoojai bhai khuaar ||
34.e: they take their cleansing baths, and give to charity again and again, but they are ultimately consumed by their love of duality.

34.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
34.t: har jeeau aapanee kirapaa kare taa laagai naam piaar ||
34.e: When the Dear Lord Himself grants His Grace, they are inspired to love the Naam.

34.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੫॥੨੦॥੫੩॥
34.t: naanak naam samaal too gur kai het apaar ||5||20||53||
34.e: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||5||20||53||

34.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
34.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
34.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

34.g: ਕਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੀ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
34.t: kis hau sevee kiaa jap karee satagur poochhau jai ||
34.e: Whom shall I serve? What shall I chant? I will go and ask the Guru.

34.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
34.t: satagur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)n liee vichahu aap gavai ||
34.e: I will accept the Will of the True Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

34.g: ਏਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
34.t: ehaa sevaa chaakaree naam vasai man aai ||
34.e: By this work and service, the Naam shall come to dwell within my mind.

34.g: ਨਾਮੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇ ॥੧॥
34.t: naamai hee te sukh paieeaai sachai sabadh suhai ||1||
34.e: Through the Naam, peace is obtained; I am adorned and embellished by the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

34.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥
34.t: man mere anadhin jaag har chet ||
34.e: O my mind, remain awake and aware night and day, and think of the Lord.

34.g: ਆਪਣੀ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਕੂੰਜ ਪੜੈਗੀ ਖੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
34.t: aapanee khetee rakh lai koo(n)j paRaigee khet ||1|| rahaau ||
34.e: Protect your crops, or else the birds shall descend on your farm. ||1||Pause||

34.g: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
34.t: man keeaa ichhaa pooreeaa sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||
34.e: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when one is filled to overflowing with the Shabad.

34.g: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦਾ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
34.t: bhai bhai bhagat kareh dhin raatee har jeeau vekhai sadhaa hadhoor ||
34.e: One who fears, loves, and is devoted to the Dear Lord day and night, sees Him always close at hand.

34.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
34.t: sachai sabadh sadhaa man raataa bhram giaa sareerahu dhoor ||
34.e: Doubt runs far away from the bodies of those, whose minds remain forever attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.

34.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰੁ ॥੨॥
34.t: niramal saahib paiaa saachaa gunee gaheer ||2||
34.e: The Immaculate Lord and Master is found. He is True; He is the Ocean of Excellence. ||2||

34.g: ਜੋ ਜਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸੂਤੇ ਗਏ ਮੁਹਾਇ ॥
34.t: jo jaage se ubare soote ge muhai ||
34.e: Those who remain awake and aware are saved, while those who sleep are plundered.

34.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਿਓ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
34.t: sachaa sabadh na pachhaanio supanaa giaa vihai ||
34.e: They do not recognize the True Word of the Shabad, and like a dream, their lives fade away.

34.g: ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਪਾਹੁਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਉ ਜਾਇ ॥
34.t: su(n)n(j)e ghar kaa paahunaa jiau aaiaa tiau jai ||
34.e: Like guests in a deserted house, they leave just exactly as they have come.

35.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
35.t: manmukh janam birathaa giaa kiaa muh dhesee jai ||3||
35.e: The life of the self-willed manmukh passes uselessly. What face will he show when he passes beyond? ||3||

35.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
35.t: sabh kichh aape aap hai haumai vich kahan na jai ||
35.e: God Himself is everything; those who are in their ego cannot even speak of this.

35.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
35.t: gur kai sabadh pachhaaneeaai dhukh haumai vichahu gavai ||
35.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized, and the pain of egotism is eradicated from within.

35.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
35.t: satagur sevan aapanaa hau tin kai laagau pai ||
35.e: I fall at the feet of those who serve their True Guru.

35.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਹਹਿ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੪॥੨੧॥੫੪॥
35.t: naanak dhar sachai sachiaar heh hau tin balihaarai jaau ||4||21||54||
35.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who are found to be true in the True Court. ||4||21||54||

35.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
35.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
35.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

35.g: ਜੇ ਵੇਲਾ ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਤਾ ਕਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
35.t: je velaa vakhat veechaareeaai taa kit velaa bhagat hoi ||
35.e: If we keep contemplating about the time as to when to remember the Lord, then when will we find the actual time for worship?

35.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
35.t: anadhin naame ratiaa sache sachee soi ||
35.e: Night and day, one who is attuned to the Name of the True Lord is true.

35.g: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਿਨੇਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
35.t: eik til piaaraa visarai bhagat kinehee hoi ||
35.e: If someone forgets the Beloved Lord, even for an instant, what sort of devotion is that?

35.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਚ ਸਿਉ ਸਾਸੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
35.t: man tan seetal saach siau saas na birathaa koi ||1||
35.e: One whose mind and body are cooled and soothed by the True Lord-no breath of his is wasted. ||1||

35.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
35.t: mere man har kaa naam dhiaai ||
35.e: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord.

35.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
35.t: saachee bhagat taa theeaai jaa har vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
35.e: True devotional worship is performed when the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

35.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਰਾਹੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਜੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
35.t: sahaje khetee raaheeaai sach naam beej pai ||
35.e: With intuitive ease, cultivate your farm, and plant the Seed of the True Name.

35.g: ਖੇਤੀ ਜੰਮੀ ਅਗਲੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਜਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
35.t: khetee ja(n)mee agalee manooaa rajaa sahaj subhai ||
35.e: The seedlings have sprouted luxuriantly, and with intuitive ease, the mind is satisfied.

35.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
35.t: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mrit hai jit peetai tikh jai ||
35.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

35.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
35.t: eih man saachaa sach rataa sache rahiaa samai ||2||
35.e: This true mind is attuned to Truth, and it remains permeated with the True One. ||2||

35.g: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
35.t: aakhan vekhan bolanaa sabadhe rahiaa samai ||
35.e: In speaking, in seeing and in words, remain immersed in the Shabad.

35.g: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
35.t: baanee vajee chahu jugee sacho sach sunai ||
35.e: The Word of the Guru's Bani vibrates throughout the four ages. As Truth, it teaches Truth.

35.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਲਇਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
35.t: haumai meraa reh giaa sachai liaa milai ||
35.e: Egotism and possessiveness are eliminated, and the True One absorbs them into Himself.

35.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਦੂਰਿ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
35.t: tin kau mahal hadhoor hai jo sach rahe liv lai ||3||
35.e: Those who remain lovingly absorbed in the True One see the Mansion of His Presence close at hand. ||3||

35.g: ਨਦਰੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
35.t: nadharee naam dhiaaieeaai vin karamaa paiaa na jai ||
35.e: By His Grace, we meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Without His Mercy, it cannot be obtained.

35.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
35.t: poorai bhaag satasa(n)gat lahai satagur bheTai jis aai ||
35.e: Through perfect good destiny, one finds the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and one comes to meet the True Guru.

35.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
35.t: anadhin naame ratiaa dhukh bikhiaa vichahu jai ||
35.e: Night and day, remain attuned to the Naam, and the pain of corruption shall be dispelled from within.

35.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੨੨॥੫੫॥
35.t: naanak sabadh milaavaRaa naame naam samai ||4||22||55||
35.e: O Nanak, merging with the Shabad through the Name, one is immersed in the Name. ||4||22||55||

35.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
35.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
35.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

35.g: ਆਪਣਾ ਭਉ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
35.t: aapanaa bhau tin paion jin gur kaa sabadh beechaar ||
35.e: Those who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are filled with the Fear of God.

35.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
35.t: satasa(n)gatee sadhaa mil rahe sache ke gun saar ||
35.e: They remain forever merged with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; they dwell upon the Glories of the True One.

35.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਅਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
35.t: dhubidhaa mail chukaieean har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
