56.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਵਖਰ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
56.t: vin vakhar dhukh agalaa kooR muThee kooRiaar ||2||
56.e: Without this commodity, there is great pain. The false are ruined by falsehood. ||2||

56.g: ਲਾਹਾ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਉਤਨਾ ਪਰਖੇ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
56.t: laahaa ahinis nautanaa parakhe ratan veechaar ||
56.e: One who contemplates and appraises this Jewel day and night reaps new profits.

56.g: ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥
56.t: vasat lahai ghar aapanai chalai kaaraj saar ||
56.e: He finds the merchandise within his own home, and departs after arranging his affairs.

56.g: ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
56.t: vanajaariaa siau vanaj kar gurmukh braham beechaar ||3||
56.e: So trade with the true traders, and as Gurmukh, contemplate God. ||3||

56.g: ਸੰਤਾਂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
56.t: sa(n)taa(n) sa(n)gat paieeaai je mele melanahaar ||
56.e: In the Society of the Saints, He is found, if the Uniter unites us.

56.g: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
56.t: miliaa hoi na vichhuRai jis a(n)tar jot apaar ||
56.e: One whose heart is filled with His Infinite Light meets with Him, and shall never again be separated from Him.

56.g: ਸਚੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੪॥
56.t: sachai aasan sach rahai sachai prem piaar ||4||
56.e: True is his position; he abides in Truth, with love and affection for the True One. ||4||

56.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
56.t: jinee aap pachhaaniaa ghar meh mahal suthai ||
56.e: One who understands himself finds the Mansion of the Lord's Presence within his own home.

56.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
56.t: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai pai ||
56.e: Imbued with the True Lord, Truth is gathered in.

57.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੫॥
57.t: tirabhavan so prabh jaaneeaai saacho saachai nai ||5||
57.e: God is known throughout the three worlds. True is the Name of the True One. ||5||

57.g: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
57.t: saa dhan kharee suhaavanee jin pir jaataa sa(n)g ||
57.e: The wife who knows that her Husband Lord is always with her is very beautiful.

57.g: ਮਹਲੀ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
57.t: mahalee mahal bulaieeaai so pir raave ra(n)g ||
57.e: The soul-bride is called to the Mansion of the His Presence, and her Husband Lord ravishes her with love.

57.g: ਸਚਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾ ਭਲੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੬॥
57.t: sach suhaagan saa bhalee pir mohee gun sa(n)g ||6||
57.e: The happy soul-bride is true and good; she is fascinated by the Glories of her Husband Lord. ||6||

57.g: ਭੂਲੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਾ ਥਲਿ ਚੜਿ ਡੂਗਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
57.t: bhoolee bhoolee thal chaRaa thal chaR ddoogar jaau ||
57.e: Wandering around and making mistakes, I climb the plateau; having climbed the plateau, I go up the mountain.

57.g: ਬਨ ਮਹਿ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਉ ॥
57.t: ban meh bhoolee je firaa bin gur boojh na paau ||
57.e: But now I have lost my way, and I am wandering around in the forest; without the Guru, I do not understand.

57.g: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੂਲੀ ਜੇ ਫਿਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
57.t: naavahu bhoolee je firaa fir fir aavau jaau ||7||
57.e: If I wander around forgetting God's Name, I shall continue coming and going in reincarnation, over and over again. ||7||

57.g: ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਧਾਊਆ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਕਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
57.t: puchhahu jai padhaauooaa chale chaakar hoi ||
57.e: Go and ask the travellers, how to walk on the Path as His slave.

57.g: ਰਾਜਨੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
57.t: raajan jaaneh aapanaa dhar ghar Thaak na hoi ||
57.e: They know the Lord to be their King, and at the Door to His Home, their way is not blocked.

57.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੬॥
57.t: naanak eko rav rahiaa dhoojaa avar na koi ||8||6||
57.e: O Nanak, the One is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all. ||8||6||

57.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
57.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
57.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

57.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰੁ ॥
57.t: gur te niramal jaaneeaai niramal dheh sareer ||
57.e: Through the Guru, the Pure One is known, and the human body becomes pure as well.

57.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥
57.t: niramal saacho man vasai so jaanai abh peer ||
57.e: The Pure, True Lord abides within the mind; He knows the pain of our hearts.

57.g: ਸਹਜੈ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਨਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਮ ਤੀਰੁ ॥੧॥
57.t: sahajai te sukh agalo naa laagai jam teer ||1||
57.e: With intuitive ease, a great peace is found, and the arrow of death shall not strike you. ||1||

57.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
57.t: bhaiee re mail naahee niramal jal nai ||
57.e: O Siblings of Destiny, filth is washed away by bathing in the Pure Water of the Name.

57.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਹੋਰੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
57.t: niramal saachaa ek too hor mail bharee sabh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
57.e: You alone are Perfectly Pure, O True Lord; all other places are filled with filth. ||1||Pause||

57.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਿ ॥
57.t: har kaa ma(n)dhar sohanaa keeaa karanaihaar ||
57.e: The Temple of the Lord is beautiful; it was made by the Creator Lord.

57.g: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਦੀਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਜੋਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
57.t: rav sas dheep anoop jot tirabhavan jot apaar ||
57.e: The sun and the moon are lamps of incomparably beautiful light. Throughout the three worlds, the Infinite Light is pervading.

57.g: ਹਾਟ ਪਟਣ ਗੜ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਉਦਾ ਵਾਪਾਰ ॥੨॥
57.t: haaT paTan gaR koThaRee sach saudhaa vaapaar ||2||
57.e: In the shops of the city of the body, in the fortresses and in the huts, the True Merchandise is traded. ||2||

57.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਾ ਦੇਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਭਾਇ ॥
57.t: giaan a(n)jan bhai bha(n)janaa dhekh nira(n)jan bhai ||
57.e: The ointment of spiritual wisdom is the destroyer of fear; through love, the Pure One is seen.

57.g: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਠਾਇ ॥
57.t: gupat pragaT sabh jaaneeaai je man raakhai Thai ||
57.e: The mysteries of the seen and the unseen are all known, if the mind is kept centered and balanced.

57.g: ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
57.t: aaisaa satigur je milai taa sahaje le milai ||3||
57.e: If one finds such a True Guru, the Lord is met with intuitive ease. ||3||

57.g: ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਪਰਖੇ ਹਿਤੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
57.t: kas kasavaTee laieeaai parakhe hit chit lai ||
57.e: He draws us to His Touchstone, to test our love and consciousness.

57.g: ਖੋਟੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਨੀ ਖਰੇ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
57.t: khoTe Thaur na painee khare khajaanai pai ||
57.e: The counterfeit have no place there, but the genuine are placed in His Treasury.

57.g: ਆਸ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਇਉ ਮਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
57.t: aas a(n)dhesaa dhoor kar iau mal jai samai ||4||
57.e: Let your hopes and anxieties depart; thus pollution is washed away. ||4||

57.g: ਸੁਖ ਕਉ ਮਾਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
57.t: sukh kau maagai sabh ko dhukh na maagai koi ||
57.e: Everyone begs for happiness; no one asks for suffering.

57.g: ਸੁਖੈ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
57.t: sukhai kau dhukh agalaa manmukh boojh na hoi ||
57.e: But in the wake of happiness, there comes great suffering. The self-willed manmukhs do not understand this.

57.g: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
57.t: sukh dhukh sam kar jaane'eeh sabadh bhedh sukh hoi ||5||
57.e: Those who see pain and pleasure as one and the same find peace; they are pierced through by the Shabad. ||5||

57.g: ਬੇਦੁ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਵਾਚੀਐ ਬਾਣੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਆਸੁ ॥
57.t: bedh pukaare vaacheeaai baanee braham biaas ||
57.e: The Vedas proclaim, and the words of Vyaasa tell us,

57.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਾਧਿਕਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
57.t: mun jan sevak saadhikaa naam rate gunataas ||
57.e: that the silent sages, the servants of the Lord, and those who practice a life of spiritual discipline are attuned to the Naam, the Treasure of Excellence.

57.g: ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜਿਣਿ ਗਏ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਸੁ ॥੬॥
57.t: sach rate se jin ge hau sadh balihaarai jaas ||6||
57.e: Those who are attuned to the True Name win the game of life; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||6||

57.g: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਮਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
57.t: chahu jug maile mal bhare jin mukh naam na hoi ||
57.e: Those who do not have the Naam in their mouths are filled with pollution; they are filthy throughout the four ages.

57.g: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
57.t: bhagatee bhai vihooniaa muh kaalaa pat khoi ||
57.e: Without loving devotion to God, their faces are blackened, and their honor is lost.

57.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੭॥
57.t: jinee naam visaariaa avagan muThee roi ||7||
57.e: Those who have forgotten the Naam are plundered by evil; they weep and wail in dismay. ||7||

57.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਪਾਇਆ ਡਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
57.t: khojat khojat paiaa ddar kar milai milai ||
57.e: I searched and searched, and found God. In the Fear of God, I have been united in His Union.

57.g: ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
57.t: aap pachhaanai ghar vasai haumai tirasanaa jai ||
57.e: Through self-realization, people dwell within the home of their inner being; egotism and desire depart.

57.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਊਜਲੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥
57.t: naanak niramal uoojale jo raate har nai ||8||7||
57.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Name of the Lord are immaculate and radiant. ||8||7||

57.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
57.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
57.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

57.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਾਵਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
57.t: sun man bhoole baavare gur kee charanee laag ||
57.e: Listen, O deluded and demented mind: hold tight to the Guru's Feet.

57.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਜਮੁ ਡਰਪੈ ਦੁਖ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
57.t: har jap naam dhiaai too jam ddarapai dhukh bhaag ||
57.e: Chant and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; death will be afraid of you, and suffering shall depart.

57.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਕਿਉ ਥਿਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
57.t: dhookh ghano dhohaaganee kiau thir rahai suhaag ||1||
57.e: The deserted wife suffers terrible pain. How can her Husband Lord remain with her forever? ||1||

58.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
58.t: bhaiee re avar naahee mai thaau ||
58.e: O Siblings of Destiny, I have no other place to go.

58.g: ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
58.t: mai dhan naam nidhaan hai gur dheeaa bal jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
58.e: The Guru has given me the Treasure of the Wealth of the Naam; I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||Pause||

58.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥
58.t: gurmat pat saabaas tis tis kai sa(n)g milaau ||
58.e: The Guru's Teachings bring honor. Blessed is He-may I meet and be with Him!

58.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਊ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
58.t: tis bin ghaRee na jeevuoo bin naavai mar jaau ||
58.e: Without Him, I cannot live, even for a moment. Without His Name, I die.

58.g: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਟੇਕ ਟਿਕੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਉ ॥੨॥
58.t: mai a(n)dhule naam na veesarai Tek Tikee ghar jaau ||2||
58.e: I am blind-may I never forget the Naam! Under His Protection, I shall reach my true home. ||2||

58.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਚੇਲੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
58.t: guroo jinaa kaa a(n)dhulaa chele naahee Thaau ||
58.e: Those chaylaas, those devotees, whose spiritual teacher is blind, shall not find their place of rest.

58.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਆ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
58.t: bin satigur naau na paieeaai bin naavai kiaa suaau ||
58.e: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained. Without the Name, what is the use of it all?

58.g: ਆਇ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਣਾ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਉ ॥੩॥
58.t: aai giaa pachhutaavanaa jiau su(n)n(j)ai ghar kaau ||3||
58.e: People come and go, regretting and repenting, like crows in a deserted house. ||3||

58.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਕਲਰ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ॥
58.t: bin naavai dhukh dhehuree jiau kalar kee bheet ||
58.e: Without the Name, the body suffers in pain; it crumbles like a wall of sand.

58.g: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
58.t: tab lag mahal na paieeaai jab lag saach na cheet ||
58.e: As long as Truth does not enter into the consciousness, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is not found.

58.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਪੈ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥
58.t: sabadh rapai ghar paieeaai nirabaanee padh neet ||4||
58.e: Attuned to the Shabad, we enter our home, and obtain the Eternal State of Nirvaanaa. ||4||

58.g: ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਛਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਉ ॥
58.t: hau gur poochhau aapane gur puchh kaar kamaau ||
58.e: I ask my Guru for His Advice, and I follow the Guru's Advice.

58.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
58.t: sabadh salaahee man vasai haumai dhukh jal jaau ||
58.e: With the Shabads of Praise abiding in the mind, the pain of egotism is burnt away.

58.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਾਵੜਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੫॥
58.t: sahaje hoi milaavaRaa saache saach milaau ||5||
58.e: We are intuitively united with Him, and we meet the Truest of the True. ||5||

58.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
58.t: sabadh rate se niramale taj kaam karodh aha(n)kaar ||
58.e: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are spotless and pure; they renounce sexual desire, anger, selfishness and conceit.

58.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਨਿ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
58.t: naam salaahan sadh sadhaa har raakheh ur dhaar ||
58.e: They sing the Praises of the Naam, forever and ever; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.

58.g: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਸਭ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੬॥
58.t: so kiau manahu visaareeaai sabh jeeaa kaa aadhaar ||6||
58.e: How could we ever forget Him from our minds? He is the Support of all beings. ||6||

58.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
58.t: sabadh marai so mar rahai fir marai na dhoojee vaar ||
58.e: One who dies in the Shabad is beyond death, and shall never die again.

58.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
58.t: sabadhai hee te paieeaai har naame lagai piaar ||
58.e: Through the Shabad, we find Him, and embrace love for the Name of the Lord.

58.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੭॥
58.t: bin sabadhai jag bhoolaa firai mar janamai vaaro vaar ||7||
58.e: Without the Shabad, the world is deceived; it dies and is reborn, over and over again. ||7||

58.g: ਸਭ ਸਾਲਾਹੈ ਆਪ ਕਉ ਵਡਹੁ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
58.t: sabh saalaahai aap kau vaddahu vadderee hoi ||
58.e: All praise themselves, and call themselves the greatest of the great.

58.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੀਐ ਕਹੇ ਸੁਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
58.t: gur bin aap na cheeneeaai kahe sune kiaa hoi ||
58.e: Without the Guru, one's self cannot be known. By merely speaking and listening, what is accomplished?

58.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੮॥੮॥
58.t: naanak sabadh pachhaaneeaai haumai karai na koi ||8||8||
58.e: O Nanak, one who realizes the Shabad does not act in egotism. ||8||8||

58.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
58.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
58.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

58.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਧਨ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਐ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
58.t: bin pir dhan seegaareeaai joban baadh khuaar ||
58.e: Without her Husband, the soul-bride's youth and ornaments are useless and wretched.

58.g: ਨਾ ਮਾਣੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
58.t: naa maane sukh sejaRee bin pir baadh seegaar ||
58.e: She does not enjoy the pleasure of His Bed; without her Husband, her ornaments are absurd.

58.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
58.t: dhookh ghano dhohaaganee naa ghar sej bhataar ||1||
58.e: The discarded bride suffers terrible pain; her Husband does not come to the bed of her home. ||1||

58.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
58.t: man re raam japahu sukh hoi ||
58.e: O mind, meditate on the Lord, and find peace.

58.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
58.t: bin gur prem na paieeaai sabadh milai ra(n)g hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
58.e: Without the Guru, love is not found. United with the Shabad, happiness is found. ||1||Pause||

58.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
58.t: gur sevaa sukh paieeaai har var sahaj seegaar ||
58.e: Serving the Guru, she finds peace, and her Husband Lord adorns her with intuitive wisdom.

58.g: ਸਚਿ ਮਾਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਸੇਜੜੀ ਗੂੜਾ ਹੇਤੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
58.t: sach maane pir sejaRee gooRaa het piaar ||
58.e: Truly, she enjoys the Bed of her Husband, through her deep love and affection.

58.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਗੁਣ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
58.t: gurmukh jaan sin(j)aaneeaai gur melee gun chaar ||2||
58.e: As Gurmukh, she comes to know Him. Meeting with the Guru, she maintains a virtuous lifestyle. ||2||

58.g: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਿਰਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
58.t: sach milahu var kaamanee pir mohee ra(n)g lai ||
58.e: Through Truth, meet your Husband Lord, O soul-bride. Enchanted by your Husband, enshrine love for Him.

58.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
58.t: man tan saach vigasiaa keemat kahan na jai ||
58.e: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in Truth. The value of this cannot be described.

58.g: ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥੩॥
58.t: har var ghar sohaaganee niramal saachai nai ||3||
58.e: The soul-bride finds her Husband Lord in the home of her own being; she is purified by the True Name. ||3||

58.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
58.t: man meh manooaa je marai taa pir raavai naar ||
58.e: If the mind within the mind dies, then the Husband ravishes and enjoys His bride.

58.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਤਾਗੈ ਰਲਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੋਤੀਅਨ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
58.t: eikat taagai ral milai gal moteean kaa haar ||
58.e: They are woven into one texture, like pearls on a necklace around the neck.

58.g: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
58.t: sa(n)t sabhaa sukh uoopajai gurmukh naam adhaar ||4||
58.e: In the Society of the Saints, peace wells up; the Gurmukhs take the Support of the Naam. ||4||

58.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਖਿਨਿ ਖਪੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
58.t: khin meh upajai khin khapai khin aavai khin jai ||
58.e: In an instant, one is born, and in an instant, one dies. In an instant one comes, and in an instant one goes.

58.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਸੰਤਾਇ ॥
58.t: sabadh pachhaanai rav rahai naa tis kaal sa(n)tai ||
58.e: One who recognizes the Shabad merges into it, and is not afflicted by death.

59.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
59.t: saahib atul na toleeaai kathan na paiaa jai ||5||
59.e: Our Lord and Master is Unweighable; He cannot be weighed. He cannot be found merely by talking. ||5||

59.g: ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਆਏ ਵਜਹੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ॥
59.t: vaapaaree vanajaariaa aae vajahu likhai ||
59.e: The merchants and the traders have come; their profits are pre-ordained.

59.g: ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
59.t: kaar kamaaveh sach kee laahaa milai rajai ||
59.e: Those who practice Truth reap the profits, abiding in the Will of God.

59.g: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
59.t: poo(n)jee saachee gur milai naa tis til na tamai ||6||
59.e: With the Merchandise of Truth, they meet the Guru, who does not have a trace of greed. ||6||

59.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੋੁਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਤਰਾਜੀ ਤੋਲੁ ॥
59.t: gurmukh tol tuolaisee sach taraajee tol ||
59.e: As Gurmukh, they are weighed and measured, in the balance and the scales of Truth.

59.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
59.t: aasaa manasaa mohanee gur Thaakee sach bol ||
59.e: The enticements of hope and desire are quieted by the Guru, whose Word is True.

59.g: ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਤੋਲੁ ॥੭॥
59.t: aap tulaae tolasee poore pooraa tol ||7||
59.e: He Himself weighs with the scale; perfect is the weighing of the Perfect One. ||7||

59.g: ਕਥਨੈ ਕਹਣਿ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਨਾ ਪੜਿ ਪੁਸਤਕ ਭਾਰ ॥
59.t: kathanai kahan na chhuTeeaai naa paR pusatak bhaar ||
59.e: No one is saved by mere talk and speech, nor by reading loads of books.

59.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਸੋਚ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
59.t: kaiaa soch na paieeaai bin har bhagat piaar ||
59.e: The body does not obtain purity without loving devotion to the Lord.

59.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੮॥੯॥
59.t: naanak naam na veesarai mele gur karataar ||8||9||
59.e: O Nanak, never forget the Naam; the Guru shall unite us with the Creator. ||8||9||

59.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
59.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
59.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

59.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਤਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
59.t: satigur pooraa je milai paieeaai ratan beechaar ||
59.e: Meeting the Perfect True Guru, we find the jewel of meditative reflection.

59.g: ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
59.t: man dheejai gur aapane paieeaai sarab piaar ||
59.e: Surrendering our minds to our Guru, we find universal love.

59.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
59.t: mukat padhaarath paieeaai avagan meTanahaar ||1||
59.e: We find the wealth of liberation, and our demerits are erased. ||1||

59.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
59.t: bhaiee re gur bin giaan na hoi ||
59.e: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom.

59.g: ਪੂਛਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਨਾਰਦੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਆਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
59.t: poochhahu brahame naaradhai bedh biaasai koi ||1|| rahaau ||
59.e: Go and ask Brahma, Naarad and Vyaas, the writer of the Vedas. ||1||Pause||

59.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
59.t: giaan dhiaan dhun jaaneeaai akath kahaavai soi ||
59.e: Know that from the vibration of the Word, we obtain spiritual wisdom and meditation. Through it, we speak the Unspoken.

59.g: ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
59.t: safalio birakh hareeaavalaa chhaav ghaneree hoi ||
59.e: He is the fruit-bearing Tree, luxuriantly green with abundant shade.

59.g: ਲਾਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
59.t: laal javehar maanakee gur bha(n)ddaarai soi ||2||
59.e: The rubies, jewels and emeralds are in the Guru's Treasury. ||2||

59.g: ਗੁਰ ਭੰਡਾਰੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
59.t: gur bha(n)ddaarai paieeaai niramal naam piaar ||
59.e: From the Guru's Treasury, we receive the Love of the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord.

59.g: ਸਾਚੋ ਵਖਰੁ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
59.t: saacho vakhar sa(n)cheeaai poorai karam apaar ||
59.e: We gather in the True Merchandise, through the Perfect Grace of the Infinite.

59.g: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਮੇਟਣੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
59.t: sukhadhaataa dhukh meTano satigur asur sa(n)ghaar ||3||
59.e: The True Guru is the Giver of peace, the Dispeller of pain, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||

59.g: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਨਾ ਕੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
59.t: bhavajal bikham ddaraavano naa ka(n)dhee naa paar ||
59.e: The terrifying world-ocean is difficult and dreadful; there is no shore on this side or the one beyond.

59.g: ਨਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹੜਾ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਵੰਝੁ ਮਲਾਰੁ ॥
59.t: naa beRee naa tulahaRaa naa tis va(n)jh malaar ||
59.e: There is no boat, no raft, no oars and no boatman.

59.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੈ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
59.t: satigur bhai kaa bohithaa nadharee paar utaar ||4||
59.e: The True Guru is the only boat on this terrifying ocean. His Glance of Grace carries us across. ||4||

59.g: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
59.t: eik til piaaraa visarai dhukh laagai sukh jai ||
59.e: If I forget my Beloved, even for an instant, suffering overtakes me and peace departs.

59.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਜਲਉ ਜਲਾਵਣੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪੈ ਰਸਾਇ ॥
59.t: jihavaa jalau jalaavanee naam na japai rasai ||
59.e: Let that tongue be burnt in flames, which does not chant the Naam with love.

59.g: ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗਲੋ ਜਮੁ ਪਕੜੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੫॥
59.t: ghaT binasai dhukh agalo jam pakaRai pachhutai ||5||
59.e: When the pitcher of the body bursts, there is terrible pain; those who are caught by the Minister of Death regret and repent. ||5||

59.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਨ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
59.t: meree meree kar ge tan dhan kalat na saath ||
59.e: Crying out, ""Mine! Mine!"", they have departed, but their bodies, their wealth, and their wives did not go with them.

59.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਭੂਲੋ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਆਥਿ ॥
59.t: bin naavai dhan baadh hai bhoolo maarag aath ||
59.e: Without the Name, wealth is useless; deceived by wealth, they have lost their way.

59.g: ਸਾਚਉ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥੋ ਕਾਥਿ ॥੬॥
59.t: saachau saahib seveeaai gurmukh akatho kaath ||6||
59.e: So serve the True Lord; become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken. ||6||

59.g: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
59.t: aavai jai bhavaieeaai piaai kirat kamai ||
59.e: Coming and going, people wander through reincarnation; they act according to their past actions.

59.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਲੇਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
59.t: poorab likhiaa kiau meTeeaai likhiaa lekh rajai ||
59.e: How can one's pre-ordained destiny be erased? It is written in accordance with the Lord's Will.

59.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
59.t: bin har naam na chhuTeeaai gurmat milai milai ||7||
59.e: Without the Name of the Lord, no one can be saved. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are united in His Union. ||7||

59.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਰਾਨੁ ॥
59.t: tis bin meraa ko nahee jis kaa jeeau paraan ||
59.e: Without Him, I have no one to call my own. My soul and my breath of life belong to Him.

59.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਲਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
59.t: haumai mamataa jal balau lobh jalau abhimaan ||
59.e: May my egotism and possessiveness be burnt to ashes, and my greed and egotistical pride consigned to the fire.

59.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੮॥੧੦॥
59.t: naanak sabadh veechaareeaai paieeaai gunee nidhaan ||8||10||
59.e: O Nanak, contemplating the Shabad, the Treasure of Excellence is obtained. ||8||10||

59.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
59.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
59.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

59.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਕਮਲੇਹਿ ॥
59.t: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee jal kamaleh ||
59.e: O mind, love the Lord, as the lotus loves the water.

59.g: ਲਹਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਛਾੜੀਐ ਭੀ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ॥
59.t: laharee naal pachhaaReeaai bhee vigasai asaneh ||
59.e: Tossed about by the waves, it still blossoms with love.

59.g: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਰਣੁ ਤਿਨੇਹਿ ॥੧॥
59.t: jal meh jeea upai kai bin jal maran tineh ||1||
59.e: In the water, the creatures are created; outside of the water they die. ||1||

60.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
60.t: man re kiau chhooTeh bin piaar ||
60.e: O mind, how can you be saved without love?

60.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
60.t: gurmukh a(n)tar rav rahiaa bakhase bhagat bha(n)ddaar ||1|| rahaau ||
60.e: God permeates the inner beings of the Gurmukhs. They are blessed with the treasure of devotion. ||1||Pause||

60.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰ ॥
60.t: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee machhulee neer ||
60.e: O mind, love the Lord, as the fish loves the water.

60.g: ਜਿਉ ਅਧਿਕਉ ਤਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਣੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
60.t: jiau adhikau tiau sukh ghano man tan saa(n)t sareer ||
60.e: The more the water, the more the happiness, and the greater the peace of mind and body.

60.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਜੀਵਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਭ ਪੀਰ ॥੨॥
60.t: bin jal ghaRee na jeeviee prabh jaanai abh peer ||2||
60.e: Without water, she cannot live, even for an instant. God knows the suffering of her mind. ||2||

60.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੇਹ ॥
60.t: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee chaatirak meh ||
60.e: O mind, love the Lord, as the song-bird loves the rain.

60.g: ਸਰ ਭਰਿ ਥਲ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨ ਪਵਈ ਕੇਹ ॥
60.t: sar bhar thal hareeaavale ik boo(n)dh na paviee keh ||
60.e: The pools are overflowing with water, and the land is luxuriantly green, but what are they to her, if that single drop of rain does not fall into her mouth?

60.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੇਹ ॥੩॥
60.t: karam milai so paieeaai kirat piaa sir dheh ||3||
60.e: By His Grace, she receives it; otherwise, because of her past actions, she gives her head. ||3||

60.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਹੋਇ ॥
60.t: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee jal dhudh hoi ||
60.e: O mind, love the Lord, as the water loves the milk.

60.g: ਆਵਟਣੁ ਆਪੇ ਖਵੈ ਦੁਧ ਕਉ ਖਪਣਿ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
60.t: aavaTan aape khavai dhudh kau khapan na dhei ||
60.e: The water, added to the milk, itself bears the heat, and prevents the milk from burning.

60.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੪॥
60.t: aape mel vichhu(n)niaa sach vaddiaaiee dhei ||4||
60.e: God unites the separated ones with Himself again, and blesses them with true greatness. ||4||

60.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਐਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਸੀ ਚਕਵੀ ਸੂਰ ॥
60.t: re man aaisee har siau preet kar jaisee chakavee soor ||
60.e: O mind, love the Lord, as the chakvee duck loves the sun.

60.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
60.t: khin pal needh na soviee jaanai dhoor hajoor ||
60.e: She does not sleep, for an instant or a moment; the sun is so far away, but she thinks that it is near.

60.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੫॥
60.t: manmukh sojhee naa pavai gurmukh sadhaa hajoor ||5||
60.e: Understanding does not come to the self-willed manmukh. But to the Gurmukh, the Lord is always close. ||5||

60.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਵਣੀ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
60.t: manmukh ganat ganaavanee karataa kare su hoi ||
60.e: The self-willed manmukhs make their calculations and plans, but only the actions of the Creator come to pass.

60.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
60.t: taa kee keemat naa pavai je lochai sabh koi ||
60.e: His Value cannot be estimated, even though everyone may wish to do so.

60.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
60.t: gurmat hoi ta paieeaai sach milai sukh hoi ||6||
60.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, it is revealed. Meeting with the True One, peace is found. ||6||

60.g: ਸਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
60.t: sachaa neh na tuTiee je satigur bheTai soi ||
60.e: True love shall not be broken, if the True Guru is met.

60.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
60.t: giaan padhaarath paieeaai tirabhavan sojhee hoi ||
60.e: Obtaining the wealth of spiritual wisdom, the understanding of the three worlds is acquired.

60.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
60.t: niramal naam na veesarai je gun kaa gaahak hoi ||7||
60.e: So become a customer of merit, and do not forget the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

60.g: ਖੇਲਿ ਗਏ ਸੇ ਪੰਖਣੂੰ ਜੋ ਚੁਗਦੇ ਸਰ ਤਲਿ ॥
60.t: khel ge se pa(n)khanoo(n) jo chugadhe sar tal ||
60.e: Those birds which peck at the shore of the pool have played and have departed.

60.g: ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਖੇਲਣੁ ਅਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਲਿ ॥
60.t: ghaRee k muhat k chalanaa khelan aj k kal ||
60.e: In a moment, in an instant, we too must depart. Our play is only for today or tomorrow.

60.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਚਾ ਪਿੜੁ ਮਲਿ ॥੮॥
60.t: jis too(n) meleh so milai jai sachaa piR mal ||8||
60.e: But those whom You unite, Lord, are united with You; they obtain a seat in the Arena of Truth. ||8||

60.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
60.t: bin gur preet na uoopajai haumai mail na jai ||
60.e: Without the Guru, love does not well up, and the filth of egotism does not depart.

60.g: ਸੋਹੰ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
60.t: soha(n) aap pachhaaneeaai sabadh bhedh pateeaai ||
60.e: One who recognizes within himself that, ""He is me"", and who is pierced through by the Shabad, is satisfied.

60.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਅਵਰ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇ ॥੯॥
60.t: gurmukh aap pachhaaneeaai avar k kare karai ||9||
60.e: When one becomes Gurmukh and realizes his own self, what more is there left to do or have done? ||9||

60.g: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਲੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
60.t: miliaa kaa kiaa meleeaai sabadh mile pateeaai ||
60.e: Why speak of union to those who are already united with the Lord? Receiving the Shabad, they are satisfied.

60.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਵੀਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
60.t: manmukh sojhee naa pavai veechhuR choTaa khai ||
60.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not understand; separated from Him, they endure beatings.

60.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜੀ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
60.t: naanak dhar ghar ek hai avar na dhoojee jai ||10||11||
60.e: O Nanak, there is only the one door to His Home; there is no other place at all. ||10||11||

60.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
60.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
60.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

60.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭੁਲੈ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ ਭੂਲੀ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਇ ॥
60.t: manmukh bhulai bhulaieeaai bhoolee Thaur na kai ||
60.e: The self-willed manmukhs wander around, deluded and deceived. They find no place of rest.

60.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ਅੰਧੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
60.t: gur bin ko na dhikhaaviee a(n)dhee aavai jai ||
60.e: Without the Guru, no one is shown the Way. Like the blind, they continue coming and going.

60.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਠਗਿਆ ਮੁਠਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
60.t: giaan padhaarath khoiaa Thagiaa muThaa jai ||1||
60.e: Having lost the treasure of spiritual wisdom, they depart, defrauded and plundered. ||1||

60.g: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
60.t: baabaa maiaa bharam bhulai ||
60.e: O Baba, Maya deceives with its illusion.

60.g: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੀ ਡੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਨਾ ਪਿਰ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
60.t: bharam bhulee ddohaaganee naa pir a(n)k samai ||1|| rahaau ||
60.e: Deceived by doubt, the discarded bride is not received into the Lap of her Beloved. ||1||Pause||

60.g: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੀ ਭੂਲੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
60.t: bhoolee firai dhisa(n)taree bhoolee girahu taj jai ||
60.e: The deceived bride wanders around in foreign lands; she leaves, and abandons her own home.

60.g: ਭੂਲੀ ਡੂੰਗਰਿ ਥਲਿ ਚੜੈ ਭਰਮੈ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
60.t: bhoolee ddoo(n)gar thal chaRai bharamai man ddolai ||
60.e: Deceived, she climbs the plateaus and mountains; her mind wavers in doubt.

60.g: ਧੁਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
60.t: dhurahu vichhu(n)nee kiau milai garab muThee bilalai ||2||
60.e: Separated from the Primal Being, how can she meet with Him again? Plundered by pride, she cries out and bewails. ||2||

60.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
60.t: vichhuRiaa gur melasee har ras naam piaar ||
60.e: The Guru unites the separated ones with the Lord again, through the love of the Delicious Name of the Lord.

61.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਘਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
61.t: saach sahaj sobhaa ghanee har gun naam adhaar ||
61.e: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.

61.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
61.t: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too(n) mai tujh bin kavan bhataar ||3||
61.e: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||

61.g: ਅਖਰ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਭੇਖੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
61.t: akhar paR paR bhuleeaai bhekhee bahut abhimaan ||
61.e: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.

61.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
61.t: teerath naataa kiaa kare man meh mail gumaan ||
61.e: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?

61.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
61.t: gur bin kin samajhaieeaai man raajaa sulataan ||4||
61.e: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||

61.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
61.t: prem padhaarath paieeaai gurmukh tat veechaar ||
61.e: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.

61.g: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
61.t: saa dhan aap gavaiaa gur kai sabadh seegaar ||
61.e: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

61.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
61.t: ghar hee so pir paiaa gur kai het apaar ||5||
61.e: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||

61.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
61.t: gur kee sevaa chaakaree man niramal sukh hoi ||
61.e: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.

61.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
61.t: gur kaa sabadh man vasiaa haumai vichahu khoi ||
61.e: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.

61.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
61.t: naam padhaarath paiaa laabh sadhaa man hoi ||6||
61.e: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||

61.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
61.t: karam milai taa paieeaai aap na liaa jai ||
61.e: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.

61.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
61.t: gur kee charanee lag rahu vichahu aap gavai ||
61.e: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.

61.g: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਸਚੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੭॥
61.t: sache setee ratiaa sacho palai pai ||7||
61.e: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||

61.g: ਭੁਲਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
61.t: bhulan a(n)dhar sabh ko abhul guroo karataar ||
61.e: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.

61.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
61.t: gurmat man samajhaiaa laagaa tisai piaar ||
61.e: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.

61.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧੨॥
61.t: naanak saach na veesarai mele sabadh apaar ||8||12||
61.e: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||

61.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
61.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
61.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

61.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਘਰ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
61.t: tirasanaa maiaa mohanee sut ba(n)dhap ghar naar ||
61.e: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.

61.g: ਧਨਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ॥
61.t: dhan joban jag Thagiaa lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
61.e: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.

61.g: ਮੋਹ ਠਗਉਲੀ ਹਉ ਮੁਈ ਸਾ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
61.t: moh Thagaulee hau muiee saa varatai sa(n)saar ||1||
61.e: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||

61.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
61.t: mere preetamaa mai tujh bin avar na koi ||
61.e: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.

61.g: ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤੂੰ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
61.t: mai tujh bin avar na bhaaviee too(n) bhaaveh sukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
61.e: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||

61.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
61.t: naam saalaahee ra(n)g siau gur kai sabadh sa(n)tokh ||
61.e: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

61.g: ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਕੂੜਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
61.t: jo dheesai so chalasee kooRaa moh na vekh ||
61.e: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.

61.g: ਵਾਟ ਵਟਾਊ ਆਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਦਾ ਸਾਥੁ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੨॥
61.t: vaaT vaTaauoo aaiaa nit chaladhaa saath dhekh ||2||
61.e: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||

61.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਆਖਹਿ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
61.t: aakhan aakheh ketaRe gur bin boojh na hoi ||
61.e: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.

61.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਪੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
61.t: naam vaddaiee je milai sach rapai pat hoi ||
61.e: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.

61.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
61.t: jo tudh bhaaveh se bhale khoTaa kharaa na koi ||3||
61.e: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||

61.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਖੋਟੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
61.t: gur saranaiee chhuTeeaai manmukh khoTee raas ||
61.e: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.

61.g: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਕੀ ਘੜੀਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸਿ ॥
61.t: asaT dhaat paatisaeh kee ghaReeaai sabadh vigaas ||
61.e: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.

61.g: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਪਵੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥
61.t: aape parakhe paarakhoo pavai khajaanai raas ||4||
61.e: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||

61.g: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥
61.t: teree keemat naa pavai sabh ddiThee Thok vajai ||
61.e: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.

61.g: ਕਹਣੈ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਸਚਿ ਟਿਕੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
61.t: kahanai haath na labhiee sach Tikai pat pai ||
61.e: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.

61.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
61.t: gurmat too(n) saalaahanaa hor keemat kahan na jai ||5||
61.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||

61.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਵਈ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਾਦੁ ॥
61.t: jit tan naam na bhaaviee tit tan haumai vaadh ||
61.e: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.

61.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
61.t: gur bin giaan na paieeaai bikhiaa dhoojaa saadh ||
61.e: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.

61.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੀਕਾ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੬॥
61.t: bin gun kaam na aaviee maiaa feekaa saadh ||6||
61.e: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||

61.g: ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਖਾਇ ॥
61.t: aasaa a(n)dhar ja(n)miaa aasaa ras kas khai ||
61.e: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.

61.g: ਆਸਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
61.t: aasaa ba(n)dh chalaieeaai muhe muh choTaa khai ||
61.e: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.

61.g: ਅਵਗਣਿ ਬਧਾ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੭॥
61.t: avagan badhaa maareeaai chhooTai gurmat nai ||7||
61.e: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||

62.g: ਸਰਬੇ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
62.t: sarabe thaiee ek too(n) jiau bhaavai tiau raakh ||
62.e: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!

62.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਲੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
62.t: gurmat saachaa man vasai naam bhalo pat saakh ||
62.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. The Companionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.

62.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖੁ ॥੮॥
62.t: haumai rog gavaieeaai sabadh sachai sach bhaakh ||8||
62.e: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the True Lord. ||8||

62.g: ਆਕਾਸੀ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
62.t: aakaasee paataal too(n) tirabhavan rahiaa samai ||
62.e: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the three worlds.

62.g: ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
62.t: aape bhagatee bhaau too(n) aape mileh milai ||
62.e: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union with Yourself.

62.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੯॥੧੩॥
62.t: naanak naam na veesarai jiau bhaavai tivai rajai ||9||13||
62.e: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13||

62.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
62.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
62.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

62.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
62.t: raam naam man bedhiaa avar k karee veechaar ||
62.e: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?

62.g: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤਉ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
62.t: sabadh surat sukh uoopajai prabh raatau sukh saar ||
62.e: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.

62.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
62.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakh too(n) mai har naam adhaar ||1||
62.e: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||

62.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
62.t: man re saachee khasam rajai ||
62.e: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.

62.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
62.t: jin tan man saaj seegaariaa tis setee liv lai ||1|| rahaau ||
62.e: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind. ||1||Pause||

62.g: ਤਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਹੋਮੀਐ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤੋਲਿ ਕਟਾਇ ॥
62.t: tan baisa(n)tar homeeaai ik ratee tol kaTai ||
62.e: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,

62.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਧਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
62.t: tan man samadhaa je karee anadhin agan jalai ||
62.e: and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in the fire,

62.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
62.t: har naamai tul na pujiee je lakh koTee karam kamai ||2||
62.e: and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all these are not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||

62.g: ਅਰਧ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਟਾਈਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਵਤੁ ਧਰਾਇ ॥
62.t: aradh sareer kaTaieeaai sir karavat dharai ||
62.e: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,

62.g: ਤਨੁ ਹੈਮੰਚਲਿ ਗਾਲੀਐ ਭੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
62.t: tan haima(n)chal gaaleeaai bhee man te rog na jai ||
62.e: and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free of disease.

62.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਪੁਜਈ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀ ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
62.t: har naamai tul na pujiee sabh ddiThee Thok vajai ||3||
62.e: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||

62.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਦਤੁ ਕਰੀ ਬਹੁ ਹੈਵਰ ਗੈਵਰ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
62.t: ka(n)chan ke koT dhat karee bahu haivar gaivar dhaan ||
62.e: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrous elephants in charity,

62.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਗਊਆ ਘਣੀ ਭੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
62.t: bhoom dhaan guooaa ghanee bhee a(n)tar garab gumaan ||
62.e: and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still be within me.

62.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
62.t: raam naam man bedhiaa gur dheeaa sach dhaan ||4||
62.e: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift. ||4||

62.g: ਮਨਹਠ ਬੁਧੀ ਕੇਤੀਆ ਕੇਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
62.t: manahaTh budhee keteeaa kete bedh beechaar ||
62.e: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplate the Vedas.

62.g: ਕੇਤੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
62.t: kete ba(n)dhan jeea ke gurmukh mokh dhuaar ||
62.e: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gate of Liberation.

62.g: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
62.t: sachahu orai sabh ko upar sach aachaar ||5||
62.e: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||

62.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਊਚਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਨੀਚੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
62.t: sabh ko uoochaa aakheeaai neech na dheesai koi ||
62.e: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.

62.g: ਇਕਨੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਐ ਇਕੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ॥
62.t: eikanai bhaa(n)dde saajiaai ik chaanan tih loi ||
62.e: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.

62.g: ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਧੁਰਿ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
62.t: karam milai sach paieeaai dhur bakhas na meTai koi ||6||
62.e: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||

62.g: ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
62.t: saadh milai saadhoo janai sa(n)tokh vasai gur bhai ||
62.e: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.

62.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
62.t: akath kathaa veechaareeaai je satigur maeh samai ||
62.e: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.

62.g: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
62.t: pee a(n)mrit sa(n)tokhiaa dharageh paidhaa jai ||7||
62.e: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||7||

62.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
62.t: ghaT ghaT vaajai ki(n)guree anadhin sabadh subhai ||
62.e: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, with sublime love for the Shabad.

62.g: ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
62.t: virale kau sojhee piee gurmukh man samajhai ||
62.e: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.

62.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੪॥
62.t: naanak naam na veesarai chhooTai sabadh kamai ||8||14||
62.e: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14||

62.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
62.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
62.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

62.g: ਚਿਤੇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਧਉਲਹਰ ਬਗੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
62.t: chite dhiseh dhaulahar bage ba(n)k dhuaar ||
62.e: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;

62.g: ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਖੁਸੀ ਉਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
62.t: kar man khusee usaariaa dhoojai het piaar ||
62.e: they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.

62.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖਾਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਢਹਿ ਢੇਰੀ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
62.t: a(n)dhar khaalee prem bin ddeh dderee tan chhaar ||1||
62.e: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||

62.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
62.t: bhaiee re tan dhan saath na hoi ||
62.e: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.

62.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
62.t: raam naam dhan niramalo gur dhaat kare prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
62.e: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift. ||1||Pause||

62.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਜੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
62.t: raam naam dhan niramalo je dhevai dhevanahaar ||
62.e: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.

62.g: ਆਗੈ ਪੂਛ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
62.t: aagai poochh na hoviee jis belee gur karataar ||
62.e: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.

62.g: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
62.t: aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai aape bakhasanahaar ||2||
62.e: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

63.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
63.t: manmukh jaanai aapane dheeaa poot sa(n)jog ||
63.e: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.

63.g: ਨਾਰੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
63.t: naaree dhekh vigaase'eeh naale harakhu su sog ||
63.e: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.

63.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੩॥
63.t: gurmukh sabadh ra(n)gaavale ahinis har ras bhog ||3||
63.e: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

63.g: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਵਿਤੁ ਜਾਵਣੋ ਸਾਕਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਇ ॥
63.t: chit chalai vit jaavano saakat ddol ddolai ||
63.e: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search of transitory wealth, unstable and distracted.

63.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਢੂੰਢਿ ਵਿਗੁਚੀਐ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਸੁਥਾਇ ॥
63.t: baahar ddoo(n)dd vigucheeaai ghar meh vasat suthai ||
63.e: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in that sacred place within the home of the heart.

63.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥
63.t: manmukh haumai kar musee gurmukh palai pai ||4||
63.e: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps. ||4||

63.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿਆਰਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
63.t: saakat niraguniaariaa aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
63.e: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!

63.g: ਰਕਤੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੋ ਅਗਨੀ ਪਾਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣੁ ॥
63.t: rakat bi(n)dh kaa ih tano aganee paas piraan ||
63.e: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.

63.g: ਪਵਣੈ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
63.t: pavanai kai vas dhehuree masatak sach neesaan ||5||
63.e: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||

63.g: ਬਹੁਤਾ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਮੁਆ ਨ ਲੋੜੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
63.t: bahutaa jeevan ma(n)geeaai muaa na loRai koi ||
63.e: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.

63.g: ਸੁਖ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
63.t: sukh jeevan tis aakheeaai jis gurmukh vasiaa soi ||
63.e: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.

63.g: ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
63.t: naam vihoone kiaa ganee jis har gur dharas na hoi ||6||
63.e: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Lord and Guru? ||6||

63.g: ਜਿਉ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੁਲੀਐ ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
63.t: jiau supanai nis bhuleeaai jab lag nidhraa hoi ||
63.e: In their dreams at night, people wander around as long as they sleep;

63.g: ਇਉ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
63.t: eiau sarapan kai vas jeeaRaa a(n)tar haumai dhoi ||
63.e: just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filled with ego and duality.

63.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੋਇ ॥੭॥
63.t: gurmat hoi veechaareeaai supanaa ih jag loi ||7||
63.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world is just a dream. ||7||

63.g: ਅਗਨਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਦੂਧੈ ਮਾਇ ॥
63.t: agan marai jal paieeaai jiau baarik dhoodhai mai ||
63.e: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,

63.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਸੁ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਮੀਨੁ ਮਰਾਇ ॥
63.t: bin jal kamal su naa theeaai bin jal meen marai ||
63.e: and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water

63.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੮॥੧੫॥
63.t: naanak gurmukh har ras milai jeevaa har gun gai ||8||15||
63.e: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15||

63.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
63.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
63.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

63.g: ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੋ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਡਰੀਆਸੁ ॥
63.t: ddoo(n)gar dhekh ddaraavano peieeaRai ddareeaas ||
63.e: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.

63.g: ਊਚਉ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਗਾਖੜੋ ਨਾ ਪਉੜੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਾਸੁ ॥
63.t: uoochau parabat gaakhaRo naa pauRee tit taas ||
63.e: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.

63.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਰੀਆਸੁ ॥੧॥
63.t: gurmukh a(n)tar jaaniaa gur melee tareeaas ||1||
63.e: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union, and so I cross over. ||1||

63.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਡਰਾਂਉ ॥
63.t: bhaiee re bhavajal bikham ddaraa(n)au ||
63.e: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!

63.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਸਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
63.t: pooraa satigur ras milai gur taare har naau ||1|| rahaau ||
63.e: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me, through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

63.g: ਚਲਾ ਚਲਾ ਜੇ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਲਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
63.t: chalaa chalaa je karee jaanaa chalanahaar ||
63.e: I may say, ""I am going, I am going"", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.

63.g: ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਚਲਸੀ ਅਮਰੁ ਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
63.t: jo aaiaa so chalasee amaru su gur karataar ||
63.e: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.

63.g: ਭੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
63.t: bhee sachaa saalaahanaa sachai thaan piaar ||2||
63.e: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||

63.g: ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਪਕੇ ਕੋਟ ਹਜਾਰ ॥
63.t: dhar ghar mahalaa sohane pake koT hajaar ||
63.e: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,

63.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
63.t: hasatee ghoRe paakhare lasakar lakh apaar ||
63.e: elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies

63.g: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੁਏ ਅਸਾਰ ॥੩॥
63.t: kis hee naal na chaliaa khap khap mue asaar ||3||
63.e: -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||

63.g: ਸੁਇਨਾ ਰੁਪਾ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਮਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
63.t: suinaa rupaa sa(n)cheeaai maal jaal ja(n)jaal ||
63.e: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.

63.g: ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਹੀ ਫੇਰੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
63.t: sabh jag meh dhohee fereeaai bin naavai sir kaal ||
63.e: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without the Name, death hovers over your head.

63.g: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਜੀਉ ਖੇਲਸੀ ਬਦਫੈਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
63.t: pi(n)dd paRai jeeau khelasee badhafailee kiaa haal ||4||
63.e: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||

63.g: ਪੁਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੀਐ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰ ॥
63.t: putaa dhekh vigaseeaai naaree sej bhataar ||
63.e: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.

63.g: ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
63.t: choaa cha(n)dhan laieeaai kaapaR roop seegaar ||
63.e: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.

63.g: ਖੇਹੂ ਖੇਹ ਰਲਾਈਐ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
63.t: khehoo kheh ralaieeaai chhodd chalai ghar baar ||5||
63.e: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||

63.g: ਮਹਰ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਾਈਐ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਉ ਕਿ ਖਾਨੁ ॥
63.t: mahar malook kahaieeaai raajaa raau k khaan ||
63.e: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;

63.g: ਚਉਧਰੀ ਰਾਉ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਜਲਿ ਬਲੀਐ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
63.t: chaudharee raau sadhaieeaai jal baleeaai abhimaan ||
63.e: he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire of egotistical pride.

63.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਡਵਿ ਦਧਾ ਕਾਨੁ ॥੬॥
63.t: manmukh naam visaariaa jiau ddav dhadhaa kaan ||6||
63.e: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in the forest fire. ||6||

63.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਆਇਆ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
63.t: haumai kar kar jaisee jo aaiaa jag maeh ||
63.e: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart.

64.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਕਾਜਲ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਆਹਿ ॥
64.t: sabh jag kaajal koThaRee tan man dheh suaaeh ||
64.e: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.

64.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੭॥
64.t: gur raakhe se niramale sabadh nivaaree bhaeh ||7||
64.e: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of the Shabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||

64.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
64.t: naanak tareeaai sach naam sir saahaa paatisaahu ||
64.e: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the heads of kings.

64.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
64.t: mai har naam na veesarai har naam ratan vesaahu ||
64.e: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.

64.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਉਜਲਿ ਪਚਿ ਮੁਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਅਥਾਹੁ ॥੮॥੧੬॥
64.t: manmukh bhaujal pach mue gurmukh tare athaahu ||8||16||
64.e: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while the Gurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16||

64.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
64.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa ||
64.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Second House:

64.g: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਣੈ ਕੀ ਧੋਖ ॥
64.t: mukaam kar ghar baisanaa nit chalanai kee dhokh ||
64.e: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to depart is always there.

64.g: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਾ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
64.t: mukaam taa par jaaneeaai jaa rahai nihachal lok ||1||
64.e: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable and unchanging. ||1||

64.g: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈਸਿ ਮੁਕਾਮੇ ॥
64.t: dhuneeaa kais mukaame ||
64.e: What sort of a resting place is this world?

64.g: ਕਰਿ ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
64.t: kar sidhak karanee kharach baadhahu laag rahu naame ||1|| rahaau ||
64.e: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed to the Name. ||1||Pause||

64.g: ਜੋਗੀ ਤ ਆਸਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਲਾ ਬਹੈ ਮੁਕਾਮਿ ॥
64.t: jogee ta aasan kar bahai mulaa bahai mukaam ||
64.e: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.

64.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਸਿਧ ਬਹਹਿ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
64.t: pa(n)ddit vakhaaneh potheeaa sidh baheh dhev sathaan ||2||
64.e: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||

64.g: ਸੁਰ ਸਿਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਪੀਰ ਸਲਾਰ ॥
64.t: sur sidh gan ga(n)dharab mun jan sekh peer salaar ||
64.e: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints, priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders

64.g: ਦਰਿ ਕੂਚ ਕੂਚਾ ਕਰਿ ਗਏ ਅਵਰੇ ਭਿ ਚਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
64.t: dhar kooch koochaa kar ge avare bh chalanahaar ||3||
64.e: -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||

64.g: ਸੁਲਤਾਨ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਉਮਰੇ ਗਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੂਚੁ ॥
64.t: sulataan khaan malook umare ge kar kar kooch ||
64.e: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.

64.g: ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਦਿਲ ਸਮਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਭਿ ਪਹੂਚੁ ॥੪॥
64.t: ghaRee muhat k chalanaa dhil samajh too(n) bh pahooch ||4||
64.e: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must go as well! ||4||

64.g: ਸਬਦਾਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਤ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
64.t: sabadhaeh maeh vakhaaneeaai viralaa ta boojhai koi ||
64.e: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!

64.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੫॥
64.t: naanak vakhaanai benatee jal thal maheeal soi ||5||
64.e: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air. ||5||

64.g: ਅਲਾਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰੀਮੁ ॥
64.t: alaahu alakh aga(n)m kaadhar karanahaar kareem ||
64.e: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.

64.g: ਸਭ ਦੁਨੀ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਰਹੀਮੁ ॥੬॥
64.t: sabh dhunee aavan jaavanee mukaam ek raheem ||6||
64.e: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||

64.g: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਸਿ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
64.t: mukaam tis no aakheeaai jis sis na hovee lekh ||
64.e: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.

64.g: ਅਸਮਾਨੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਚਲਸੀ ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ॥੭॥
64.t: asamaan dharatee chalasee mukaam ohee ek ||7||
64.e: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||

64.g: ਦਿਨ ਰਵਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਸਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਲੈ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਲਖ ਪਲੋਇ ॥
64.t: dhin rav chalai nis sas chalai taarikaa lakh paloi ||
64.e: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.

64.g: ਮੁਕਾਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਬੁਗੋਇ ॥੮॥੧੭॥
64.t: mukaam ohee ek hai naanakaa sach bugoi ||8||17||
64.e: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17||

64.g: ਮਹਲੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਤਾਰਹ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
64.t: mahale pahile sataareh asaTapadheeaa ||
64.e: Seventeen Ashtpadheeyaa Of The First Mehla.

64.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ
64.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa
64.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:

64.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
64.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
64.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

64.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
64.t: gurmukh kirapaa kare bhagat keejai bin gur bhagat na hoi ||
64.e: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

64.g: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
64.t: aapai aap milaae boojhai taa niramal hovai koi ||
64.e: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.

64.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
64.t: har jeeau sachaa sachee baanee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||1||
64.e: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||

64.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਭਗਤਿਹੀਣੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਗਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
64.t: bhaiee re bhagatiheen kaahe jag aaiaa ||
64.e: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?

64.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
64.t: poore gur kee sev na keenee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
64.e: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||

64.g: ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
64.t: aape har jagajeevan dhaataa aape bakhas milaae ||
64.e: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.

64.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਏ ਕਿਆ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
64.t: jeea ja(n)t e kiaa vechaare kiaa ko aakh sunaae ||
64.e: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?

64.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
64.t: gurmukh aape dhe vaddiaaiee aape sev karaae ||2||
64.e: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||

64.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
64.t: dhekh kuTa(n)b moh lobhaanaa chaladhiaa naal na jaiee ||
64.e: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.

65.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
65.t: satigur sev gun nidhaan paiaa tis kee keem na paiee ||
65.e: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.

65.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
65.t: prabh sakhaa har jeeau meraa a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||3||
65.e: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||

65.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
65.t: peieeaRai jagajeevan dhaataa manmukh pat gavaiee ||
65.e: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.

65.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
65.t: bin satigur ko mag na jaanai a(n)dhe Thaur na kaiee ||
65.e: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.

65.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥੪॥
65.t: har sukhadhaataa man nahee vasiaa a(n)t giaa pachhutaiee ||4||
65.e: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall depart with regret in the end. ||4||

65.g: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
65.t: peieeaRai jagajeevan dhaataa gurmat ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
65.e: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivated within my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.

65.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
65.t: anadhin bhagat kareh dhin raatee haumai moh chukaiaa ||
65.e: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotional attachment are removed.

65.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਤਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
65.t: jis siau raataa taiso hovai sache sach samaiaa ||5||
65.e: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||

65.g: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਭਾਉ ਲਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
65.t: aape nadhar kare bhaau laae gur sabadhee beechaar ||
65.e: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

65.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
65.t: satigur seviaai sahaj uoopajai haumai tirasanaa maar ||
65.e: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.

65.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
65.t: har gunadhaataa sadh man vasai sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||6||
65.e: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||

65.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
65.t: prabh meraa sadhaa niramalaa man niramal paiaa jai ||
65.e: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.

65.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
65.t: naam nidhaan har man vasai haumai dhukh sabh jai ||
65.e: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain are totally eliminated.

65.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੭॥
65.t: satigur sabadh sunaiaa hau sadh balihaarai jaau ||7||
65.e: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||7||

65.g: ਆਪਣੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
65.t: aapanai man chit kahai kahaae bin gur aap na jaiee ||
65.e: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.

65.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
65.t: har jeeau bhagat vachhal sukhadhaataa kar kirapaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||
65.e: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, He abides within the mind.

65.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥੧॥੧੮॥
65.t: naanak sobhaa surat dhei prabh aape gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee ||8||1||18||
65.e: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18||

65.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
65.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
65.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

65.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਮਡੰਡੁ ਲਗੈ ਤਿਨ ਆਇ ॥
65.t: haumai karam kamaavadhe jamadda(n)dd lagai tin aai ||
65.e: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Death with his club.

65.g: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
65.t: j satigur sevan se ubare har setee liv lai ||1||
65.e: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||

65.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
65.t: man re gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
65.e: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

65.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
65.t: dhur poorab karatai likhiaa tinaa gurmat naam samai ||1|| rahaau ||
65.e: Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

65.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
65.t: vin satigur parateet na aaviee naam na laago bhaau ||
65.e: Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.

65.g: ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਸਵੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
65.t: supanai sukh na paaviee dhukh meh savai samai ||2||
65.e: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||

65.g: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਲੋਚੀਐ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
65.t: je har har keechai bahut locheeaai kirat na meTiaa jai ||
65.e: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your past actions are still not erased.

65.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਗਤੀ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਪਏ ਦਰਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੩॥
65.t: har kaa bhaanaa bhagatee ma(n)niaa se bhagat pe dhar thai ||3||
65.e: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door. ||3||

65.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਿੜਾਵੈ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
65.t: gur sabadh dhiRaavai ra(n)g siau bin kirapaa liaa na jai ||
65.e: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.

65.g: ਜੇ ਸਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੀਐ ਭੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥੪॥
65.t: je sau a(n)mrit neereeaai bhee bikh fal laagai dhai ||4||
65.e: Even if the poisonous plant is watered with ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||

65.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
65.t: se jan sache niramale jin satigur naal piaar ||
65.e: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.

65.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥੫॥
65.t: satigur kaa bhaanaa kamaavadhe bikh haumai taj vikaar ||5||
65.e: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego and corruption. ||5||

65.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਉਪਾਇ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਧਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
65.t: manahaTh kitai upai na chhooTeeaai simirat saasatr sodhahu jai ||
65.e: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and the Shaastras.

65.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਬਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੬॥
65.t: mil sa(n)gat saadhoo ubare gur kaa sabadh kamai ||6||
65.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of the Guru, you shall be saved. ||6||

65.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
65.t: har kaa naam nidhaan hai jis a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
65.e: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.

65.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਈ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
65.t: gurmukh seiee sohadhe jin kirapaa kare karataar ||7||
65.e: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||

65.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
65.t: naanak dhaataa ek hai dhoojaa aaur na koi ||
65.e: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.

65.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੨॥੧੯॥
65.t: gur parasaadhee paieeaai karam paraapat hoi ||8||2||19||
65.e: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19||

66.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
66.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
66.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

66.g: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਚੁਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
66.t: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRaa sach chugai gur bhai ||
66.e: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.

66.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਡੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
66.t: har ras peevai sahaj rahai uddai na aavai jai ||
66.e: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.

66.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
66.t: nij ghar vaasaa paiaa har har naam samai ||1||
66.e: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

66.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
66.t: man re gur kee kaar kamai ||
66.e: O mind, work to serve the Guru.

66.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
66.t: gur kai bhaanai je chaleh taa anadhin raacheh har nai ||1|| rahaau ||
66.e: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||

66.g: ਪੰਖੀ ਬਿਰਖ ਸੁਹਾਵੜੇ ਊਡਹਿ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
66.t: pa(n)khee birakh suhaavaRe uooddeh chahu dhis jaeh ||
66.e: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.

66.g: ਜੇਤਾ ਊਡਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਘਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਦਾਝਹਿ ਤੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਹਿ ॥
66.t: jetaa uooddeh dhukh ghane nit dhaajheh tai bilalaeh ||
66.e: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.

66.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
66.t: bin gur mahal na jaapiee naa a(n)mirat fal paeh ||2||
66.e: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||

66.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
66.t: gurmukh braham hareeaavalaa saachai sahaj subhai ||
66.e: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.

66.g: ਸਾਖਾ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
66.t: saakhaa teen nivaareeaa ek sabadh liv lai ||
66.e: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.

66.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
66.t: a(n)mirat fal har ek hai aape dhei khavai ||3||
66.e: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||

66.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਊਭੇ ਸੁਕਿ ਗਏ ਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਤਿੰਨਾ ਛਾਉ ॥
66.t: manmukh uoobhe suk ge naa fal ti(n)naa chhaau ||
66.e: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.

66.g: ਤਿੰਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ਨ ਬੈਸੀਐ ਓਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਨ ਗਿਰਾਉ ॥
66.t: ti(n)naa paas na baiseeaai onaa ghar na giraau ||
66.e: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.

66.g: ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥
66.t: kaTe'eeh tai nit jaale'eeh onaa sabadh na naau ||4||
66.e: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||

66.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
66.t: hukame karam kamaavane piaai kirat firaau ||
66.e: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.

66.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
66.t: hukame dharasan dhekhanaa jeh bhejeh teh jaau ||
66.e: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.

66.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੫॥
66.t: hukame har har man vasai hukame sach samaau ||5||
66.e: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||

66.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
66.t: hukam na jaaneh bapuRe bhoole fireh gavaar ||
66.e: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.

66.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
66.t: manahaTh karam kamaavadhe nit nit hoh khuaar ||
66.e: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.

66.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
66.t: a(n)tar saa(n)t na aaviee naa sach lagai piaar ||6||
66.e: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||

66.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀਆ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
66.t: gurmukheeaa muh sohane gur kai het piaar ||
66.e: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.

66.g: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰ ॥
66.t: sachee bhagatee sach rate dhar sachai sachiaar ||
66.e: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.

66.g: ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
66.t: aae se paravaan hai sabh kul kaa kareh udhaar ||7||
66.e: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||

66.g: ਸਭ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
66.t: sabh nadharee karam kamaavadhe nadharee baahar na koi ||
66.e: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.

66.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਚਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੀ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
66.t: jaisee nadhar kar dhekhai sachaa taisaa hee ko hoi ||
66.e: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.

66.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੩॥੨੦॥
66.t: naanak naam vaddaieeaa karam paraapat hoi ||8||3||20||
66.e: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||

66.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
66.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
66.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

66.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
66.t: gurmukh naam dhiaaieeaai manmukh boojh na pai ||
66.e: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.

66.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
66.t: gurmukh sadhaa mukh uoojale har vasiaa man aai ||
66.e: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.

66.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
66.t: sahaje hee sukh paieeaai sahaje rahai samai ||1||
66.e: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||

66.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
66.t: bhaiee re dhaasan dhaasaa hoi ||
66.e: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

66.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
66.t: gur kee sevaa gur bhagat hai viralaa paae koi ||1|| rahaau ||
66.e: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||

66.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
66.t: sadhaa suhaag suhaaganee je chaleh satigur bhai ||
66.e: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

66.g: ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
66.t: sadhaa pir nihachal paieeaai naa oh marai na jai ||
66.e: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.

66.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਨਾ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
66.t: sabadh milee naa veechhuRai pir kai a(n)k samai ||2||
66.e: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||

66.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਜਲਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
66.t: har niramal at uoojalaa bin gur paiaa na jai ||
66.e: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.

66.g: ਪਾਠੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾ ਬੂਝਈ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
66.t: paaTh paRai naa boojhiee bhekhee bharam bhulai ||
66.e: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.

66.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
66.t: gurmatee har sadhaa paiaa rasanaa har ras samai ||3||
66.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

66.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
66.t: maiaa moh chukaiaa gurmatee sahaj subhai ||
66.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.

67.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਫਿਰੈ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਗਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
67.t: bin sabadhai jag dhukheeaa firai manmukhaa no giee khai ||
67.e: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.

67.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
67.t: sabadhe naam dhiaaieeaai sabadhe sach samai ||4||
67.e: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge in Truth. ||4||

67.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਿਧ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
67.t: maiaa bhoole sidh fireh samaadh na lagai subhai ||
67.e: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in the Samaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.

67.g: ਤੀਨੇ ਲੋਅ ਵਿਆਪਤ ਹੈ ਅਧਿਕ ਰਹੀ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
67.t: teene loa viaapat hai adhik rahee lapaTai ||
67.e: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.

67.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
67.t: bin gur mukat na paieeaai naa dhubidhaa maiaa jai ||5||
