67.e: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya does not go away. ||5||

67.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
67.t: maiaa kis no aakheeaai kiaa maiaa karam kamai ||
67.e: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?

67.g: ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਬਧੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
67.t: dhukh sukh eh jeeau badh hai haumai karam kamai ||
67.e: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.

67.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਨਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
67.t: bin sabadhai bharam na chookiee naa vichahu haumai jai ||6||
67.e: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within. ||6||

67.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
67.t: bin preetee bhagat na hoviee bin sabadhai thai na pai ||
67.e: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.

67.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
67.t: sabadhe haumai maareeaai maiaa kaa bhram jai ||
67.e: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya is dispelled.

67.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
67.t: naam padhaarath paieeaai gurmukh sahaj subhai ||7||
67.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||

67.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਜਾਪਨੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
67.t: bin gur gun na jaapanee bin gun bhagat na hoi ||
67.e: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is no devotional worship.

67.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
67.t: bhagat vachhal har man vasiaa sahaj miliaa prabh soi ||
67.e: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet that God with intuitive ease.

67.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੮॥੪॥੨੧॥
67.t: naanak sabadhe har saalaaheeaai karam paraapat hoi ||8||4||21||
67.e: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained. ||8||4||21||

67.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
67.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
67.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

67.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
67.t: maiaa moh merai prabh keenaa aape bharam bhulaae ||
67.e: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us through illusion and doubt.

67.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
67.t: manmukh karam kareh nahee boojheh birathaa janam gavaae ||
67.e: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.

67.g: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥੧॥
67.t: gurbaanee is jag meh chaanan karam vasai man aae ||1||
67.e: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||

67.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
67.t: man re naam japahu sukh hoi ||
67.e: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.

67.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
67.t: gur pooraa saalaaheeaai sahaj milai prabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
67.e: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||

67.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
67.t: bharam giaa bhau bhaagiaa har charanee chit lai ||
67.e: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

67.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
67.t: gurmukh sabadh kamaieeaai har vasai man aai ||
67.e: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.

67.g: ਘਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
67.t: ghar mahal sach samaieeaai jamakaal na sakai khai ||2||
67.e: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger of Death cannot devour us. ||2||

67.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਛੀਬਾ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਜੋੁਲਾਹਾ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
67.t: naamaa chheebaa kabeer juolaahaa poore gur te gat paiee ||
67.e: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through the Perfect Guru.

67.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਬੇਤੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
67.t: braham ke bete sabadh pachhaaneh haumai jaat gavaiee ||
67.e: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.

67.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਭਾਈ ॥੩॥
67.t: sur nar tin kee baanee gaaveh koi na meTai bhaiee ||3||
67.e: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings of Destiny! ||3||

67.g: ਦੈਤ ਪੁਤੁ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
67.t: dhait put karam dharam kichh sa(n)jam na paRai dhoojaa bhaau na jaanai ||
67.e: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.

67.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
67.t: satigur bheTiaai niramal hoaa anadhin naam vakhaanai ||
67.e: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

67.g: ਏਕੋ ਪੜੈ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ॥੪॥
67.t: eko paRai eko naau boojhai dhoojaa avar na jaanai ||4||
67.e: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other at all. ||4||

67.g: ਖਟੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਜੋਗੀ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
67.t: khaT dharasan jogee sa(n)niaasee bin gur bharam bhulaae ||
67.e: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and the Sanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.

67.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
67.t: satigur seveh taa gat mit paaveh har jeeau ma(n)n vasaae ||
67.e: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the Dear Lord within their minds.

67.g: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥੫॥
67.t: sachee baanee siau chit laagai aavan jaan rahaae ||5||
67.e: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings in reincarnation are over. ||5||

67.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
67.t: pa(n)ddit paR paR vaadh vakhaaneh bin gur bharam bhulaae ||
67.e: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.

67.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
67.t: lakh chauraaseeh fer piaa bin sabadhai mukat na paae ||
67.e: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, they do not attain liberation.

67.g: ਜਾ ਨਾਉ ਚੇਤੈ ਤਾ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੬॥
67.t: jaa naau chetai taa gat paae jaa satigur mel milaae ||6||
67.e: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when the True Guru unites them in Union. ||6||

67.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
67.t: satasa(n)gat meh naam har upajai jaa satigur milai subhaae ||
67.e: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love.

68.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ਚਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਏ ॥
68.t: man tan arapee aap gavaiee chalaa satigur bhaae ||
68.e: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

68.g: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
68.t: sadh balihaaree gur apune viTahu j har setee chit laae ||7||
68.e: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||

68.g: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜੋ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
68.t: so braahaman braham jo bi(n)dhe har setee ra(n)g raataa ||
68.e: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.

68.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
68.t: prabh nikaT vasai sabhanaa ghaT a(n)tar gurmukh viralai jaataa ||
68.e: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.

68.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੮॥੫॥੨੨॥
68.t: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||8||5||22||
68.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||

68.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
68.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
68.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

68.g: ਸਹਜੈ ਨੋ ਸਭ ਲੋਚਦੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
68.t: sahajai no sabh lochadhee bin gur paiaa na jai ||
68.e: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.

68.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
68.t: paR paR pa(n)ddit jotakee thake bhekhee bharam bhulai ||
68.e: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.

68.g: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
68.t: gur bheTe sahaj paiaa aapanee kirapaa kare rajai ||1||
68.e: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||

68.g: ਭਾਈ ਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
68.t: bhaiee re gur bin sahaj na hoi ||
68.e: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.

68.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
68.t: sabadhai hee te sahaj uoopajai har paiaa sach soi ||1|| rahaau ||
68.e: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
68.t: sahaje gaaviaa thai pavai bin sahajai kathanee baadh ||
68.e: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ॥
68.t: sahaje hee bhagat uoopajai sahaj piaar bairaag ||
68.e: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.

68.g: ਸਹਜੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
68.t: sahajai hee te sukh saat hoi bin sahajai jeevan baadh ||2||
68.e: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||

68.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
68.t: sahaj saalaahee sadhaa sadhaa sahaj samaadh lagai ||
68.e: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਊਚਰੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
68.t: sahaje hee gun uoocharai bhagat kare liv lai ||
68.e: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.

68.g: ਸਬਦੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
68.t: sabadhe hee har man vasai rasanaa har ras khai ||3||
68.e: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਡਾਰਿਆ ਸਚ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
68.t: sahaje kaal viddaariaa sach saranaiee pai ||
68.e: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
68.t: sahaje har naam man vasiaa sachee kaar kamai ||
68.e: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.

68.g: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥
68.t: se vaddabhaagee jinee paiaa sahaje rahe samai ||4||
68.e: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||

68.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
68.t: maiaa vich sahaj na uoopajai maiaa dhoojai bhai ||
68.e: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.

68.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲੈ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
68.t: manmukh karam kamaavane haumai jalai jalai ||
68.e: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.

68.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
68.t: ja(n)man maran na chookiee fir fir aavai jai ||5||
68.e: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||

68.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
68.t: tirahu gunaa vich sahaj na paieeaai trai gun bharam bhulai ||
68.e: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.

68.g: ਪੜੀਐ ਗੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਾ ਮੁੰਢਹੁ ਘੁਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
68.t: paReeaai guneeaai kiaa katheeaai jaa mu(n)ddahu ghuthaa jai ||
68.e: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?

68.g: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
68.t: chauthe padh meh sahaj hai gurmukh palai pai ||6||
68.e: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||

68.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
68.t: niragun naam nidhaan hai sahaje sojhee hoi ||
68.e: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.

68.g: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
68.t: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sache sachee soi ||
68.e: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.

68.g: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਸੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੭॥
68.t: bhuliaa sahaj milaisee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||7||
68.e: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||

68.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
68.t: bin sahajai sabh a(n)dh hai maiaa moh gubaar ||
68.e: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
68.t: sahaje hee sojhee piee sachai sabadh apaar ||
68.e: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.

68.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੮॥
68.t: aape bakhas milaian poore gur karataar ||8||
68.e: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||

68.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
68.t: sahaje adhisaT pachhaaneeaai nirabhau jot nira(n)kaar ||
68.e: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.

68.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
68.t: sabhanaa jeeaa kaa ik dhaataa jotee jot milaavanahaar ||
68.e: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.

68.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥੯॥
68.t: poorai sabadh salaaheeaai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||9||
68.e: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||

68.g: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
68.t: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sahaj kareh vaapaar ||
68.e: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.

68.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਨਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
68.t: anadhin laahaa har naam lain akhuT bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
68.e: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.

68.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੀਏ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੬॥੨੩॥
68.t: naanak toT na aaviee dhe'ee dhevanahaar ||10||6||23||
68.e: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||

69.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
69.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
69.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

69.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
69.t: satigur miliaai fer na pavai janam maran dhukh jai ||
69.e: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.

69.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
69.t: poorai sabadh sabh sojhee hoiee har naamai rahai samai ||1||
69.e: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||

69.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
69.t: man mere satigur siau chit lai ||
69.e: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.

69.g: ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
69.t: niramal naam sadh navatano aap vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
69.e: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||

69.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
69.t: har jeeau raakhahu apunee saranaiee jiau raakheh tiau rahanaa ||
69.e: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.

69.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
69.t: gur kai sabadh jeevat marai gurmukh bhavajal taranaa ||2||
69.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

69.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
69.t: vaddai bhaag naau paieeaai gurmat sabadh suhaiee ||
69.e: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.

69.g: ਆਪੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
69.t: aape man vasiaa prabh karataa sahaje rahiaa samaiee ||3||
69.e: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||

69.g: ਇਕਨਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
69.t: eikanaa manmukh sabadh na bhaavai ba(n)dhan ba(n)dh bhavaiaa ||
69.e: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.

69.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
69.t: lakh chauraaseeh fir fir aavai birathaa janam gavaiaa ||4||
69.e: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||

69.g: ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
69.t: bhagataa man aana(n)dh hai sachai sabadh ra(n)g raate ||
69.e: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.

69.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਤੇ ॥੫॥
69.t: anadhin gun gaaveh sadh niramal sahaje naam samaate ||5||
69.e: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||

69.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੀ ॥
69.t: gurmukh a(n)mirat baanee boleh sabh aatam raam pachhaanee ||
69.e: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.

69.g: ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਏਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
69.t: eko sevan ek araadheh gurmukh akath kahaanee ||6||
69.e: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||

69.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
69.t: sachaa saahib seveeaai gurmukh vasai man aai ||
69.e: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.

69.g: ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਿਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੭॥
69.t: sadhaa ra(n)g raate sach siau apunee kirapaa kare milai ||7||
69.e: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||

69.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਕਨਾ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਦੇਇ ਜਗਾਇ ॥
69.t: aape kare karaae aape ikanaa sutiaa dhei jagai ||
69.e: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.

69.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੭॥੨੪॥
69.t: aape mel milaidhaa naanak sabadh samai ||8||7||24||
69.e: He Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad. ||8||7||24||

69.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
69.t: sireeraag mahalaa teejaa ||
69.e: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:

69.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
69.t: satigur seviaai man niramalaa bhe pavit sareer ||
69.e: Serving the True Guru, the mind becomes immaculate, and the body becomes pure.

69.g: ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
69.t: man aana(n)dh sadhaa sukh paiaa bheTiaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
69.e: The mind obtains bliss and eternal peace, meeting with the Deep and Profound Lord.

69.g: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰ ॥੧॥
69.t: sachee sa(n)gat baisanaa sach naam man dheer ||1||
69.e: Sitting in the Sangat, the True Congregation, the mind is comforted and consoled by the True Name. ||1||

69.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਸੰਗੁ ॥
69.t: man re satigur sev nisa(n)g ||
69.e: O mind, serve the True Guru without hesitation.

69.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
69.t: satigur seviaai har man vasai lagai na mail pata(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
69.e: Serving the True Guru, the Lord abides within the mind, and no trace of filth shall attach itself to you. ||1||Pause||

69.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
69.t: sachai sabadh pat uoopajai sache sachaa naau ||
69.e: From the True Word of the Shabad comes honor. True is the Name of the True One.

69.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
69.t: jinee haumai maar pachhaaniaa hau tin balihaarai jaau ||
69.e: I am a sacrifice to those who conquer their ego and recognize the Lord.

69.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤਿਨ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
69.t: manmukh sach na jaananee tin Thaur na katahoo thaau ||2||
69.e: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the True One; they find no shelter, and no place of rest anywhere. ||2||

69.g: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
69.t: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sache hee vich vaas ||
69.e: Those who take the Truth as their food and the Truth as their clothing, have their home in the True One.

69.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
69.t: sadhaa sachaa saalaahanaa sachai sabadh nivaas ||
69.e: They constantly praise the True One, and in the True Word of the Shabad they have their dwelling.

69.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
69.t: sabh aatam raam pachhaaniaa gurmatee nij ghar vaas ||3||
69.e: They recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all, and through the Guru's Teachings they dwell in the home of their own inner self. ||3||

69.g: ਸਚੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
69.t: sach vekhan sach bolanaa tan man sachaa hoi ||
69.e: They see the Truth, and they speak the Truth; their bodies and minds are True.

69.g: ਸਚੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
69.t: sachee saakhee upadhes sach sache sachee soi ||
69.e: True are their teachings, and True are their instructions; True are the reputations of the true ones.

69.g: ਜਿੰਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਚਲੇ ਰੋਇ ॥੪॥
69.t: ji(n)nee sach visaariaa se dhukhe'ee chale roi ||4||
69.e: Those who have forgotten the True One are miserable-they depart weeping and wailing. ||4||

69.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸੇ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
69.t: satigur jinee na sevio se kit aae sa(n)saar ||
69.e: Those who have not served the True Guru-why did they even bother to come into the world?

69.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਪੂਕਾਰ ॥
69.t: jam dhar badhe maare'eh kook na sunai pookaar ||
69.e: They are bound and gagged and beaten at Death's door, but no one hears their shrieks and cries.

69.g: ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
69.t: birathaa janam gavaiaa mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||5||
69.e: They waste their lives uselessly; they die and are reincarnated over and over again. ||5||

70.g: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
70.t: eh jag jalataa dhekh kai bhaj pe satigur saranaa ||
70.e: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

70.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
70.t: satigur sach dhiRaiaa sadhaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
70.e: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

70.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
70.t: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabadhe bhavajal taranaa ||6||
70.e: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

70.g: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
70.t: lakh chauraaseeh firadhe rahe bin satigur mukat na hoiee ||
70.e: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

70.g: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
70.t: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake dhoojai bhai pat khoiee ||
70.e: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

70.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
70.t: satigur sabadh sunaiaa bin sache avar na koiee ||7||
70.e: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

70.g: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
70.t: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
70.e: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

70.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
70.t: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
70.e: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

70.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
70.t: naanak bhagat sukhe'ee sadhaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
70.e: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

70.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
70.t: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
70.e: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

70.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਣੈ ਢੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
70.t: jaa kau musakal at banai ddoiee koi na dhei ||
70.e: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,

70.g: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਸਮਨਾ ਸਾਕ ਭਿ ਭਜਿ ਖਲੇ ॥
70.t: laagoo hoe dhusamanaa saak bh bhaj khale ||
70.e: when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

70.g: ਸਭੋ ਭਜੈ ਆਸਰਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
70.t: sabho bhajai aasaraa chukai sabh asaraau ||
70.e: and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

70.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ॥੧॥
70.t: chit aavai os paarabraham lagai na tatee vaau ||1||
70.e: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

70.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
70.t: saahib nitaaniaa kaa taan ||
70.e: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.

70.g: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
70.t: aai na jaiee thir sadhaa gur sabadhee sach jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
70.e: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||

70.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਬਲਾ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
70.t: je ko hovai dhubalaa na(n)g bhukh kee peer ||
70.e: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,

70.g: ਦਮੜਾ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
70.t: dhamaRaa palai naa pavai naa ko dhevai dheer ||
70.e: with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,

70.g: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
70.t: suaarath suaau na ko kare naa kichh hovai kaaj ||
70.e: and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works is accomplished

70.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
70.t: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nihachal hovai raaj ||2||
70.e: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

70.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
70.t: jaa kau chi(n)taa bahut bahut dhehee viaapai rog ||
70.e: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;

70.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
70.t: girasat kuTa(n)b paleTiaa kadhe harakh kadhe sog ||
70.e: when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimes feeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

70.g: ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
70.t: gaun kare chahu ku(n)T kaa ghaRee na baisan soi ||
70.e: when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleep even for a moment

70.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
70.t: chit aavai os paarabraham tan man seetal hoi ||3||
70.e: -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||3||

70.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਲੋਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
70.t: kaam karodh moh vas keeaa kirapan lobh piaar ||
70.e: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or a greedy miser in love with your wealth;

70.g: ਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਨਿ ਅਘ ਕੀਏ ਹੋਆ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥
70.t: chaare kilavikh un agh ke'ee hoaa asur sa(n)ghaar ||
70.e: if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are a murderous fiend

70.g: ਪੋਥੀ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
70.t: pothee geet kavit kichh kadhe na karan dhariaa ||
70.e: who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

70.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
70.t: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nimakh simarat tariaa ||4||
70.e: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

70.g: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਖਾਗਰ ਬਿਚਰੇ ॥
70.t: saasat si(n)mirat bedh chaar mukhaagar bichare ||
70.e: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;

70.g: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
70.t: tape tapeesar jogeeaa teerath gavan kare ||
70.e: they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage

70.g: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
70.t: khaT karamaa te dhugune poojaa karataa nai ||
70.e: and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worship services and ritual bathings.

70.g: ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਰਕੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
70.t: ra(n)g na lagee paarabraham taa sarapar narake jai ||5||
70.e: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shall surely go to hell. ||5||

70.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
70.t: raaj milak sikadhaareeaa ras bhogan bisathaar ||
70.e: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment of myriads of pleasures;

70.g: ਬਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
70.t: baag suhaave sohane chalai hukam afaar ||
70.e: you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

70.g: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਚਾਇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
70.t: ra(n)g tamaase bahu bidhee chai lag rahiaa ||
70.e: you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue to enjoy exciting pleasures

70.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
70.t: chit na aaio paarabraham taa sarap kee joon giaa ||6||
70.e: -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

70.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਧਨਾਢਿ ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
70.t: bahut dhanaadd achaarava(n)t sobhaa niramal reet ||
70.e: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputation and observe religious customs;

70.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈਆ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
70.t: maat pitaa sut bhaieeaa saajan sa(n)g pareet ||
70.e: you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

70.g: ਲਸਕਰ ਤਰਕਸਬੰਦ ਬੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਕੀਤ ॥
70.t: lasakar tarakasaba(n)dh ba(n)dh jeeau jeeau sagalee keet ||
70.e: you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect;

71.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਖੜਿ ਰਸਾਤਲਿ ਦੀਤ ॥੭॥
71.t: chit na aaio paarabraham taa khaR rasaatal dheet ||7||
71.e: But still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then you shall be taken and consigned to the most hideous hell! ||7||

71.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਾੜਾ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
71.t: kaiaa rog na chhidhr kichh naa kichh kaaRaa sog ||
71.e: You may have a body free of disease and deformity, and have no worries or grief at all;

71.g: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਗੈ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
71.t: mrit na aavee chit tis ahinis bhogai bhog ||
71.e: you may be unmindful of death, and night and day revel in pleasures;

71.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਤੋਨੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜੀਇ ਨ ਸੰਕ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
71.t: sabh kichh keeton aapanaa jeei na sa(n)k dhariaa ||
71.e: you may take everything as your own, and have no fear in your mind at all;

71.g: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਮਕੰਕਰ ਵਸਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੮॥
71.t: chit na aaio paarabraham jamaka(n)kar vas pariaa ||8||
71.e: but still, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||8||

71.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
71.t: kirapaa kare jis paarabraham hovai saadhoo sa(n)g ||
71.e: The Supreme Lord showers His Mercy, and we find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

71.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਓਹੁ ਵਧਾਈਐ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
71.t: jiau jiau oh vadhaieeaai tiau tiau har siau ra(n)g ||
71.e: The more time we spend there, the more we come to love the Lord.

71.g: ਦੁਹਾ ਸਿਰਿਆ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
71.t: dhuhaa siriaa kaa khasam aap avar na dhoojaa thaau ||
71.e: The Lord is the Master of both worlds; there is no other place of rest.

71.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੯॥੧॥੨੬॥
71.t: satigur tuThai paiaa naanak sachaa naau ||9||1||26||
71.e: When the True Guru is pleased and satisfied, O Nanak, the True Name is obtained. ||9||1||26||
Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House:
I do not know what pleases my Lord.
O mind, seek out the way! ||1||Pause||
The meditatives practice meditation,
and the wise practice spiritual wisdom,
but how rare are those who know God! ||1||
The worshipper of Bhagaauti practices self-discipline,
the Yogi speaks of liberation,
and the ascetic is absorbed in asceticism. ||2||
The men of silence observe silence,
the Sanyaasees observe celibacy,
and the Udaasees abide in detachment. ||3||
There are nine forms of devotional worship.
The Pandits recite the Vedas.
The householders assert their faith in family life. ||4||
Those who utter only One Word, those who take many forms, the naked renunciates,
the wearers of patched coats, the magicians, those who remain always awake,
and those who bathe at holy places of pilgrimage-||5||
Those who go without food, those who never touch others,
the hermits who never show themselves,
and those who are wise in their own minds-||6||
Of these, no one admits to any deficiency;
all say that they have found the Lord.
But he alone is a devotee, whom the Lord has united with Himself. ||7||

71.g: ਸਗਲ ਉਕਤਿ ਉਪਾਵਾ ॥ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
71.t: sagal ukat upaavaa || tiaagee saran paavaa ||
71.e: Abandoning all devices and contrivances, I have sought His Sanctuary.
Nanak has fallen at the Feet of the Guru. ||8||2||27||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Siree Raag, First Mehla, Third House:
Among Yogis, You are the Yogi;
among pleasure seekers, You are the Pleasure Seeker.

71.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਮਛਿ ਪਇਆਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
71.t: teraa a(n)t na paiaa surag machh piaal jeeau ||1||
71.e: Your limits are not known to any of the beings in the heavens, in this world, or in the nether regions of the underworld. ||1||

71.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
71.t: hau vaaree hau vaaranai kurabaan tere naav no ||1|| rahaau ||
71.e: I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to Your Name. ||1||Pause||
You created the world,
and assigned tasks to one and all.

71.g: ਵੇਖਹਿ ਕੀਤਾ ਆਪਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
71.t: vekheh keetaa aapanaa kar kudharat paasaa ddaal jeeau ||2||
71.e: You watch over Your Creation, and through Your All-powerful Creative Potency, You cast the dice. ||2||
You are manifest in the Expanse of Your Workshop.
Everyone longs for Your Name,

71.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਮੋਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
71.t: satigur baajh na paio sabh mohee maiaa jaal jeeau ||3||
71.e: but without the Guru, no one finds You. All are enticed and trapped by Maya. ||3||
I am a sacrifice to the True Guru.
Meeting Him, the supreme status is obtained.

72.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਲੋਚਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
72.t: sur nar mun jan lochadhe so satigur dheeaa bujhai jeeau ||4||
72.e: The angelic beings and the silent sages long for Him; the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||4||
How is the Society of the Saints to be known?
There, the Name of the One Lord is chanted.

72.g: ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
72.t: eko naam hukam hai naanak satigur dheeaa bujhai jeeau ||5||
72.e: The One Name is the Lord's Command; O Nanak, the True Guru has given me this understanding. ||5||
This world has been deluded by doubt.
You Yourself, Lord, have led it astray.

72.g: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਲਗਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਗ ਜਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
72.t: parataap lagaa dhohaaganee bhaag jinaa ke naeh jeeau ||6||
72.e: The discarded soul-brides suffer in terrible agony; they have no luck at all. ||6||
What are the signs of the discarded brides?
They miss their Husband Lord, and they wander around in dishonor.

72.g: ਮੈਲੇ ਵੇਸ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਦੁਖੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
72.t: maile ves tinaa kaamanee dhukhee rain vihai jeeau ||7||
72.e: The clothes of those brides are filthy-they pass their life-night in agony. ||7||
What actions have the happy soul-brides performed?
They have obtained the fruit of their pre-ordained destiny.

72.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
72.t: nadhar kare kai aapanee aape le milai jeeau ||8||
72.e: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord unites them with Himself. ||8||
Those, whom God causes to abide by His Will,
have the Shabad of His Word abiding deep within.

72.g: ਸਹੀਆ ਸੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
72.t: saheeaa se sohaaganee jin seh naal piaar jeeau ||9||
72.e: They are the true soul-brides, who embrace love for their Husband Lord. ||9||
Those who take pleasure in God's Will
remove doubt from within.

72.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੋ ਸਭਸੈ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
72.t: naanak satigur aaisaa jaaneeaai jo sabhasai le milai jeeau ||10||
72.e: O Nanak, know Him as the True Guru, who unites all with the Lord. ||10||
Meeting with the True Guru, they receive the fruits of their destiny,
and egotism is driven out from within.

72.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਭਾਗੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਆਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
72.t: dhuramat kaa dhukh kaTiaa bhaag baiThaa masatak aai jeeau ||11||
72.e: The pain of evil-mindedness is eliminated; good fortune comes and shines radiantly from their foreheads. ||11||
The Bani of Your Word is Ambrosial Nectar.
It permeates the hearts of Your devotees.

72.g: ਸੁਖ ਸੇਵਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਖਿਐ ਆਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
72.t: sukh sevaa a(n)dhar rakhiaai aapanee nadhar kareh nisataar jeeau ||12||
72.e: Serving You, peace is obtained; granting Your Mercy, You bestow salvation. ||12||
Meeting with the True Guru, one comes to know;
by this meeting, one comes to chant the Name.

72.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਭ ਥਕੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
72.t: satigur baajh na paio sabh thakee karam kamai jeeau ||13||
72.e: Without the True Guru, God is not found; all have grown weary of performing religious rituals. ||13||
I am a sacrifice to the True Guru;
I was wandering in doubt, and He has set me on the right path.

72.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਰਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
72.t: nadhar kare je aapanee aape le ralai jeeau ||14||
72.e: If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, He unites us with Himself. ||14||
You, Lord, are pervading in all,
and yet, the Creator keeps Himself concealed.

72.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
72.t: naanak gurmukh paragaT hoiaa jaa kau jot dharee karataar jeeau ||15||
72.e: O Nanak, the Creator is revealed to the Gurmukh, within whom He has infused His Light. ||15||
The Master Himself bestows honor.
He creates and bestows body and soul.

72.g: ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀਆ ਦੁਇ ਕਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
72.t: aapane sevak kee paij rakheeaa dhui kar masatak dhaar jeeau ||16||
72.e: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; He places both His Hands upon their foreheads. ||16||
All strict rituals are just clever contrivances.
My God knows everything.

72.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਰੈ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
72.t: pragaT prataap varataio sabh lok karai jaikaar jeeau ||17||
72.e: He has made His Glory manifest, and all people celebrate Him. ||17 |
He has not considered my merits and demerits;
this is God's Own Nature.

72.g: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਕੈ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
72.t: ka(n)Th lai kai rakhion lagai na tatee vaau jeeau ||18||
72.e: Hugging me close in His Embrace, He protects me, and now, even the hot wind does not touch me. ||18||
Within my mind and body, I meditate on God.
I have obtained the fruits of my soul's desire.

72.g: ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਤੂੰ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਨਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
72.t: saeh paatisaeh sir khasam too(n) jap naanak jeevai naau jeeau ||19||
72.e: You are the Supreme Lord and Master, above the heads of kings. Nanak lives by chanting Your Name. ||19||

73.e: You Yourself created the Universe;
You created the play of duality, and staged it.

73.g: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
73.t: sabh sacho sach varatadhaa jis bhaavai tisai bujhai jeeau ||20||
73.e: The Truest of the True is pervading everywhere; He instructs those with whom He is pleased. ||20||
By Guru's Grace, I have found God.
By His Grace, I have shed emotional attachment to Maya.

73.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥
73.t: kirapaa kar kai aapanee aape le samai jeeau ||21||
73.e: Showering His Mercy, He has blended me into Himself. ||21||
You are the Gopis, the milk-maids of Krishna; You are the sacred river Jamunaa; You are Krishna, the herdsman.
You Yourself support the world.

73.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੨॥
73.t: hukamee bhaa(n)dde saajiaa too(n) aape bha(n)n savaar jeeau ||22||
73.e: By Your Command, human beings are fashioned. You Yourself embellish them, and then again destroy them. ||22||
Those who have focused their consciousness on the True Guru
have rid themselves of the love of duality.

73.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਆ ਓਇ ਚਲੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੩॥
73.t: niramal jot tin praaneeaa oi chale janam savaar jeeau ||23||
73.e: The light of those mortal beings is immaculate. They depart after redeeming their lives. ||23||

73.g: ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ॥ ਮੈ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੈ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ॥
73.t: tereeaa sadhaa sadhaa cha(n)giaaieeaa || mai raat dhihai vaddiaaieeaa(n) ||
73.e: Forever and ever, night and day, I praise the Greatness of Your Goodness.

73.g: ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੪॥੧॥
73.t: anama(n)giaa dhaan dhevanaa kahu naanak sach samaal jeeau ||24||1||
73.e: You bestow Your Gifts, even if we do not ask for them. Says Nanak, contemplate the True Lord. ||24||1||
Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:
I fall at His Feet to please and appease Him.

73.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
73.t: satigur purakh milaiaa tis jevadd avar na koi jeeau ||1|| rahaau ||
73.e: The True Guru has united me with the Lord, the Primal Being. There is no other as great as He. ||1||Pause||
The Lord of the Universe is my Sweet Beloved.
He is sweeter than my mother or father.

73.g: ਭੈਣ ਭਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਹਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
73.t: bhain bhaiee sabh sajanaa tudh jehaa naahee koi jeeau ||1||
73.e: Among all sisters and brothers and friends, there is no one like You. ||1||
By Your Command, the month of Saawan has come.
I have hooked up the plow of Truth,

73.g: ਨਾਉ ਬੀਜਣ ਲਗਾ ਆਸ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਹਲ ਬਖਸ ਜਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
73.t: naau beejan lagaa aas kar har bohal bakhas jamai jeeau ||2||
73.e: and I plant the seed of the Name in hopes that the Lord, in His Generosity, will bestow a bountiful harvest. ||2||
Meeting with the Guru, I recognize only the One Lord.
In my consciousness, I do not know of any other account.

73.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਤੈ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਓਨੁ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਂਵੈ ਨਿਬਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
73.t: har ikatai kaarai laion jiau bhaavai ti(n)vai nibaeh jeeau ||3||
73.e: The Lord has assigned one task to me; as it pleases Him, I perform it. ||3||
Enjoy yourselves and eat, O Siblings of Destiny.
In the Guru's Court, He has blessed me with the Robe of Honor.

73.g: ਹਉ ਹੋਆ ਮਾਹਰੁ ਪਿੰਡ ਦਾ ਬੰਨਿ ਆਦੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਸਰੀਕ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
73.t: hau hoaa maahar pi(n)dd dhaa ba(n)n aadhe pa(n)j sareek jeeau ||4||
73.e: I have become the Master of my body-village; I have taken the five rivals as prisoners. ||4||
I have come to Your Sanctuary.
The five farm-hands have become my tenants;

73.g: ਕੰਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਢਿ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੁਠਾ ਘੁਘਿ ਗਿਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
73.t: ka(n)n koiee kadd na ha(n)ghiee naanak vuThaa ghugh giraau jeeau ||5||
73.e: none dare to raise their heads against me. O Nanak, my village is populous and prosperous. ||5||
I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You.
I meditate on You continually.

73.g: ਉਜੜੁ ਥੇਹੁ ਵਸਾਇਓ ਹਉ ਤੁਧ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
73.t: aujaR theh vasaio hau tudh viTahu kurabaan jeeau ||6||
73.e: The village was in ruins, but You have re-populated it. I am a sacrifice to You. ||6||
O Beloved Lord, I meditate on You continually;
I obtain the fruits of my mind's desires.

73.g: ਸਭੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਨੁ ਲਾਹੀਅਨੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
73.t: sabhe kaaj savaarian laaheean man kee bhukh jeeau ||7||
73.e: All my affairs are arranged, and the hunger of my mind is appeased. ||7||
I have forsaken all my entanglements;
I serve the True Lord of the Universe.

73.g: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਪਲੈ ਬਧਾ ਛਿਕਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
73.t: nau nidh naam nidhaan har mai palai badhaa chhik jeeau ||8||
73.e: I have firmly attached the Name, the Home of the Nine Treasures to my robe. ||8||
I have obtained the comfort of comforts.
The Guru has implanted the Word of the Shabad deep within me.

73.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਵਿਖਾਲਿਆ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਰਿ ਕੈ ਹਥੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥
73.t: satigur purakh vikhaaliaa masatak dhar kai hath jeeau ||9||
73.e: The True Guru has shown me my Husband Lord; He has placed His Hand upon my forehead. ||9||

73.g: ਮੈ ਬਧੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲ ਹੈ ॥
73.t: mai badhee sach dharam saal hai ||
73.e: I have established the Temple of Truth.
I sought out the Guru's Sikhs, and brought them into it.

73.g: ਪੈਰ ਧੋਵਾ ਪਖਾ ਫੇਰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਗਾ ਪਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੦॥
73.t: pair dhovaa pakhaa feradhaa tis niv niv lagaa pai jeeau ||10||
73.e: I wash their feet, and wave the fan over them. Bowing low, I fall at their feet. ||10||

74.e: I heard of the Guru, and so I went to Him.
He instilled within me the Naam, the goodness of charity and true cleansing.

74.g: ਸਭੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਸਾਰੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੀ ਬੇੜੀ ਚਾੜਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੧॥
74.t: sabh mukat hoaa saisaaraRaa naanak sachee beRee chaaR jeeau ||11||
74.e: All the world is liberated, O Nanak, by embarking upon the Boat of Truth. ||11||

74.g: ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
74.t: sabh sirasaT seve dhin raat jeeau ||
74.e: The whole Universe serves You, day and night.
Please hear my prayer, O Dear Lord.

74.g: ਠੋਕਿ ਵਜਾਇ ਸਭ ਡਿਠੀਆ ਤੁਸਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਛਡਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੨॥
74.t: Thok vajai sabh ddiTheeaa tus aape lian chhaddai jeeau ||12||
74.e: I have thoroughly tested and seen all-You alone, by Your Pleasure, can save us. ||12||
Now, the Merciful Lord has issued His Command.
Let no one chase after and attack anyone else.

74.g: ਸਭ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ਵੁਠੀਆ ਇਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਲੇਮੀ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੩॥
74.t: sabh sukhaalee vuTheeaa ih hoaa halemee raaj jeeau ||13||
74.e: Let all abide in peace, under this Benevolent Rule. ||13||
Softly and gently, drop by drop, the Ambrosial Nectar trickles down.
I speak as my Lord and Master causes me to speak.

74.g: ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਥਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੪॥
74.t: bahu maan keeaa tudh upare too(n) aape paieh thai jeeau ||14||
74.e: I place all my faith in You; please accept me. ||14||
Your devotees are forever hungry for You.
O Lord, please fulfill my desires.

74.g: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਿਆ ਮੈ ਗਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੫॥
74.t: dheh dharas sukhadhaatiaa mai gal vich laih milai jeeau ||15||
74.e: Grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Giver of Peace. Please, take me into Your Embrace. ||15||
I have not found any other as Great as You.
You pervade the continents, the worlds and the nether regions;

74.g: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੬॥
74.t: too(n) thaan thana(n)tar rav rahiaa naanak bhagataa sach adhaar jeeau ||16||
74.e: You are permeating all places and interspaces. Nanak: You are the True Support of Your devotees. ||16||
I am a wrestler; I belong to the Lord of the World.
I met with the Guru, and I have tied a tall, plumed turban.

74.g: ਸਭ ਹੋਈ ਛਿੰਝ ਇਕਠੀਆ ਦਯੁ ਬੈਠਾ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੭॥
74.t: sabh hoiee chhi(n)jh ikaTheeaa dhay baiThaa vekhai aap jeeau ||17||
74.e: All have gathered to watch the wrestling match, and the Merciful Lord Himself is seated to behold it. ||17||
The bugles play and the drums beat.
The wrestlers enter the arena and circle around.

74.g: ਨਿਹਤੇ ਪੰਜਿ ਜੁਆਨ ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਪੀ ਦਿਤੀ ਕੰਡਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੮॥
74.t: nihate pa(n)j juaan mai gur thaapee dhitee ka(n)dd jeeau ||18||
74.e: I have thrown the five challengers to the ground, and the Guru has patted me on the back. ||18||
All have gathered together,
but we shall return home by different routes.

74.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਗਏ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਚਲੇ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੧੯॥
74.t: gurmukh laahaa lai ge manmukh chale mool gavai jeeau ||19||
74.e: The Gurmukhs reap their profits and leave, while the self-willed manmukhs lose their investment and depart. ||19||
You are without color or mark.
The Lord is seen to be manifest and present.

74.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੦॥
74.t: sun sun tujhai dhiaaidhe tere bhagat rate gunataas jeeau ||20||
74.e: Hearing of Your Glories again and again, Your devotees meditate on You; they are attuned to You, O Lord, Treasure of Excellence. ||20||
Through age after age, I am the servant of the Merciful Lord.
The Guru has cut away my bonds.

74.g: ਹਉ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਛਿੰਝ ਨ ਨਚਊ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਲਧਾ ਭਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨੧॥੨॥੨੯॥
74.t: hau baahuR chhi(n)jh na nachuoo naanak aausar ladhaa bhaal jeeau ||21||2||29||
74.e: I shall not have to dance in the wrestling arena of life again. Nanak has searched, and found this opportunity. ||21||2||29||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

74.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa pahare ghar pehilaa ||
74.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla, Pehray, First House:

74.g: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥
74.t: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa hukam piaa garabhaas ||
74.e: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you were cast into the womb, by the Lord's Command.

74.g: ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
74.t: auradh tap a(n)tar kare vanajaariaa mitraa khasam setee aradhaas ||
74.e: Upside-down, within the womb, you performed penance, O my merchant friend, and you prayed to your Lord and Master.

74.g: ਖਸਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਉਰਧ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
74.t: khasam setee aradhaas vakhaanai uradh dhiaan liv laagaa ||
74.e: You uttered prayers to your Lord and Master, while upside-down, and you meditated on Him with deep love and affection.

74.g: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਨਾਗਾ ॥
74.t: naa marajaadh aaiaa kal bheetar baahuR jaasee naagaa ||
74.e: You came into this Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and you shall depart again naked.

74.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਲਮ ਵੁੜੀ ਹੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
74.t: jaisee kalam vuRee hai masatak taisee jeeaRe paas ||
74.e: As God's Pen has written on your forehead, so it shall be with your soul.

74.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਇਆ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
74.t: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai hukam piaa garabhaas ||1||
74.e: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command, you enter into the womb. ||1||

75.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
75.t: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa visar giaa dhiaan ||
75.e: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you have forgotten to meditate.

75.g: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਿਉ ਜਸੁਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਨੁ ॥
75.t: hatho hath nachaieeaai vanajaariaa mitraa jiau jasudhaa ghar kaan ||
75.e: From hand to hand, you are passed around, O my merchant friend, like Krishna in the house of Yashoda.

75.g: ਹਥੋ ਹਥਿ ਨਚਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਤ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
75.t: hatho hath nachaieeaai praanee maat kahai sut meraa ||
75.e: From hand to hand, you are passed around, and your mother says, ""This is my son.""

75.g: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
75.t: chet achet mooR man mere a(n)t nahee kachh teraa ||
75.e: O, my thoughtless and foolish mind, think: In the end, nothing shall be yours.

75.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਧਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
75.t: jin rach rachiaa tiseh na jaanai man bheetar dhar giaan ||
75.e: You do not know the One who created the creation. Gather spiritual wisdom within your mind.

75.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੨॥
75.t: kahu naanak praanee dhoojai paharai visar giaa dhiaan ||2||
75.e: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, you have forgotten to meditate. ||2||

75.g: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥
75.t: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhan joban siau chit ||
75.e: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your consciousness is focused on wealth and youth.

75.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥
75.t: har kaa naam na chetahee vanajaariaa mitraa badhaa chhuTeh jit ||
75.e: You have not remembered the Name of the Lord, O my merchant friend, although it would release you from bondage.

75.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਬਿਕਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
75.t: har kaa naam na chetai praanee bikal bhiaa sa(n)g maiaa ||
75.e: You do not remember the Name of the Lord, and you become confused by Maya.

75.g: ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਰਤਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮਤਾ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
75.t: dhan siau rataa joban mataa ahilaa janam gavaiaa ||
75.e: Revelling in your riches and intoxicated with youth, you waste your life uselessly.

75.g: ਧਰਮ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
75.t: dharam setee vaapaar na keeto karam na keeto mit ||
75.e: You have not traded in righteousness and Dharma; you have not made good deeds your friends.

75.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ॥੩॥
75.t: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee dhan joban siau chit ||3||
75.e: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, your mind is attached to wealth and youth. ||3||

75.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲਾਵੀ ਆਇਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥
75.t: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa laavee aaiaa khet ||
75.e: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Grim Reaper comes to the field.

75.g: ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
75.t: jaa jam pakaR chalaiaa vanajaariaa mitraa kisai na miliaa bhet ||
75.e: When the Messenger of Death seizes and dispatches you, O my merchant friend, no one knows the mystery of where you have gone.

75.g: ਭੇਤੁ ਚੇਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
75.t: bhet chet har kisai na milio jaa jam pakaR chalaiaa ||
75.e: So think of the Lord! No one knows this secret, of when the Messenger of Death will seize you and take you away.

75.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਰੁਦਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਦੋੁਆਲੈ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
75.t: jhooThaa rudhan hoaa dhuoaalai khin meh bhiaa paraiaa ||
75.e: All your weeping and wailing then is false. In an instant, you become a stranger.

75.g: ਸਾਈ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੇਤੁ ॥
75.t: saiee vasat paraapat hoiee jis siau laiaa het ||
75.e: You obtain exactly what you have longed for.

75.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਲਾਵੀ ਲੁਣਿਆ ਖੇਤੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
75.t: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai laavee luniaa khet ||4||1||
75.e: Says Nanak, in the fourth watch of the night, O mortal, the Grim Reaper has harvested your field. ||4||1||

75.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
75.t: sireeraag mahalaa pehilaa ||
75.e: Siree Raag, First Mehla:

75.g: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਾਲਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਚੇਤੁ ॥
75.t: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa baalak budh achet ||
75.e: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your innocent mind has a child-like understanding.

75.g: ਖੀਰੁ ਪੀਐ ਖੇਲਾਈਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਹੇਤੁ ॥ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਨੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
75.t: kheer peeaai khelaieeaai vanajaariaa mitraa maat pitaa sut het || maat pitaa sut neh ghaneraa maiaa moh sabaiee ||
75.e: You drink milk, and you are fondled so gently, O my merchant friend. The mother and father love their child so much, but in Maya, all are caught in emotional attachment.

75.g: ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਆਇਆ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
75.t: sa(n)jogee aaiaa kirat kamaiaa karanee kaar karaiee ||
75.e: By the good fortune of good deeds done in the past, you have come, and now you perform actions to determine your future.

75.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਬੂਡੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ॥
75.t: raam naam bin mukat na hoiee booddee dhoojai het ||
75.e: Without the Lord's Name, liberation is not obtained, and you are drowned in the love of duality.

75.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਛੂਟਹਿਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ॥੧॥
75.t: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai chhooTahigaa har chet ||1||
75.e: Says Nanak, in the first watch of the night, O mortal, you shall be saved by remembering the Lord. ||1||

75.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਮੈ ਮਤਿ ॥
75.t: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar joban mai mat ||
75.e: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, you are intoxicated with the wine of youth and beauty.

75.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਾਮਿ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
75.t: ahinis kaam viaapiaa vanajaariaa mitraa a(n)dhule naam na chit ||
75.e: Day and night, you are engrossed in sexual desire, O my merchant friend, and your consciousness is blind to the Naam.

75.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
75.t: raam naam ghaT a(n)tar naahee hor jaanai ras kas meeThe ||
75.e: The Lord's Name is not within your heart, but all sorts of other tastes seem sweet to you.

75.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹੁਗੇ ਝੂਠੇ ॥
75.t: giaan dhiaan gun sa(n)jam naahee janam marahuge jhooThe ||
75.e: You have no wisdom at all, no meditation, no virtue or self-discipline; in falsehood, you are caught in the cycle of birth and death.

75.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਵਰਤ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
75.t: teerath varat such sa(n)jam naahee karam dharam nahee poojaa ||
75.e: Pilgrimages, fasts, purification and self-discipline are of no use, nor are rituals, religious ceremonies or empty worship.

75.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥
75.t: naanak bhai bhagat nisataaraa dhubidhaa viaapai dhoojaa ||2||
75.e: O Nanak, emancipation comes only by loving devotional worship; through duality, people are engrossed in duality. ||2||

75.g: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਰਿ ਹੰਸ ਉਲਥੜੇ ਆਇ ॥
75.t: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa sar ha(n)s ulathaRe aai ||
75.e: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the swans, the white hairs, come and land upon the pool of the head.

75.g: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਘਟੈ ਜਰੂਆ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
75.t: joban ghaTai jarooaa jinai vanajaariaa mitraa aav ghaTai dhin jai ||
75.e: Youth wears itself out, and old age triumphs, O my merchant friend; as time passes, your days diminish.

76.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਸੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਾ ਜਮਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
76.t: a(n)t kaal pachhutaasee a(n)dhule jaa jam pakaR chalaiaa ||
76.e: At the last moment, you repent-you are so blind!-when the Messenger of Death seizes you and carries you away.

76.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਇਆ ਪਰਾਇਆ ॥
76.t: sabh kichh apunaa kar kar raakhiaa khin meh bhiaa paraiaa ||
76.e: You kept all your things for yourself, but in an instant, they are all lost.

76.g: ਬੁਧਿ ਵਿਸਰਜੀ ਗਈ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
76.t: budh visarajee giee siaanap kar avagan pachhutai ||
76.e: Your intellect left you, your wisdom departed, and now you repent for the evil deeds you committed.

76.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
76.t: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai prabh chetahu liv lai ||3||
76.e: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the third watch of the night, let your consciousness be lovingly focused on God. ||3||

76.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਣੁ ॥
76.t: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa biradh bhiaa tan kheen ||
76.e: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your body grows old and weak.

76.g: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕੰਨੀ ਸੁਣੈ ਨ ਵੈਣ ॥
76.t: akhee a(n)dh na dheesiee vanajaariaa mitraa ka(n)nee sunai na vain ||
76.e: Your eyes go blind, and cannot see, O my merchant friend, and your ears do not hear any words.

76.g: ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਹੇ ਪਰਾਕਉ ਤਾਣਾ ॥
76.t: akhee a(n)dh jeebh ras naahee rahe paraakau taanaa ||
76.e: Your eyes go blind, and your tongue is unable to taste; you live only with the help of others.

76.g: ਗੁਣ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
76.t: gun a(n)tar naahee kiau sukh paavai manmukh aavan jaanaa ||
76.e: With no virtue within, how can you find peace? The self-willed manmukh comes and goes in reincarnation.

76.g: ਖੜੁ ਪਕੀ ਕੁੜਿ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਆਇ ਚਲੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
76.t: khaR pakee kuR bhajai binasai aai chalai kiaa maan ||
76.e: When the crop of life has matured, it bends, breaks and perishes; why take pride in that which comes and goes?

76.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੪॥
76.t: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai gurmukh sabadh pachhaan ||4||
76.e: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the Gurmukh recognizes the Word of the Shabad. ||4||

76.g: ਓੜਕੁ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਹਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨਿ ॥
76.t: oRak aaiaa tin saahiaa vanajaariaa mitraa jar jaravaanaa ka(n)n ||
76.e: Your breath comes to its end, O my merchant friend, and your shoulders are weighed down by the tyrant of old age.

76.g: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਨ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅਵਗਣ ਖੜਸਨਿ ਬੰਨਿ ॥
76.t: eik ratee gun na samaaniaa vanajaariaa mitraa avagan khaRasan ba(n)n ||
76.e: Not one iota of virtue came into you, O my merchant friend; bound and gagged by evil, you are driven along.

76.g: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜਾਵੈ ਚੋਟ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
76.t: gun sa(n)jam jaavai choT na khaavai naa tis ja(n)man maranaa ||
76.e: One who departs with virtue and self-discipline is not struck down, and is not consigned to the cycle of birth and death.

76.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਤਰਣਾ ॥
76.t: kaal jaal jam joh na saakai bhai bhagat bhai taranaa ||
76.e: The Messenger of Death and his trap cannot touch him; through loving devotional worship, he crosses over the ocean of fear.

76.g: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਵੈ ॥
76.t: pat setee jaavai sahaj samaavai sagale dhookh miTaavai ||
76.e: He departs with honor, and merges in intuitive peace and poise; all his pains depart.

76.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥
76.t: kahu naanak praanee gurmukh chhooTai saache te pat paavai ||5||2||
76.e: Says Nanak, when the mortal becomes Gurmukh, he is saved and honored by the True Lord. ||5||2||

76.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
76.t: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ||
76.e: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla:

76.g: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਉਦਰ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥
76.t: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har paiaa udhar ma(n)jhaar ||
76.e: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord places you in the womb.

76.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰਿ ॥
76.t: har dhiaavai har ucharai vanajaariaa mitraa har har naam samaar ||
76.e: You meditate on the Lord, and chant the Lord's Name, O my merchant friend. You contemplate the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

76.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਗਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਿਆ ॥
76.t: har har naam jape aaraadhe vich aganee har jap jeeviaa ||
76.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and meditating on it within the fire of the womb, your life is sustained by dwelling on the Naam.

76.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਰਸੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤ ਥੀਵਿਆ ॥
76.t: baahar janam bhiaa mukh laagaa sarase pitaa maat theeviaa ||
76.e: You are born and you come out, and your mother and father are delighted to see your face.

76.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਵਸਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
76.t: jis kee vasat tis chetahu praanee kar hiradhai gurmukh beechaar ||
76.e: Remember the One, O mortal, to whom the child belongs. As Gurmukh, reflect upon Him within your heart.

76.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
76.t: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai har japeeaai kirapaa dhaar ||1||
76.e: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, dwell upon the Lord, who shall shower you with His Grace. ||1||

76.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
76.t: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man laagaa dhoojai bhai ||
76.e: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the mind is attached to the love of duality.

76.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਲੀਐ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਲੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
76.t: meraa meraa kar paaleeaai vanajaariaa mitraa le maat pitaa gal lai ||
76.e: Mother and father hug you close in their embrace, claiming, ""He is mine, he is mine""; so is the child brought up, O my merchant friend.

76.g: ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਗਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਏ ॥
76.t: laavai maat pitaa sadhaa gal setee man jaanai khaT khavaae ||
76.e: Your mother and father constantly hug you close in their embrace; in their minds, they believe that you will provide for them and support them.

76.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਮੂੜਾ ਦਿਤੇ ਨੋ ਲਪਟਾਏ ॥
76.t: jo dhevai tisai na jaanai mooRaa dhite no lapaTaae ||
76.e: The fool does not know the One who gives; instead, he clings to the gift.

76.g: ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
76.t: koiee gurmukh hovai su karai veechaar har dhiaavai man liv lai ||
76.e: Rare is the Gurmukh who reflects upon, meditates upon, and within his mind, is lovingly attached to the Lord.

76.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
76.t: kahu naanak dhoojai paharai praanee tis kaal na kabahoo(n) khai ||2||
76.e: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, death never devours you. ||2||

76.g: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਆਲਿ ਜੰਜਾਲਿ ॥
76.t: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa man lagaa aal ja(n)jaal ||
76.e: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, your mind is entangled in worldly and household affairs.

76.g: ਧਨੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਵੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
76.t: dhan chitavai dhan sa(n)chavai vanajaariaa mitraa har naamaa har na samaal ||
76.e: You think of wealth, and gather wealth, O my merchant friend, but you do not contemplate the Lord or the Lord's Name.

76.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਜਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
76.t: har naamaa har har kadhe na samaalai j hovai a(n)t sakhaiee ||
76.e: You never dwell upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, who will be your only Helper and Support in the end.

77.g: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
77.t: eih dhan sa(n)pai maiaa jhooThee a(n)t chhodd chaliaa pachhutaiee ||
77.e: This wealth, property and Maya are false. In the end, you must leave these, and depart in sorrow.

77.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
77.t: jis no kirapaa kare gur mele so har har naam samaal ||
77.e: Those whom the Lord, in His Mercy, unites with the Guru, reflect upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

77.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਸੇ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
77.t: kahu naanak teejai paharai praanee se jai mile har naal ||3||
77.e: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, O mortal, they go, and are united with the Lord. ||3||

77.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਲਣ ਵੇਲਾ ਆਦੀ ॥
77.t: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa har chalan velaa aadhee ||
77.e: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord announces the time of departure.

77.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਭ ਚਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਦੀ ॥
77.t: kar sevahu pooraa satiguroo vanajaariaa mitraa sabh chalee rain vihaadhee ||
77.e: Serve the Perfect True Guru, O my merchant friend; your entire life-night is passing away.

77.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਢਿਲ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥
77.t: har sevahu khin khin ddil mool na karih jit asathir jug jug hovahu ||
77.e: Serve the Lord each and every instant-do not delay! You shall become eternal throughout the ages.

77.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਖੋਵਹੁ ॥
77.t: har setee sadh maanahu raleeaa janam maran dhukh khovahu ||
77.e: Enjoy ecstasy forever with the Lord, and do away with the pains of birth and death.

77.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਾਂਦੀ ॥
77.t: gur satigur suaamee bhedh na jaanahu jit mil har bhagat sukhaa(n)dhee ||
77.e: Know that there is no difference between the Guru, the True Guru, and your Lord and Master. Meeting with Him, take pleasure in the Lord's devotional service.

77.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਸਫਲਿਓੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
77.t: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai safalio rain bhagataa dhee ||4||1||3||
77.e: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, the life-night of the devotee is fruitful. ||4||1||3||

77.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
77.t: sireeraag mahalaa panjavaa ||
77.e: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehla:

77.g: ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
77.t: pahilai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhar paitaa udharai maeh ||
77.e: In the first watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the Lord placed your soul in the womb.

77.g: ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
77.t: dhasee maasee maanas keeaa vanajaariaa mitraa kar muhalat karam kamaeh ||
77.e: In the tenth month, you were made into a human being, O my merchant friend, and you were given your allotted time to perform good deeds.

77.g: ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
77.t: muhalat kar dheenee karam kamaane jaisaa likhat dhur paiaa ||
77.e: You were given this time to perform good deeds, according to your pre-ordained destiny.

77.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸੰਜੋਇਆ ॥
77.t: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa tin bheetar prabhoo sa(n)joiaa ||
77.e: God placed you with your mother, father, brothers, sons and wife.

77.g: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਇਸੁ ਜੰਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
77.t: karam sukaram karaae aape is ja(n)tai vas kichh naeh ||
77.e: God Himself is the Cause of causes, good and bad-no one has control over these things.

77.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਪਹਿਲੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਧਰਿ ਪਾਇਤਾ ਉਦਰੈ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
77.t: kahu naanak praanee pahilai paharai dhar paitaa udharai maeh ||1||
77.e: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the first watch of the night, the soul is placed in the womb. ||1||

77.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਭਰਿ ਜੁਆਨੀ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥
77.t: dhoojai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bhar juaanee laharee dhei ||
77.e: In the second watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the fullness of youth rises in you like waves.

77.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਤਾ ਅਹੰਮੇਇ ॥
77.t: buraa bhalaa na pachhaaniee vanajaariaa mitraa man mataa aha(n)mei ||
77.e: You do not distinguish between good and evil, O my merchant friend-your mind is intoxicated with ego.

77.g: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਆਗੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ॥
77.t: buraa bhalaa na pachhaanai praanee aagai pa(n)th karaaraa ||
77.e: Mortal beings do not distinguish between good and evil, and the road ahead is treacherous.

77.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰਾ ॥
77.t: pooraa satigur kabahoo(n) na seviaa sir Thaadde jam ja(n)dhaaraa ||
77.e: They never serve the Perfect True Guru, and the cruel tyrant Death stands over their heads.

77.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਬ ਪਕਰਸਿ ਬਵਰੇ ਤਬ ਕਿਆ ਜਬਾਬੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
77.t: dharam rai jab pakaras bavare tab kiaa jabaab karei ||
77.e: When the Righteous Judge seizes you and interrogates you, O madman, what answer will you give him then?

77.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਭਰਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਲਹਰੀ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
77.t: kahu naanak dhoojai paharai praanee bhar joban laharee dhei ||2||
77.e: Says Nanak, in the second watch of the night, O mortal, the fullness of youth tosses you about like waves in the storm. ||2||

77.g: ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
77.t: teejai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa bikh sa(n)chai a(n)dh agiaan ||
77.e: In the third watch of the night, O my merchant friend, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison.

77.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰਿ ਕਲਤ੍ਰਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਿਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ॥
77.t: putr kalatr moh lapaTiaa vanajaariaa mitraa a(n)tar lahar lobhaan ||
77.e: He is entangled in emotional attachment to his wife and sons, O my merchant friend, and deep within him, the waves of greed are rising up.

77.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲਹਰਿ ਲੋਭਾਨੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
77.t: a(n)tar lahar lobhaan paraanee so prabh chit na aavai ||
77.e: The waves of greed are rising up within him, and he does not remember God.

77.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
77.t: saadhasa(n)gat siau sa(n)g na keeaa bahu jonee dhukh paavai ||
77.e: He does not join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and he suffers in terrible pain through countless incarnations.

77.g: ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
77.t: sirajanahaar visaariaa suaamee ik nimakh na lago dhiaan ||
77.e: He has forgotten the Creator, his Lord and Master, and he does not meditate on Him, even for an instant.

77.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤੀਜੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੇ ਅੰਧੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
77.t: kahu naanak praanee teejai paharai bikh sa(n)che a(n)dh agiaan ||3||
77.e: Says Nanak, in the third watch of the night, the blind and ignorant person gathers poison. ||3||

77.g: ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਰੈਣਿ ਕੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥
77.t: chauthai paharai rain kai vanajaariaa mitraa dhin neRai aaiaa soi ||
77.e: In the fourth watch of the night, O my merchant friend, that day is drawing near.

77.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ॥
77.t: gurmukh naam samaal too(n) vanajaariaa mitraa teraa dharageh belee hoi ||
77.e: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O my merchant friend. It shall be your Friend in the Court of the Lord.

77.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
77.t: gurmukh naam samaal paraanee a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||
77.e: As Gurmukh, remember the Naam, O mortal; in the end, it shall be your only companion.

78.g: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਝੂਠੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
78.t: eih moh maiaa terai sa(n)g na chaalai jhooThee preet lagaiee ||
78.e: This emotional attachment to Maya shall not go with you; it is false to fall in love with it.

78.g: ਸਗਲੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਦਰੀ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
78.t: sagalee rain gudharee a(n)dhiaaree sev satigur chaanan hoi ||
78.e: The entire night of your life has passed away in darkness; but by serving the True Guru, the Divine Light shall dawn within.

78.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਉਥੈ ਪਹਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
78.t: kahu naanak praanee chauthai paharai dhin neRai aaiaa soi ||4||
78.e: Says Nanak, O mortal, in the fourth watch of the night, that day is drawing near! ||4||

78.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੇ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
78.t: likhiaa aaiaa govi(n)dh kaa vanajaariaa mitraa uTh chale kamaanaa saath ||
78.e: Receiving the summons from the Lord of the Universe, O my merchant friend, you must arise and depart with the actions you have committed.

78.g: ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਬਿਲਮ ਨ ਦੇਵਨੀ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਓਨੀ ਤਕੜੇ ਪਾਏ ਹਾਥ ॥
78.t: eik ratee bilam na dhevanee vanajaariaa mitraa onee takaRe paae haath ||
78.e: You are not allowed a moment's delay, O my merchant friend; the Messenger of Death seizes you with firm hands.

78.g: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
78.t: likhiaa aaiaa pakaR chalaiaa manmukh sadhaa dhuhele ||
78.e: Receiving the summons, people are seized and dispatched. The self-willed manmukhs are miserable forever.

78.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
78.t: jinee pooraa satigur seviaa se dharageh sadhaa suhele ||
78.e: But those who serve the Perfect True Guru are forever happy in the Court of the Lord.

78.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਖਾਤਿ ॥
78.t: karam dharatee sareer jug a(n)tar jo bovai so khaat ||
78.e: The body is the field of karma in this age; whatever you plant, you shall harvest.

78.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸਦਾ ਭਵਾਤਿ ॥੫॥੧॥੪॥
78.t: kahu naanak bhagat soheh dharavaare manmukh sadhaa bhavaat ||5||1||4||
78.e: Says Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs wander forever in reincarnation. ||5||1||4||

78.g: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਛੰਤ
78.t: sireeraag mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa chha(n)t
78.e: Siree Raag, Fourth Mehla, Second House, Chhant:

78.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
78.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
78.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

78.g: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖੈ ॥
78.t: mu(n)dh iaanee peieeaRai kiau kar har dharasan pikhai ||
78.e: How can the ignorant soul-bride obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is in this world of her father's home?

78.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ॥
78.t: har har apanee kirapaa kare gurmukh saahuraRai ka(n)m sikhai ||
78.e: When the Lord Himself grants His Grace, the Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home.

78.g: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਕੰਮ ਸਿਖੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
78.t: saahuraRai ka(n)m sikhai gurmukh har har sadhaa dhiaae ||
78.e: The Gurmukh learns the duties of her Husband's Celestial Home; she meditates forever on the Lord, Har, Har.

78.g: ਸਹੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਏ ॥
78.t: saheeaa vich firai suhelee har dharageh baeh luddaae ||
78.e: She walks happily among her companions, and in the Lord's Court, she swings her arms joyfully.

78.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਖੈ ॥
78.t: lekhaa dharam rai kee baakee jap har har naam kirakhai ||
78.e: Her account is cleared by the Righteous Judge of Dharma, when she chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

78.g: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦਿਖੈ ॥੧॥
78.t: mu(n)dh iaanee peieeaRai gurmukh har dharasan dhikhai ||1||
78.e: The ignorant soul-bride becomes Gurmukh, and gains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, while she is still in her father's house. ||1||

78.g: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
78.t: veeaahu hoaa mere baabulaa gurmukhe har paiaa ||
78.e: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord.

78.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡੁ ਬਲਾਇਆ ॥
78.t: agiaan a(n)dheraa kaTiaa gur giaan pracha(n)dd balaiaa ||
78.e: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled. The Guru has revealed the blazing light of spiritual wisdom.

78.g: ਬਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਾ ॥
78.t: baliaa gur giaan a(n)dheraa binasiaa har ratan padhaarath laadhaa ||
78.e: This spiritual wisdom given by the Guru shines forth, and the darkness has been dispelled. I have found the Priceless Jewel of the Lord.

78.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖਾਧਾ ॥
78.t: haumai rog giaa dhukh laathaa aap aapai gurmat khaadhaa ||
78.e: The sickness of my ego has been dispelled, and my pain is over and done. Through the Guru's Teachings, my identity has consumed my identical identity.

78.g: ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
78.t: akaal moorat var paiaa abinaasee naa kadhe marai na jaiaa ||
78.e: I have obtained my Husband Lord, the Akaal Moorat, the Undying Form. He is Imperishable; He shall never die, and He shall never ever leave.

78.g: ਵੀਆਹੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
78.t: veeaahu hoaa mere baabolaa gurmukhe har paiaa ||2||
78.e: My marriage has been performed, O my father. As Gurmukh, I have found the Lord. ||2||

78.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੁਹੰਦੀ ॥
78.t: har sat sate mere baabulaa har jan mil ja(n)n(j) suha(n)dhee ||
78.e: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage procession looks beautiful.

78.g: ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ॥
78.t: pevakaRai har jap suhelee vich saahuraRai kharee soha(n)dhee ||
78.e: She who chants the Lord's Name is happy in this world of her father's home, and in the next world of her Husband Lord, she shall be very beautiful.

78.g: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਰੀ ਸੋਹੰਦੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
78.t: saahuraRai vich kharee soha(n)dhee jin pevakaRai naam samaaliaa ||
78.e: In her Husband Lord's Celestial Home, she shall be most beautiful, if she has remembered the Naam in this world.

78.g: ਸਭੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਢਾਲਿਆ ॥
78.t: sabh safalio janam tinaa dhaa gurmukh jinaa man jin paasaa ddaaliaa ||
78.e: Fruitful are the lives of those who, as Gurmukh, have conquered their minds-they have won the game of life.

78.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸੋਹਿਆ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਨੰਦੀ ॥
78.t: har sa(n)t janaa mil kaaraj sohiaa var paiaa purakh ana(n)dhee ||
78.e: Joining with the humble Saints of the Lord, my actions bring prosperity, and I have obtained the Lord of Bliss as my Husband.

78.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੋਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੰਞ ਸੋੁਹੰਦੀ ॥੩॥
78.t: har sat sat mere baabolaa har jan mil ja(n)n(j) suoha(n)dhee ||3||
78.e: The Lord is the Truest of the True, O my father. Joining with the humble servants of the Lord, the marriage party has been embellished. ||3||

78.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥
78.t: har prabh mere baabulaa har dhevahu dhaan mai dhaajo ||
78.e: O my father, give me the Name of the Lord God as my wedding gift and dowry.

79.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਪੜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਵਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਾਜੋ ॥
79.t: har kapaRo har sobhaa dhevahu jit savarai meraa kaajo ||
79.e: Give me the Lord as my wedding gown, and the Lord as my glory, to accomplish my works.

79.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਆ ॥
79.t: har har bhagatee kaaj suhelaa gur satigur dhaan dhivaiaa ||
79.e: Through devotional worship to the Lord, this ceremony is made blissful and beautiful; the Guru, the True Guru, has given this gift.

79.g: ਖੰਡਿ ਵਰਭੰਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਈ ਇਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਰਲੈ ਰਲਾਇਆ ॥
79.t: kha(n)dd varabha(n)dd har sobhaa hoiee ih dhaan na ralai ralaiaa ||
79.e: Across the continents, and throughout the Universe, the Lord's Glory is pervading. This gift is not diminished by being diffused among all.

79.g: ਹੋਰਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਾਜੁ ਜਿ ਰਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਕਚੁ ਪਾਜੋ ॥
79.t: hor manmukh dhaaj j rakh dhikhaaleh su kooR aha(n)kaar kach paajo ||
79.e: Any other dowry, which the self-willed manmukhs offer for show, is only false egotism and a worthless display.

79.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬੁਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੈ ਦਾਜੋ ॥੪॥
79.t: har prabh mere baabulaa har dhevahu dhaan mai dhaajo ||4||
